local function shoot(n)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, s in ipairs(E.shoot) do
if s.age >= s.life then
local dir = math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1
local ang = 0.35 + math.random() * 0.35
local sp = S.sx * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.5)
s.life, s.age = 0.55 + math.random() * 0.3, 0
s.len = S.sy * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.12)
s.x, s.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.9 - dir * S.sx * 0.2, -S.sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.1)
s.vx, s.vy = dir * math.cos(ang) * sp, math.sin(ang) * sp
s.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(s.vy, s.vx))
s.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.moonY
local a = (i / #E.orbs) * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.4
b.vx, b.vy = math.cos(a) * w * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.2), -h * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
end
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.mk = S.mk + 0.22
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.7 * I), S.zk - 0.14 * I, 30, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 16, 260, 0.8)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.04, 0.5)
shoot(2)
itick(0.55, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.sp.tsc = {0.35, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.chroma, S.zk, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), 44, S.zk - 0.2 * I, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.045 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.2 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if m == 2 and t - S.modeAt > 0.15 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.22 * k) * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.4)
end
end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.75)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.12 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.03 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, 5 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 8 * k
shoot(k > 1 and 2 or 1)
if m == 1 then
S.step = S.step + 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
itick(0.9 + 0.1 * S.step, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 380 + 80 * S.step, 0.7, 3, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY))
else
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 5 + 3 * k, 150, 0.5) end
if m == 2 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.3 + 0.25 * math.random())
end
end
end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 3 then S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k) end
if m == 4 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.5 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.08 * I)
end
if m == 2 then
E.orbs[math.random(1, #E.orbs)].vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.4 * math.random())
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
local col = accent()
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bar = math.clamp(math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 1, 16)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local floorY = sy * 0.27
local R3 = math.min(sy * 0.34, sx * 0.42)
local rm0 = sy * 0.15
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u3 = clamp01((t - M3) / (M4 - M3))
local u4 = clamp01((t - M4) / (K.DUR - M4))
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 18
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * K.INT
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.12, 0.6)
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 9 or 40) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.5 or 1.2, 0.3)
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 220 + 6 * beatIdx, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col, sy) end
end
while S.wi < #TW and t >= TW[S.wi + 1][1] do
S.wi = S.wi + 1
if t - TW[S.wi][1] < 0.3 and #E.dust > 0 then
E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1
if mode >= 3 then E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1 end
end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and 0.3 or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.28 + 0.18 * S.step) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.88 * S.ecl)
local MYF = -sy * 0.07
local e1 = smooth(u1)
local mscT, myT = 1, MYF
if mode == 1 then
mscT = 0.55 + 0.45 * e1
myT = lerp(floorY + rm0 * mscT * 1.15, MYF, e1)
elseif mode == 3 then
mscT = 0.84
elseif mode == 4 then
mscT = 1 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
end
local msc = follow("msc", mscT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.55)
local myy = follow("my", myT, 9, 0.8, dt, floorY + rm0 * 0.55 * 1.15)
S.moonY = myy
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 1 + 0.05 * u1 + 0.22 * u1 ^ 3
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1)
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
elseif mode == 2 then
tz = 1.03 + 0.05 * S.ecl
tr = ((bar % 2 == 1) and 1 or -1) * 1.2 * K.INT
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
tx = math.sin(u3 * 6.283) * sx * 0.04
tr = math.sin(u3 * 6.283 + 1.2) * 1.8 * K.INT
tz = 1.05 + 0.03 * math.sin(u3 * 12.566) + 0.05 * S.ecl
else
tz = 1.06 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
tr = (1 - u4) * -2 * K.INT
end
local hk = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 1.5 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk
local kd = math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
SKYT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.6 * S.ecl),
SKYB:Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br):Lerp(BLACK, 0.7 * S.ecl)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br - (mode > 1 and 0.16 * S.lv or 0), 0.35, 1)
local starsOn = clamp01(t / (M2 * 0.8))
local starCol = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
for _, d in ipairs(E.dust) do
d.x = (d.x + dt * S.ts * (0.004 + 0.01 * S.lv) * d.z) % 1
d.fl = d.fl * math.exp(-5 * dt)
d.f.Position = UDim2.new(d.x * 2.4 - 0.7, -cx * d.z * 0.3, d.y * 1.6 - 0.3, 0)
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * (1.2 + d.z) + d.ph)
if d.i <= (0.15 + 0.85 * starsOn) * #E.dust then
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.35 * tw - 0.8 * d.fl + 0.5 * S.ecl, 0, 1)
else
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = starCol
local sz = d.sz * (1 + 2.2 * d.fl)
d.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
end
for _, c in ipairs(E.clouds) do
c.x = (c.x + dt * S.ts * c.sp * (1 + 2 * S.lv)) % 1
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(c.x * 1.7 - 0.35, -cx * 0.15, 0.5, c.y * sy)
c.f.Size = UDim2.new(c.w, 0, 0, sy * c.h)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 122, 200):Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.92 - 0.04 * S.lv - 0.03 * S.pulse - 0.04 * S.br, 0.8, 1)
end

local mpos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, myy)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halos) do
h.Position = mpos
local hs = md * (1.2 + 0.4 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.mk)
h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hs, hs)
h.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.4)
h.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - br * (0.1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.08 * S.pulse) / i, 0.55, 1)
end

E.moon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.moon.BackgroundColor3 = DIM:Lerp(MOON, S.br)

E.moonS.Thickness = 2 + 5 * S.ecl + 2 * S.pulse
E.moonS.Transparency = math.clamp(0.6 - 0.45 * S.ecl - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.05, 1)
E.shade.Position = mpos
E.shade.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.shade.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.88 * S.ecl
E.sea.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.sea.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.4), 0.6 * S.ecl)
E.hz.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.hz.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
E.hz.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.4 * br - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.1, 1)

for i, l in ipairs(E.lines) do

l.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
l.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.9 - 0.55 * br - 0.25 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse * (1 - u) + 0.15 * u, 0.1, 1)
end

for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
local r = sy * b.rk
local bw, bh, vis = 2 * r, 2 * r, mode >= 2
local zi = 10
if mode == 2 then
b.vy = b.vy + sy * 1.5 * sdt
b.vx = b.vx * (1 - 0.3 * sdt)
b.x, b.y = b.x + b.vx * sdt, b.y + b.vy * sdt
if b.y > floorY - r then
b.y = floorY - r
b.vy = -math.max(math.abs(b.vy) * 0.72, sy * 0.28)
end
local hw = sx * 0.5 - r
if b.x > hw then b.x, b.vx = hw, -math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 elseif b.x < -hw then b.x, b.vx = -hw, math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 end

bw, bh = bw * (1 - st * 0.35), bh * (1 + st)

E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then

else

end
end

loop()
end)

end

function FX.Intro3(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro3Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.02, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 106.92), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n)
return K.OFF + n * K.BAR
end
local M2, M3, M4, TN = B(8), B(16), B(24), B(27)
local NS = 23
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local HERO = "JEALOUSY"
local CREATOR = "STEVETHEREALONE"
local SUB = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80)) or string.format("MY JEALOUSY  //  %d BPM", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 106.92) + 0.5))
local conns, E = {}, {}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end
local function blinkMul(tb, t)
local u = (t - tb) / 0.2
if u < 0 or u > 1 then return 1 end
return 1 - 0.92 * math.sin(u * 3.1416)
end

local function drawEye(EW, open, ix, iy, ir, prx, pry, irisCol, rimCol, sclCol, rimT)
local A = EW * 0.5
E.line.Visible = open < 0.09
if E.line.Visible then
E.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(EW * (0.45 + 0.5 * clamp01(open * 11)), 2)
E.line.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
E.line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.4 * clamp01(open * 11)
end
if open < 0.025 then
for i = 1, NS do
E.rim[i].Visible, E.scl[i].Visible, E.iri[i].Visible, E.pup[i].Visible = false, false, false, false
end
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = false, false
return
end
local Bh = math.max(1, EW * 0.21 * open)
local RR = (A * A / Bh + Bh) * 0.5
local dd = (A * A / Bh - Bh) * 0.5
local h = (2 * Bh) / NS
for i = 1, NS do
local y = (i - (NS + 1) / 2) * h
local ay = math.abs(y)
local w2 = RR * RR - (ay + dd) * (ay + dd)
local w = w2 > 0 and math.sqrt(w2) or 0
local rim, sc, iv, pu = E.rim[i], E.scl[i], E.iri[i], E.pup[i]
if w < 0.6 then
rim.Visible, sc.Visible, iv.Visible, pu.Visible = false, false, false, false
else
local k = ay / Bh
rim.Visible = true
rim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
rim.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w + 8, h + 5)
rim.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
rim.BackgroundTransparency = rimT
sc.Visible = true
sc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
sc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w, h + 1.5)
sc.BackgroundColor3 = sclCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55 * k * k)
local dy = y - iy
if math.abs(dy) < ir then
local ch = math.sqrt(ir * ir - dy * dy)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - ch, -w), math.min(ix + ch, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
iv.Visible = true
iv.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
iv.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
local kk = math.abs(dy) / ir
iv.BackgroundColor3 = irisCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.12 + 0.62 * kk * kk)
else
iv.Visible = false
end
else
iv.Visible = false
end
if math.abs(dy) < pry then
local pc = prx * math.sqrt(1 - (dy / pry) ^ 2)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - pc, -w), math.min(ix + pc, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
pu.Visible = true
pu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
pu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
else
pu.Visible = false
end
else
pu.Visible = false
end
end
end
local hlOn = open > 0.55
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = hlOn, hlOn
if hlOn then
E.hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix - ir * 0.36, iy - ir * 0.4)
E.hl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.3, ir * 0.3)
E.hl2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix + ir * 0.3, iy + ir * 0.34)
E.hl2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.14, ir * 0.14)
end
end
local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.sp.tsc = {2.6, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.85 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 13 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = w * 0.09 end
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.sp.tsc = {1.9, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.25
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.16 * I, 36, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.35 * I), S.zk + 0.04 * I, 20, 5 * I
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 800, 1.1, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.05, 0.8)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
itick(0.7, 0.9)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05 * k
S.pk, S.vk = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.1 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if k > 1 and (m == 2 or m == 3) then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function hatHit(m)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.45)
if m >= 2 and #E.rain > 0 then E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1 end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.fl, S.gl = 1, 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.015 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 1 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 260 + 90 * k, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if m == 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k)
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.blinkT, S.capT = t, t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.gtx = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.35 + 0.5 * math.random())
S.gty = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 6
if m == 4 then S.zk = S.zk - 0.02 * I end
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u4 = clamp01((t - B(30)) / (K.DUR - B(30)))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.ic = S.ic:Lerp(IRISC[mode], 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut, bigCut = false, false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then
inCut = true
bigCut = (c[2] - c[1]) > 0.5
end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + (bigCut and 24 or 10)
S.zk = S.zk + (bigCut and 0.06 or 0.02) * K.INT
if bigCut then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 7, 0.1, 0.7) end
end
S.inCut, S.bigCut = inCut, bigCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.pk = S.pk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.vk = S.vk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.fl = S.fl * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.gl = S.gl * math.exp(-6 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.3 then hatHit(mode) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.vi < #VOC and t >= VOC[S.vi + 1][1] do
S.vi = S.vi + 1
if t - VOC[S.vi][1] < 0.3 then vocHit(t, mode) end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and (bigCut and 0.3 or 0.6) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.3 + 0.45 * u1) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.8 * S.ecl)
local EWb = math.min(sx * 0.68, sy * 1.15)
local ewT, eyT, openT, prxT, pryT = 0.9, -sy * 0.08, 1, 0.34, 0.34
if mode == 1 then
local fb = clamp01((t - B(7)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.6 + 0.3 * u1
eyT = -sy * 0.03
openT = 0.03 + 0.6 * smooth(clamp01((t - 2.0) / 14.5)) + 0.37 * fb ^ 2 + 0.22 * S.fl
prxT = 0.36 - 0.22 * fb
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 2 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(15)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 1
eyT = -sy * 0.1
openT = lerp(1, 0.32, smooth(q)) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.34 + 0.5 * S.pk
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 3 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(23)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.88
eyT = sy * 0.07
openT = lerp(1.06, 0.7, q) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.1 + 0.2 * S.pk
pryT = 0.97
else
ewT = 0.92 + 5.5 * u4 ^ 3
eyT = -sy * 0.06 * (1 - u4)
openT = 0.86 + 0.14 * S.pk + 0.3 * u4
prxT = 0.36 + 0.4 * S.pk + 0.55 * u4
pryT = prxT
end
local blink = blinkMul(S.blinkT, t)
local ew = follow("ew", ewT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.6) * EWb * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse + S.mk)
local ey = follow("ey", eyT, 8, 0.8, dt, -sy * 0.03)
local open = follow("eo", openT, 16, 0.62, dt, 0) * blink * (1 - S.ecl)
open = math.clamp(open, 0, 1.4)
S.eyeY = ey
local irS = ew * 0.2
S.gtx = S.gtx * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)
S.gty = S.gty * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)
local wander = (mode == 1) and 1 or ((mode == 4) and 0.35 or 0.12)
local gx = follow("gx", S.gtx + math.sin(t * 0.45) * 0.35 * wander, 16, 0.55, dt, 0)
local gy = follow("gy", S.gty + math.sin(t * 0.31) * 0.2 * wander, 16, 0.55, dt, 0)
local ix, iy = gx * (ew * 0.5 - irS) * 0.8, gy * ew * 0.05
local prx = follow("prx", prxT, 14, 0.6, dt, 0.34) * irS
local pry = follow("pry", pryT, 14, 0.6, dt, 0.34) * irS
local irisCol = S.ic:Lerp(BLACK, (1 - br) * 0.75 + 0.06):Lerp(WHITE, (mode == 4 and 0.55 * u4 ^ 2 or 0) + 0.12 * S.gl)
local rimCol = (mode == 3) and EMER or col
local sclCol = Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 14):Lerp(S.ic, 0.1 + 0.14 * S.pulse)
drawEye(ew, open, ix, iy, irS, prx, pry, irisCol, rimCol, sclCol, math.clamp(0.55 - 0.25 * S.pulse - 0.2 * S.lv, 0.1, 0.8))
E.eye.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
local eyeVis = (t > 0.25)
for i, hh in ipairs(E.halo) do
hh.Visible = eyeVis and open > 0.05
local hs = ew * (0.7 + 0.35 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.12 * S.mk)
hh.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
hh.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hs, hs * 0.62)
hh.BackgroundColor3 = S.ic:Lerp(col, 0.4)
hh.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - br * (0.08 + 0.07 * S.lv + 0.09 * S.pulse) / i, 0.6, 1)
end
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 1 + 0.04 * u1 + 0.18 * u1 ^ 3
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1)
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
elseif mode == 2 then
tz = 1.03 + 0.05 * S.ecl
tr = ((math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1) * 1.1 * K.INT
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
local u3 = clamp01((t - M3) / (M4 - M3))
tx = math.sin(u3 * 6.283) * sx * 0.04
tr = math.sin(u3 * 6.283 + 1.2) * 1.8 * K.INT
tz = 1.05 + 0.03 * math.sin(u3 * 12.566) + 0.04 * S.ecl
else
tz = 1.02 + 0.04 * clamp01((t - M4) / (K.DUR - M4)) + 0.25 * u4 ^ 3
tr = math.sin((t - M4) * 0.35) * 1.4 * K.INT * (1 - u4)
end
local hk = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 0.7 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk
local kd = math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
S.bgT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.6 * S.ecl),
S.bgB:Lerp(col, 0.04 + 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br):Lerp(BLACK, 0.7 * S.ecl)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br - (mode > 1 and 0.16 * S.lv or 0), 0.35, 1)
local rainOn = clamp01((t - 1.5) / 4)
for _, r in ipairs(E.rain) do
r.y = (r.y + dt * S.ts * (0.5 + 1.6 * S.lv) * r.z * 0.9) % 1
r.fl = r.fl * math.exp(-6 * dt)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(r.x * 1.4 - 0.2, -cx * r.z * 0.2, r.y * 1.4 - 0.2, 0)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.th, r.len * (0.6 + S.lv))
r.f.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, math.clamp(0.93 - 0.3 * S.lv - 0.25 * S.rainK - 0.55 * r.fl, 0.2, 1) + (1 - rainOn) + 0.5 * S.ecl)
end
local ec0 = ew * 0.07
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do
c.len = lerp(c.len, c.tgt, 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
if mode == 4 then c.tgt = c.tgt * math.exp(-2 * dt) end
local show = c.len > 3 and mode > 1
c.f.Visible = show
if show then
local d = ec0 + c.len * 0.5
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(c.a) * d, 0.5, ey + math.sin(c.a) * d)
c.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(c.len, c.w)
c.f.Rotation = math.deg(c.a)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.2 + 0.35 * (1 - S.pulse) + 0.4 * S.ecl, 0.1, 0.9)
end
end
local sdt = dt * S.ts
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
local r = sy * b.rk
local vis = mode >= 2
local bw, bh = 2 * r, 2 * r
local zi = 4
if vis then
local rev = (mode == 2) and ((t - M2) / (K.BAR * 2)) or ((mode == 3) and ((t - M3) / K.BAR + 0.5) or ((t - M4) / (K.BAR * 3) + 1.2))
local R = math.min(sy * 0.36, sx * 0.44) * (1 + 0.12 * S.stormK)
if mode == 4 then
R = R * (0.62 - 0.5 * u4 * u4)
bw, bh = bw * (1 - 0.7 * u4 ^ 3), bh * (1 - 0.7 * u4 ^ 3)
end
local a = b.a + rev * 6.283
local kk = 1 - math.exp(-7 * dt)
local sa = math.sin(a)
b.x, b.y = lerp(b.x, math.cos(a) * R, kk), lerp(b.y, ey + sa * R * 0.55, kk)
bw, bh = bw * (1 + 0.22 * sa), bh * (1 + 0.22 * sa)
if sa < 0 then zi = 4 else zi = 12 end
local dx, dy = -b.x, ey - b.y
local dl = math.max(1, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
b.pu.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + dx / dl * 0.16, 0.5 + dy / dl * 0.16)
bh = bh * blinkMul(S.blinkT + i * 0.035, t)
end
if zi ~= b.zi then
b.zi = zi
b.f.ZIndex = zi
end
b.f.Visible = vis
if vis then
b.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, b.x, 0.5, b.y)
b.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bw, math.max(2, bh))
b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 * S.ecl
b.pu.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 * (0.7 + 0.5 * S.pk), 0.5 * (0.7 + 0.5 * S.pk))
b.ir.BackgroundColor3 = (mode == 3) and CRIM or b.pc
b.gl.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.86 - 0.2 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.5, 1)
end
end
do
local ty3, ts3 = sy * 0.27, 0.5
if mode == 2 then
ty3, ts3 = sy * 0.19, 1
elseif mode == 3 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.37, 0.42
elseif mode == 4 then
ty3, ts3 = sy * 0.27, 0.8 + 0.4 * u4
end
ts3 = ts3 * (1 - 0.1 * S.ecl)
local tyy = follow("ty", ty3, 9, 0.7, dt, sy * 0.27)
local tss = follow("tsc", ts3, 9, 0.62, dt, 0.5)
local want
if mode == 1 then
local n = math.clamp(math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 0, #HERO)
want = HERO:sub(1, n) .. string.rep("-", #HERO - n)
elseif mode == 4 and t >= TN and NAME ~= HERO then
want = scr(NAME, (t - TN) / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
else
want = scr(HERO, (t - ((mode == 2) and M2 or ((mode == 3) and M3 or M4))) / (K.BEAT * 1.2))
end
local settled = (want == HERO or want == NAME or mode == 1)
if settled then
if S.hero ~= want then
S.hero = want
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
else
S.hero = ""
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
E.tF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy)
E.tS.Scale = math.max(0.05, tss * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse))
S.chroma = S.chroma * math.exp(-5 * dt)
local ch = S.chroma + (mode == 4 and 18 * u4 or 0)
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ch, 0.5, ch * 0.25), UDim2.new(0.5, -ch, 0.5, -ch * 0.25)
if mode == 1 then
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1
E.tM.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.5 - 0.3 * S.pulse, 0.1, 1)
else
local ca = math.clamp(1 - ch / 16, 0.25, 1)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = ca, ca
E.tM.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.55 * S.ecl + (mode == 4 and 0.8 * u4 ^ 2 or 0), 0, 1)
end
E.tM.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.18)
E.sub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy + sy * 0.12 * (mode == 3 and 0.5 or 1))
E.sub.TextColor3 = col
if bigCut then
E.sub.Text = "-   B L I N K   -"
E.sub.TextTransparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 9)
elseif mode == 4 and t >= TN then
E.sub.Text = "J E A L O U S Y"
E.sub.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.25 + u4, 0, 1)
else
E.sub.Text = SUB
E.sub.TextTransparency = (mode == 2 and (1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * 2) / K.BEAT))) or (mode == 3 and 0.3) or 1
end
local ca = t - S.capT
if S.capTxt ~= "" and ca < 1.5 then
E.cap.Text = scr(S.capTxt, ca / 0.28)
E.cap.TextColor3 = col
E.cap.TextTransparency = ca < 1.0 and (0.05 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 40)) or clamp01((ca - 1.0) / 0.5)
local capY = ey - (ew * 0.21 * math.max(open, 0.4) + sy * 0.07)
E.cap.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.noise(t * 30, seed) * 6) * (1 - clamp01(ca / 0.28)), 0.5, capY)
elseif E.cap.TextTransparency < 1 then
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
end
for i, f in ipairs(E.cards) do
local w0, w1 = CARDWIN[i][1], CARDWIN[i][2]
local show = t >= w0 and t < w1
f.Visible = show
if show then

local vt = math.clamp((mode == 1 and 0.5 or (mode == 3 and 0.22 or 0.34)) - 0.3 * S.vk - 0.08 * S.lv - 0.15 * S.ecl, 0.05, 0.8)
for _, vf in ipairs(E.vig) do vf.BackgroundTransparency = vt end

E.tc.Text = string.format("T+ %05.2f / %05.2f", math.min(t, K.DUR), K.DUR)
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING: " .. string.upper(SONG.Title or "")
E.ms.Text = modStatus()
E.tc.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 0)) or 1
E.np.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 1)) or 1
E.ms.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 2)) or 1
for _, l in ipairs({E.tc, E.np, E.ms}) do l.TextColor3 = col end

E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.skipS.Color, E.skip.TextColor3 = col, col
E.skipS.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3)
if mode == 1 then
local L = {
"> JEALOUSY.EXE  ONLINE", "> TARGET  ACQUIRED", "> HEARTBEAT  " .. string.format("%d", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 106.92) + 0.5)) .. " BPM",
"> ENVY  LEVEL  RISING", "> " .. modStatus(), "> SOMEONE  IS  WATCHING",
}

for i, ln in ipairs(L) do
if bt >= 2 + (i - 1) * 4 then out[#out + 1] = scr(ln, (bt - 2 - (i - 1) * 4) / 1.4) end
end
if bt >= 28 then out[#out + 1] = "> DROP IN " .. (32 - beatIdx) end
E.term.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
E.term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.035), 12, 20)
E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)
E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then
E.term.Text = ""
end
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local fa = clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen)
local flashA = math.max(fa, math.min(0.85, S.flashK))
if mode == 4 then flashA = math.max(flashA, S.pulse * 0.1 * u4 * K.INT) end
local fadeIn = 1 - clamp01(t / (K.BEAT * 3))
if fadeIn > 0.01 and flashA < 0.05 then
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 1 - fadeIn
else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 3 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end

FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,

})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})

function FX.Intro4(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)

K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 40 * K.BAR
local function B(n)
return K.OFF + n * K.BAR
end
local M2, MB, MR, M3, MF = B(4), B(20), B(24), B(28), B(36)

if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local HERO, CREATOR = "LIL PEEP", "STEVETHEREALONE"
local SUB = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80)) or string.format("LIL PEEP  //  NUTS  //  %d BPM", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 124) + 0.5))
local conns, E = {}, {}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local PINK, ICE, VIO, HOT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 168), Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 214)
local MODEC = {ICE, PINK, VIO, HOT}

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end

a[3] = round(box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.6768, 0.3602), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0))
return a
end

end

end)

if isPress(input) then tween(sc, 0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
end
local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.4
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), S.zk + 0.45 * I, 40, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.6)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.winOn = false
S.blk, S.chroma, S.shake, S.zk = 1, 22, 7 * I, S.zk - 0.06 * I
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 1.2, 3, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.9)
itick(0.4, 0.9)
elseif m == 4 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.6
S.sp.tsc = {2.4, 0}
for _, b in ipairs(E.minis) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I), S.zk + 0.55 * I, 44, 16 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 30, 340, 1)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 0.9, 7, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 0.75, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.7)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function milestone(i, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if i == 1 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk + w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.25 * I, 30, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif i == 2 then
S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = S.zk - 0.1 * I, 20, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 900, 1.2, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.05, 0.8)
itick(0.8, 0.9)
elseif i == 3 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk - w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.3 * I, 30
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
else
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I), S.zk - 0.15 * I, 40, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 1, 6, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.05, 0.8)
itick(0.6, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w)
local I = K.INT
if m == 1 then S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5) return end
local dmp = (m == 3 and t < MR) and 0.4 or 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.08 + 0.1 * k) * I * dmp)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, dmp)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.04 * k * I * dmp
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1 + k) * I * dmp
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.007 * k * I * dmp
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (3 + 4 * k) * I * dmp)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 9 * k * dmp
itick(0.55, 0.8 * dmp)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 420 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.04, 0.35) end
if k > 1 and m ~= 3 then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col)
if m == 1 then return end
S.sk = 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.025 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * K.INT)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.6)
if k > 1 and spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 8, 220, 0.5) end
end
local function hatHit()
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.4)
S.starK = math.min(1, S.starK + 0.15)
E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1
for _ = 1, 2 do
E.win[math.random(1, #E.win)].fl = 1
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.capT = t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.45)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 7
S.xk = S.xk + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * S.sx * 0.012 * I
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < MB and 2 or (t < M3 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local fb = clamp01((t - B(3)) / K.BAR)
local u3 = clamp01((t - MB) / (MR - MB))
local ur = clamp01((t - MR) / (M3 - MR))
local u4 = clamp01((t - MF) / (K.DUR - MF))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 14
S.zk = S.zk + 0.03 * K.INT
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.06, 0.4) end
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.cutK = lerp(S.cutK, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 12 and beatIdx <= 15 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 12), 0.8) end
if beatIdx % 2 == 0 then
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5 + 0.03 * beatIdx)
S.dubAt = t + K.BEAT * 0.38
end
elseif mode == 3 and t >= B(27) then
S.capT, S.capTxt = t, tostring(112 - beatIdx)
itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 108), 0.8)
end
end
if S.dubAt > 0 and t >= S.dubAt then
S.dubAt = -1
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.4)
end
local ex = math.exp
S.pulse = S.pulse * ex(-5 * dt)
S.hk = S.hk * ex(-7 * dt)
S.sk = S.sk * ex(-9 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * ex(-6 * dt)
while S.mi < #MIL and t >= MIL[S.mi + 1] do
S.mi = S.mi + 1
if t - MIL[S.mi] < 0.3 then milestone(S.mi, col, sx) end
end
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.3 then hatHit() end
end
while S.vi < #VOC and t >= VOC[S.vi + 1][1] do
S.vi = S.vi + 1
if t - VOC[S.vi][1] < 0.3 then vocHit(t, mode) end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - ex(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, ((mode == 3 and t < MR) and 0.45) or (inCut and 0.4 or 1), 1 - ex(-6 * dt))
local HS = math.min(sx * 0.46, sy * 0.76)
local szT, eyT, gapT, hv = 0.8, sy * 0.05, 0, 1
if mode == 1 then
hv = smooth(clamp01((t - 1.9) / 4.5))
szT = 0.34 + 0.42 * u1 * u1 - 0.1 * clamp01((t - (M2 - K.BEAT * 0.7)) / (K.BEAT * 0.7))
eyT = -sy * 0.02
elseif mode == 3 then
szT = 0.72 - 0.06 * u3 + 0.16 * ur * ur
eyT = -sy * 0.03 - sy * 0.02 * u3
gapT = 0.55 * ((t < MR) and smooth(u3) or (1 - smooth(ur) ^ 2))
elseif mode == 4 then
szT, eyT = 0.86, sy * 0.08
end
eyT = eyT * (1 - u4)
local ey = follow("ey", eyT, 8, 0.8, dt, -sy * 0.02)
S.eyeY = ey
local hsz = follow("hs", szT, 14, 0.5, dt, 0.3) * HS * (1 + 0.22 * S.hk + 0.05 * S.pulse) * (1 + 9 * u4 ^ 3)
local gap = follow("gap", gapT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0) * HS
local gapK = gap / (0.55 * HS)
local rimC = col:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(0.85, 0.45 * S.hk + 0.7 * u4 * u4))
if mode == 3 then rimC = rimC:Lerp(BLACK, 0.3 * (1 - ur)) end
local darkC = S.bgB:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55):Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.08 * S.hk)
local hvT = 1 - hv * (1 - 0.85 * S.cutK)
E.hc.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
for s = 1, 2 do
local H = E.hh[s]
local cw, ch = hsz * 1.25, hsz * 2.6
H.cf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, ch)
H.cf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((s == 1 and -1 or 1) * gap * 0.5, (s == 1 and 1 or -0.6) * gapK * sy * 0.035)
H.ct.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s == 1 and cw or 0, ch * 0.5)
H.ct.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hsz, hsz)
H.ct.Rotation = (s == 1 and -14 or 11) * gapK + math.sin(t * 1.7 + s) * 1.5 * gapK
for i, g in ipairs(H.glow) do
g.BackgroundColor3 = col
g.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, math.clamp(0.95 - 0.02 * i - 0.14 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.hk, 0.5, 1) + hvT)
end
paint(H.rim, rimC, hvT)
paint(H.dark, darkC, hvT)
end
E.seam.Visible = gap > 3
if E.seam.Visible then
E.seam.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
E.seam.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3 + 3 * S.pulse, hsz * 0.92)
E.seam.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
E.seam.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.25 + 0.4 * math.noise(t * 25, seed), 0.1, 0.9)
end
if t - S.histT > 0.035 then
S.histT = t
table.insert(S.hist, 1, clamp01(S.lv * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.random()) + 0.55 * S.hk))
S.hist[25] = nil
end
local vizOn = (mode == 1 and 0.5 * clamp01((t - 2) / 5)) or ((mode == 3 and t < MR) and 0.45 or 1)
local bw = sx * 0.9 / 48
for i, f in ipairs(E.viz) do
local idx = (i <= 24) and (25 - i) or (i - 24)
local v = S.hist[idx] or 0
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ((i <= 24) and -1 or 1) * ((idx - 0.5) * bw), 0.5, ey)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bw * 0.55, 3 + v * sy * 0.2 * vizOn)
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.3 + 0.5 * idx / 24 + (1 - vizOn) * 0.4, 0.2, 1)
end
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 0.8 + 0.2 * smooth(u1) + 0.12 * fb ^ 2
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1) + 5 * fb ^ 3
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
ty = sy * 0.02 * (1 - u1)
elseif mode == 2 then
local ph = (t - M2) / (MB - M2)
tz = 1 + 0.07 * ph + 0.04 * math.sin(ph * 12.566)
tx = math.sin(ph * 6.283) * sx * 0.035
tr = ((math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1) * 1.3 * K.INT * (0.6 + 0.4 * ph) - 3 * ph ^ 3
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
if t < MR then
tz = 0.96 + 0.05 * u3
ty = -sy * 0.03 * u3
tr = math.sin(u3 * 3.1416) * 2
else
tz = 1 + 0.2 * ur * ur
tr = -7 * ur ^ 3
tx = math.sin(ur * 18) * sx * 0.006 * ur
end
else
local ph = (t - M3) / (MF - M3)
tz = 1.03 + 0.04 * math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 12.566) + 0.1 * u4 * u4
tx = math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 12.566) * sx * 0.04 * (1 - u4)
tr = math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 9.4) * 2.6 * K.INT * (1 - u4) + 16 * u4 ^ 3
end
local hk2 = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 0.7 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk2
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk2
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk2
local kd = ex(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * ex(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
S.bgT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.3 * S.blk),
S.bgB:Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.1 * S.pulse):Lerp(BLACK, 0.8 * S.blk)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * (mode > 1 and 1 or 0.4) - 0.18 * S.lv, 0.4, 1)
S.starK = S.starK * ex(-4 * dt)
local starOn = ((mode == 1) and clamp01((t - 0.4) / 5) or 1) * ((mode == 3 and 1.3) or (mode == 1 and 0.8) or 0.55)
local starCol = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.3)
for _, s in ipairs(E.stars) do
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * s.sp + s.ph)
s.f.Position = UDim2.new(s.x, -cx * s.z * 0.25, s.y, -cy * s.z * 0.15)
s.f.BackgroundColor3 = starCol
s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(starOn * s.a * (0.2 + 0.8 * tw) + 0.5 * S.starK * tw)
end
local cityT = (mode == 1 and 1.5) or ((mode == 3) and (1.12 - 0.12 * ur) or 1)
local cyS = follow("city", cityT, 7, 0.75, dt, 1.5)
E.ground.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, cyS)
for _, b in ipairs(E.bld) do
b.f.Position = UDim2.new(b.x, -cx * b.z * 0.12, cyS - 0.008 * S.hk * (0.5 + b.z), 0)
b.rim.BackgroundColor3 = col
b.rim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + 0.4 * (1 - S.lv)
end
for _, wd in ipairs(E.win) do
wd.fl = wd.fl * ex(-5 * dt)
local want = 1
if S.winOn and (t - S.winT) >= wd.d then
want = math.clamp(0.5 - 0.5 * wd.fl - 0.12 * S.lv + (wd.hot and 0 or 0.15) + 0.8 * S.cutK, 0.05, 1)
end
if math.abs(want - wd.tr) > 0.02 then
wd.tr = want
wd.f.BackgroundTransparency = want
wd.f.BackgroundColor3 = wd.hot and ICE or col
end
end
local rainOn = clamp01((t - 0.8) / 3)
for _, r in ipairs(E.rain) do
r.y = (r.y + dt * S.ts * (0.5 + 1.6 * S.lv) * r.z * 0.9) % 1
r.fl = r.fl * ex(-6 * dt)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(r.x * 1.4 - 0.2, -cx * r.z * 0.2, r.y * 1.4 - 0.2, 0)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.th, r.len * (0.6 + S.lv))
r.f.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, math.clamp(0.9 - 0.3 * S.lv - 0.25 * S.rainK - 0.55 * r.fl, 0.2, 1) + (1 - rainOn))
end
local ec0 = hsz * 0.18
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do
c.len = lerp(c.len, c.tgt, 1 - ex(-14 * dt))
if mode == 4 then c.tgt = c.tgt * ex(-1.5 * dt) end
local show = c.len > 3 and (mode == 2 or mode == 4)
c.f.Visible = show
if show then
local d = ec0 + c.len * 0.5
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(c.a) * d, 0.5, ey + math.sin(c.a) * d)
c.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(c.len, c.w)
c.f.Rotation = math.deg(c.a)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.2 + 0.35 * (1 - S.pulse), 0.1, 0.9)
end
end
for _, m in ipairs(E.minis) do
local vis = (mode == 4)
m.f.Visible = vis
if vis then
local a = m.a + ((t - M3) / (K.BAR * 2.2) + 0.2) * 6.283
local R = math.min(sy * 0.4, sx * 0.44) * (1 + 0.1 * S.hk) * (1 - 0.8 * u4 * u4)
local kk = 1 - ex(-7 * dt)
local sa = math.sin(a)
m.x, m.y = lerp(m.x, math.cos(a) * R, kk), lerp(m.y, ey + sa * R * 0.55, kk)
local sz = sy * m.rk * 2 * (1 + 0.22 * sa) * (1 + 0.3 * S.hk) * (1 - 0.7 * u4 ^ 3)
m.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, m.x, 0.5, m.y)
m.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
m.f.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2 + m.ph) * 12
m.f.ZIndex = (sa < 0) and 8 or 14
m.gl.BackgroundColor3 = col
m.gl.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.88 - 0.2 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.5, 1)
paint(m.rim, col, 0)
paint(m.dark, darkC, 0)
end
end
do
local ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.34, 0.6
if mode == 3 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.33, 0.5
elseif mode == 4 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.31, (0.9 + 0.1 * math.min(1, (t - M3) / K.BAR)) * (1 - 0.5 * u4)
end
local tyy = follow("ty", ty3, 9, 0.7, dt, -sy * 0.34)
local tss = follow("tsc", ts3, 9, 0.62, dt, 0.4)
local want = ""
if mode == 2 and t >= MIL[1] then
local n = math.clamp(math.floor((t - MIL[1]) / K.BEAT) + 1, 1, #HERO)
want = HERO:sub(1, n) .. (HERO:sub(n + 1):gsub("%S", "-"))
elseif mode == 3 then
want = HERO
elseif mode == 4 then
want = scr(HERO, (t - M3) / (K.BEAT * 1.2))
end
if want == "" or want == HERO or mode == 2 then
if S.hero ~= want then
S.hero = want
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
else
S.hero = ""
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
E.tF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy)
E.tS.Scale = math.max(0.05, tss * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse))
S.chroma = S.chroma * ex(-5 * dt)
local ch = S.chroma + (mode == 4 and 18 * u4 or 0)
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ch, 0.5, ch * 0.25), UDim2.new(0.5, -ch, 0.5, -ch * 0.25)
if want == "" then
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1
elseif mode == 3 then
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1
E.tM.TextTransparency = inCut and 1 or math.clamp(0.74 + 0.18 * math.sin(t * 3), 0.5, 1)
else
local ca = math.clamp(1 - ch / 16, 0.25, 1)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = ca, ca
E.tM.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.14 - 0.1 * S.pulse + (mode == 4 and 0.8 * u4 * u4 or 0), 0, 1)
end
E.tM.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.18)
E.sub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy + sy * 0.1)
E.sub.TextColor3 = col
if mode == 4 and t >= MIL[3] then
E.sub.Text = scr(NAME, (t - MIL[3]) / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
E.sub.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.25 + u4, 0, 1)
elseif (mode == 2 and t >= MIL[1]) or mode == 4 then
E.sub.Text = SUB
E.sub.TextTransparency = 0.35
else
E.sub.TextTransparency = 1
end

if S.capTxt ~= "" and ca < 1.5 then
E.cap.Text = scr(S.capTxt, ca / 0.28)
E.cap.TextColor3 = col
E.cap.TextTransparency = ca < 1.0 and (0.05 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 40)) or clamp01((ca - 1.0) / 0.5)
E.cap.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.noise(t * 30, seed) * 6) * (1 - clamp01(ca / 0.28)), 0.5, ey - (hsz * 0.55 + sy * 0.06))
elseif E.cap.TextTransparency < 1 then
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
E.streak.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
E.streak.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * (0.6 + 0.9 * S.sk), 2 + 2 * S.sk)
E.streak.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.4)
E.streak.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - 0.85 * S.sk, 0.1, 1)
end

f.Visible = show
if show then
local cw = math.clamp(math.min(sx * 0.62, sy * 1.5), 220, 460)
local side = (i % 2 == 1) and -1 or 1
local uin, uout = clamp01((t - w0) / (K.BEAT * 0.9)), clamp01((t - (w1 - K.BEAT * 0.7)) / (K.BEAT * 0.7))
local ex0 = side * (sx * 0.5 + cw)

f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, cw * 0.36)
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, sy * 0.3 + math.sin(t * 2 + i) * sy * 0.004)
f.Rotation = (1 - uin) * side * 6 + S.rk * 0.5
end
end
local vt = math.clamp((mode == 1 and 0.5 or (mode == 3 and 0.3 or 0.34)) - 0.3 * S.hk - 0.08 * S.lv, 0.05, 0.8)
for _, vf in ipairs(E.vig) do vf.BackgroundTransparency = vt end
local barT = (mode == 1 and 0.12) or (mode == 3 and 0.14) or (0.065 + 0.08 * u4)
local bhh = follow("bar", CFG.IntroScan and sy * barT or 0, 8, 0.8, dt, 0)

E.ms.Text = modStatus()
E.tc.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 0)) or 1
E.np.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 1)) or 1
E.ms.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 2)) or 1
for _, l in ipairs({E.tc, E.np, E.ms}) do l.TextColor3 = col end
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3 + math.floor(S.pulse * 2))
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.skipS.Color, E.skip.TextColor3 = col, col
E.skipS.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3)
if mode == 1 then
local L = {
"> LIL_PEEP.EXE  LOADING", "> RAIN  ON", "> NIGHT  MODE  ENABLED", "> HEARTBEAT  " .. string.format("%d", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 124) + 0.5)) .. " BPM",
"> " .. modStatus(), "> SOMETHING  IS  COMING",
}
local out = {}
for i, ln in ipairs(L) do
if bt >= 1 + (i - 1) * 2 then out[#out + 1] = scr(ln, (bt - 1 - (i - 1) * 2) / 1.4) end
end
if bt >= 12 then out[#out + 1] = "> DROP IN " .. (16 - beatIdx) end
E.term.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
E.term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.035), 12, 20)
E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)
E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then
E.term.Text = ""
end
S.flashK = S.flashK * ex(-9 * dt)
S.blk = S.blk * ex(-4 * dt)
local fa = clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen)
local flashA = math.max(fa, math.min(0.85, S.flashK))
if mode == 3 and t >= B(26) then
flashA = math.max(flashA, 0.18 * S.pulse * clamp01((t - B(26)) / (2 * K.BAR)) * K.INT)
end
local blackA = math.max(1 - clamp01(t / (K.BEAT * 3)), S.blk)
if flashA >= 0.05 then
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 1 - blackA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 4 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false

Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})

FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)

end)
return true
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function eob(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function kick(key, v)
local st = S.sp[key]
if st then st[2] = st[2] + v end
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 7)
end
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0,
ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function seq(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false, trl = -1}
end

local function ringSlot(list)
local best = list[1]
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if not r.on then return r end
if r.t0 < best.t0 then best = r end
end
return best
end
local function ringGo(r, x, y, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, follow, rel)
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.rad0, r.rad1, r.rev, r.tilt0, r.tilt1, r.follow, r.rel = true, S.t, life, x, y, rad0, rad1, rev, tilt0 or 0, tilt1 or 0, follow, rel
r.c.Visible = true
r.trl = -1
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
end
local function flat(x, y, w, life, col, rel)
ringGo(ringSlot(E.flat), x, y, w * 0.08, w, life, col, false, 0, 0, false, rel)
end
local function orbit(rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1)
if not rev then
if S.t - S.lastRing < 0.3 then return end
S.lastRing = S.t
end
ringGo(ringSlot(E.orbR), 0, 0, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, true, false)
end
local function bubble(x, y, r, vy)
for _, b in ipairs(E.bub) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.x, b.y, b.r, b.vy, b.ph, b.wob = true, x, y, r, vy, math.random() * 6.28, 6 + math.random() * 14
b.f.Visible = true
b.s.Color = accent()
return
end
end
end
local function crown(n, x, y, spd, rel, col)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, c in ipairs(E.crown) do
if not c.on then
local a = -math.pi / 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.9
local v = spd * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.6)
c.on, c.x, c.y, c.vx, c.vy, c.sz, c.rel, c.age = true, x, y, math.cos(a) * v, math.sin(a) * v, 3 + math.random() * 5, rel, 0
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
c.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function drip(x, y)
for _, d in ipairs(E.drip) do
if not d.on then
d.on, d.x, d.y, d.vy = true, x, y, 0
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = accent()
d.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function glint(x, y)
for _, g in ipairs(E.glint) do
if not g.on then
g.on, g.x, g.y, g.t0, g.w = true, x, y, S.t, 10 + math.random() * 30
g.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function updRings(list, t)
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.c.Visible = false
else
local e = r.rev and (u * u) or eo3(u)
local rad = r.rad0 + (r.rad1 - r.rad0) * e
local tr = r.rev and (0.85 - 0.75 * u) or (0.1 + 0.9 * u)
local cx, cy = r.x, r.y
if r.follow then
cx, cy = S.ox, S.oy
elseif r.rel then
cy = cy + (S.surfPx - S.sy * 0.64)
end
local W = rad / 0.46
r.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
r.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, W * r.ratio)
r.c.Rotation = lerp(r.tilt0, r.tilt1, u)
if math.abs(r.trl - tr) > 0.02 then
r.trl = tr
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
end
end
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function curTideTop(t)
if t < M5 then return 1.4 end
local pts = {{M5, 0.8}, {M6, 0.66}, {M7, 0.54}, {M8, 0.4}, {M9, -0.4}}
for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
if t < pts[i + 1][1] then
return lerp(pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][2], smooth(clamp01((t - pts[i][1]) / (pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1]))))
end
end
return -0.4
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.95 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK = 1, 1, 1
local sxm, sy0 = sx * 0.5, sy * 0.64
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 1.1, 2.2, WHITE, true)
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 0.62, 1.6, col, true)
orbit(S.R * 0.6, S.R * 7, 1.8, WHITE, false, 0, 30)
crown(14, sxm, sy0, sy * 1.15, true, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 12 do
bubble(sxm + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.3, sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.4), 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.25))
end
E.term.Text = ""
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.6, 0.8)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.9) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.12 * I)
orbit(S.R * 0.8, S.R * 4.5, 1.6, col, false, -10, 20)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.04 * I
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.34 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK, S.ts, S.surge = 1, 1, 1, 1, 1
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 5.5, 1.5, col, false, 0, 40)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 8.5, 1.9, WHITE, false, 10, -30)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 3.6, 1.1, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), false, -20, 50)
crown(12, S.ox, S.oy, sy * 0.9, false, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 10 do
bubble(sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), sy * 1.05, 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.4))
end
S.sp.tide = {1.25, 0}
S.sp.rail = {0.2, 0}
itick(0.55, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.8) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 14, 380, 0.9) end
elseif m == 6 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.4 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.2 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1, S.R * 6, 1.4, col, false, 0, -35)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.7) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 10, 320, 0.8) end
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.06 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1.2, S.R * 9, 2.0, WHITE, false, 0, 25)
itick(0.8, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.35)
S.aura = math.max(S.aura, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.4)
if mode == 1 then
S.hz = math.max(S.hz, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
return
end
if mode == 4 then
for _, h in ipairs(REV) do
if math.abs(t - h) < 0.1 then
S.pk = S.pk + 1
kick("sq", 3.4)
S.vizK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.14 * I)
S.aura = 1
orbit(S.R * 0.5, S.R * 2.6, 0.9, accent(), false, 15, 35)
itick(1 + 0.16 * S.pk, 0.9)
return
end
end
return
end
kick("sq", k == 2 and 2.2 or 0.9)
S.vizK = math.min(1, S.vizK + (k == 2 and 0.6 or 0.25))
if mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then

th.tp, th.ap = t, sy * (k == 2 and 0.09 or 0.04)
end

S.shake = S.shake + 3 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.014 * I
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)

drip(L.x, L.y + S.tsz * 0.4)
end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, accent(), 5, 240, 0.5) end
end
if mode ~= 8 then orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * (3.4 + math.random() * 1.8), 1.1, accent(), false, math.random(-35, 35), math.random(-35, 35)) end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
S.noteK = 1
if mode == 2 or mode == 3 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
local a = math.random() * 6.283
bubble(S.ox + math.cos(a) * S.R * 0.9, S.oy + math.sin(a) * S.R * 0.9, 4 + math.random() * 10, S.sy * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.14))
end
elseif mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
bubble(S.sx * (0.05 + math.random() * 0.9), S.sy * (S.tide + 0.04), 4 + math.random() * 9, S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if mode == 1 then
glint(S.sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), S.sy * (0.66 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end

for j, L in ipairs(E.tide) do
local tcol = (j == 1 and col:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55)) or (j == 2 and col:Lerp(BLACK, 0.3)) or col
local ttr = (j == 1 and 0.4) or (j == 2 and 0.5) or 0.58
local n = #L.cols
local cw = sx * 1.5 / n + 2
for i, f in ipairs(L.cols) do
f.Visible = tideOn
if tideOn then
local x = sx * (-0.25 + 1.5 * (i - 0.5) / n)
local y = tidePx + (j - 2) * sy * 0.03 + amp * (math.sin(x / sx * 7 + vt * (1 + 0.4 * j) + j) + 0.5 * math.sin(x / sx * 15 - vt * 1.9 + j * 2))
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, sy * 1.4)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, sy * 1.4 - y)
f.BackgroundColor3 = tcol
f.BackgroundTransparency = ttr
end
end
end
for _, d in ipairs(E.drip) do
if d.on then
d.vy = d.vy + sy * 1.4 * dt
d.y = d.y + d.vy * dt
local ground = math.max(tidePx, 0)
if d.y >= ground or d.y > sy * 1.2 then
d.on = false
d.f.Visible = false
if tideOn and tidePx < sy then flat(d.x, tidePx, sx * 0.14, 1.1, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), false) end
else
d.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(d.x, d.y)
d.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 8 + d.vy * 0.04)
end
end
end
local ts = math.max(20, math.min(sx * 0.072, sy * 0.15))
S.tsz = ts
local pitch = ts * 0.78
local titleY = sy * 0.7
local nCh = #TITLE
for _, L in ipairs(E.letters) do
local u = clamp01((t - TT - L.ci * 0.055) / 0.55)
local ex = clamp01((t - M8 - L.ci * 0.045) / 0.6)
local x = sx * 0.5 + (L.ci - (nCh + 1) / 2) * pitch
local y = titleY - (1 - eob(u)) * ts * 2.2 + math.sin(vt * 2.1 + L.ci * 0.62) * ts * 0.045 + ex * ex * sy * 0.5
local bulge = 0
local bd = t - S.bulgeT - L.ci * 0.03
if bd > 0 then bulge = math.exp(-bd * 7) end
L.x, L.y = x, y
local alpha = smooth(clamp01(u * 1.6)) * (1 - ex)
L.f.Visible = alpha > 0.01
if alpha > 0.01 then
L.f.TextSize = ts
L.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ts * 1.1, ts * 1.3)
L.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
L.f.TextTransparency = 1 - alpha
L.f.TextStrokeColor3 = col:Lerp(BLACK, 0.6)
L.f.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - alpha * 0.65
L.us.Scale = (0.5 + 0.5 * eob(u)) * (1 + 0.2 * bulge + 0.04 * S.pulse)
L.f.Rotation = math.sin(vt * 1.7 + L.ci) * 1.2 + (1 - eob(u)) * 14 * ((L.ci % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1)
end
end
local subA = clamp01((t - TT - 1.2) / 0.6) * (1 - clamp01((t - M8) / 0.5))
E.sub.Visible = subA > 0.01
if subA > 0.01 then
E.sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, titleY + ts * 0.95)
E.sub.TextSize = math.max(11, math.min(16, sx * 0.012))
E.sub.Text = scr(SUB, (t - TT - 1.2) / 0.8)
E.sub.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
E.sub.TextTransparency = 0.25 + (1 - subA) * 0.75
end
local nameA = clamp01((t - (M8 + 0.45 * (M9 - M8))) / 0.8) * (1 - 0.4 * u9)
E.name.Visible = nameA > 0.01
E.nameSub.Visible = nameA > 0.01
if nameA > 0.01 then
local nt = math.max(20, math.min(sx * 0.075, sy * 0.16, sx * 0.9 / (#NAME * 0.78)))
E.name.TextSize = nt
E.name.Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, nt * 1.3)
E.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5 + math.sin(vt * 2) * nt * 0.03)
E.name.Text = scr(NAME, (t - (M8 + 0.45 * (M9 - M8))) / 0.7)
E.name.TextTransparency = 1 - nameA
E.nameSub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5 + nt * 0.95)
E.nameSub.TextSize = math.max(11, math.min(16, sx * 0.012))
E.nameSub.Text = "L I Q U I D   S M O O T H"
E.nameSub.TextTransparency = 1 - nameA * 0.9
end
while CAPS[S.capI + 1] and CAPS[S.capI + 1][1] <= t do
S.capI = S.capI + 1
if t - CAPS[S.capI][1] < 0.5 then
S.capT, S.capTxt = CAPS[S.capI][1], CAPS[S.capI][2]
itick(1.5, 0.45)
end
end
local ca = t - S.capT
if ca >= 0 and ca < 2.8 then
local fa = clamp01(ca / 0.35) * (1 - clamp01((ca - 2.2) / 0.6))
E.cap.Visible = true
E.cap.TextSize = math.max(16, math.min(sy * 0.034, sx * 0.045))
E.cap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.17 - (1 - eo3(clamp01(ca / 0.8))) * sy * 0.02)
E.cap.Text = scr(S.capTxt, ca / 0.4)
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - fa * 0.92
E.cap.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6)
else
E.cap.Visible = false
end
local vigT = (mode == 1 and 0.5) or (mode == 2 and 0.2) or (mode == 3 and 0.6) or (mode == 4 and 1) or (mode == 8 and 0) or 0.25
S.vigK = lerp(S.vigK or 0.5, vigT, 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt))
for _, f in ipairs(E.vig) do
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.25 + 0.55 * S.vigK)
end
local barT = (mode == 1 and 0.075) or (mode == 3 and 0.045) or (mode == 4 and 0.13) or 0
local bh = follow("bar", sy * barT, 6, 0.9, dt, 0)
E.barT.Size, E.barB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(0, bh)), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(0, bh))
local dipK = (mode == 1) and clamp01((t - (M2 - K.BEAT)) / K.BEAT) * 0.55 or 0
E.dip.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - dipK
local endK = smooth(clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen))
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, endK)
E.flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, fk)
local hudOn = CFG.IntroHud ~= false
local h1 = hudOn and clamp01(1 - rv(t, 1)) or 0
local fade = 1 - endK
E.tc.Visible, E.np.Visible, E.ms.Visible, E.prog.Visible = hudOn, hudOn, hudOn, hudOn
if hudOn then
local hc = col:Lerp(mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE, 0.55)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 28   111 BPM", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(28, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3, E.ms.TextColor3 = hc, hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - h1 * fade) * 0.65
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  MITSKI - LIQUID SMOOTH (INSTRUMENTAL)"
E.np.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - clamp01(1 - rv(t, 2)) * fade) * 0.55
if t - S.msT > 0.5 then
S.msT = t
S.ms = modStatus()
end
E.ms.Text = S.ms
E.ms.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - clamp01(1 - rv(t, 3)) * fade) * 0.55
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.prog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
end
E.term.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
E.term.TextTransparency = mode == 1 and 0.25 or 1
E.skip.TextColor3 = mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE
E.skip.BackgroundColor3 = mode == 8 and WHITE or BLACK
E.skipS.Color = mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 5 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end
