local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM, FOOT = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim), parse(D.foot)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local sw0 = Util.GetScreenSize()
local U0 = math.min(sw0.X, sw0.Y)
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function seq3(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false}
end

local function ringE(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringE[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringE) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.c.Visible = true
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local function ringC(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringC[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringC) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.f.Visible = true
r.s.Color = col
end
local function eye(x, y, sz, col)
if S.t - S.lastEye < 0.25 then return end
for _, e in ipairs(E.eye) do
if not e.on then
e.on, e.t0, e.life, e.x, e.y, e.sz, e.ph = true, S.t, 2.6 + math.random() * 1.6, x, y, sz, math.random() * 3
e.c.Visible = true
for s = 1, 2 do
e.pair[s].g.BackgroundColor3 = col
e.pair[s].e.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
end
S.lastEye = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function bat(dirn)
if S.t - S.lastBat < 0.12 then return end
for _, b in ipairs(E.bat) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.t0, b.life, b.dir = true, S.t, 3.6 + math.random() * 1.4, dirn or (math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1)
b.x0 = b.dir > 0 and -S.sx * 0.05 or S.sx * 1.05
b.y0 = S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.4)
b.sp = S.sx * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.16)
b.sc = 0.7 + math.random() * 0.9
b.ph = math.random() * 6.28
b.c.Visible = true
S.lastBat = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function seg(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 2, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function bolt(xf, power)
local b = E.bolt[1].on and E.bolt[2] or E.bolt[1]
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local pts, x, y = {}, sx * xf, -sy * 0.05
local step = (sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.1)) / 7
for i = 1, 8 do
pts[i] = {x, y}
x = x + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.09
y = y + step
end
local n = 0
for i = 1, 7 do
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2], 3 + 3 * power)
end
local bx, by = pts[4][1], pts[4][2]
for _ = 1, 4 do
local nx, ny = bx + (math.random() - 0.3) * sx * 0.07, by + step * 0.8
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], bx, by, nx, ny, 2)
bx, by = nx, ny
end
b.on, b.t0, b.n = true, S.t, n
end
local function doStrike(st)
local I = K.INT
bolt((st == M5 or st == M7) and 0.5 or (0.15 + math.random() * 0.7), 1)
S.boltK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
itick(0.35, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.03, 0.5) end
end
local HB0, HBP = 17.64, K.BEAT * 2
local function slam(i, col)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.glitch = 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.09 * K.INT
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.16 * K.INT)
S.pulse = 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.48, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.05, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.55, 0.6, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2))
itick(0.6 + 0.07 * i, 1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.03, 0.4) end
if i == 4 or i == 8 then
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3), 12, 340, 0.8) end
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.kickK = math.max(S.kickK, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.moonK = math.max(S.moonK, 0.6 * k)
for _, tb in ipairs(E.tomb) do tb.bounce = 1 end
if k == 2 then
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.08, math.min(sx, sy) * 1.1, 0.9, accent())
itick(0.5, 0.6)
end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
if mode == 4 then
S.noteK = 1
S.ember = 1
if k == 2 then bat() end
elseif mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, k == 2 and 0.8 or 0.3)
S.noteK = 1
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if (mode == 5 or mode == 6) and k == 2 and math.random() < 0.3 then bat() end
end
local function footHit(i)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.02 * K.INT
S.rk = S.rk + (i % 2 == 0 and 0.7 or -0.7) * K.INT
ringE(sx * (0.35 + 0.3 * (i % 2)), sy * 0.9, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.03, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.4, 0.8, accent())
itick(0.55, 0.9)
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = TERM[2 + i] or "> STEP"
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = BONE
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 12 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 3 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5, U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.9, BONE)
bat(1)
itick(0.45, 1.2)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.15 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * I
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.2 * I)
S.rk = S.rk - 2 * I
bat(-1)
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.38 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.pulse, S.moonK, S.ts = 1, 1, 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.04, 0.9) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4), 16, 420, 1.0) end
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.22 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 9 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.4, 1.0, col)
bat(1)
bat(-1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.05, 0.7) end
elseif m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.6 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.1 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I
itick(0.4, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.05, 0.9) end
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.32, U * 0.2, U * 1.0, 1.4, PA[8])
itick(0.8, 0.8)
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I = K.INT
local mode = (t < M2 and 1) or (t < M3 and 2) or (t < M4 and 3) or (t < M5 and 4) or (t < M6 and 5) or (t < M7 and 6) or (t < M8 and 7) or 8
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(PA[mode], ck)
S.mm = S.mm:Lerp(PM[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(PB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
S.vt = S.vt + dt
local vt = S.vt
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
local lv = S.lv
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = (beatIdx % 4 == 0)
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 0.8 or 0.4)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
S.shake = S.shake + (down and 4 or 2) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
itick(down and 1.4 or 1.0, 0.3)
elseif mode == 1 then
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and beatIdx > 0 then itick(0.5, 0.25) end
local line = (beatIdx == 1 and TERM[1]) or (beatIdx == 8 and TERM[2]) or nil
if line then
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = line
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
end
end
if t >= HB0 and mode >= 3 and mode <= 4 then
local hb = math.floor((t - HB0) / HBP)
if hb ~= S.hbI then
S.hbI = hb
S.pulse, S.moonK = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.035 * I
S.dubT = t + 0.2
itick(0.4, 1.1)
if mode == 3 then
eye(sx * (0.08 + math.random() * 0.84), sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.2), U * 0.03, col)
end
end
if S.dubT and t >= S.dubT then
S.dubT = nil
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.7)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.018 * I
itick(0.3, 0.9)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local ev = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then bassHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while NOTE[S.noteI] and NOTE[S.noteI][1] <= t do
local ev = NOTE[S.noteI]
S.noteI = S.noteI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then noteHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while SHIM[S.shimI] and SHIM[S.shimI][1] <= t do
local ev = SHIM[S.shimI]
S.shimI = S.shimI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then shimHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while FOOT[S.footI] and FOOT[S.footI][1] <= t do
local ev = FOOT[S.footI]
local i = S.footI
S.footI = S.footI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.4 then footHit(i) end
end
while STRIKES[S.strikeI] and STRIKES[S.strikeI] <= t do
local st = STRIKES[S.strikeI]
S.strikeI = S.strikeI + 1
if t - st < 0.3 then doStrike(st) end
end
for i, L in ipairs(E.letters) do
if not L.hit and t >= L.lt and t - L.lt < 0.5 then
L.hit = true
slam(i, col)
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-4.2 * dt)
S.moonK = S.moonK * math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.xk = S.xk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.yk = S.yk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-3.4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.boltK = S.boltK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.shim = S.shim * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.noteK = S.noteK * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.glitch = S.glitch * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.kickK = S.kickK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.ember = S.ember * math.exp(-8 * dt)
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u4 = clamp01((t - M4) / (M5 - M4))
local u7 = clamp01((t - M7) / (M8 - M7))
local pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, 0, 0, 1
if mode == 1 then
pxT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.004, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * 0.5, 1 + 0.1 * smooth(u1)
elseif mode == 2 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.9) * sx * 0.006, math.sin(vt * 3.1) * sy * 0.004, math.sin(vt * 1.5) * 0.8, 1.1 + 0.08 * clamp01((t - M2) / (M3 - M2))
elseif mode == 3 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.35) * sx * 0.012, math.sin(vt * 0.27) * sy * 0.008, math.sin(vt * 0.3) * 1.2, 1.18
elseif mode == 4 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.6) * sx * 0.02 * (0.3 + u4), math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sy * 0.01, math.sin(vt * 0.9) * (1 + 3 * u4), 1.14 + 0.22 * u4 * u4
S.shake = S.shake + lv * 0.5 * (0.3 + u4)
elseif mode == 5 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.sin(vt * 0.5) * sx * 0.015, 0, math.sin(vt * 1.1) * 1.8, 1.12
elseif mode == 6 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = math.cos(vt * 0.55) * sx * 0.05, math.sin(vt * 0.4) * sy * 0.02, math.sin(vt * 0.5) * 4.5, 1.1 + 0.04 * math.sin(vt * 0.4)
elseif mode == 7 then
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, -sy * 0.02 * u7, 7 * smooth(u7), 1.1 - 0.14 * smooth(u7)
else
local u8 = clamp01((t - M8) / (K.DUR - M8))
pxT, pyT, rollT, zT = 0, 0, 7 * (1 - smooth(clamp01((t - M8) / (K.BAR * 0.8)))), 0.96 + 0.16 * smooth(u8)
end
local shk = S.shake
local cx = follow("cx", (pxT + S.xk) * I + (math.random() - 0.5) * shk, 5, 0.85, dt, 0)
local cy = follow("cy", (pyT + S.yk) * I + (math.random() - 0.5) * shk, 5, 0.85, dt, 0)
local cr = follow("cr", rollT * I + S.rk, 5, 0.8, dt, 0)
local cz = follow("cz", zT + S.zk, 6, 0.8, dt, 1)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx, 0.5, cy)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = cz
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(S.bgT:Lerp(C(120, 150, 200), S.boltK * 0.5), S.bgB:Lerp(C(150, 180, 220), S.boltK * 0.5))
E.skyFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - S.boltK * 0.4
for _, s in ipairs(E.star) do
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(vt * s.sp + s.ph)
s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + 0.6 * tw
s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s.sz + S.shim * 1.5, s.sz + S.shim * 1.5)
end
local moonY = lerp(0.62, 0.3, smooth(clamp01(t / M4)))
local R = U * (0.17 + 0.13 * smooth(clamp01(t / M5)))
local mS = 2 * R * (1 + 0.05 * S.moonK + 0.015 * lv)
E.moonC.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, moonY)
E.moonC.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mS, mS)
E.moon.BackgroundColor3 = S.mm
for i, h in ipairs(E.halo) do
h.BackgroundColor3 = col
h.BackgroundTransparency = 0.95 - 0.04 * i * 0.3 - 0.06 * S.moonK - 0.04 * lv
end
local shx = 1.6
if t >= M7 and t < M8 then
shx = lerp(1.5, 0.12, smooth(clamp01((t - M7) / (M8 - M7))))
elseif t >= M8 then
local es = B(30.4)
shx = lerp(0.12, -1.6, smooth(clamp01((t - es) / (K.DUR - es))))
end
E.shade.Position = UDim2.fromScale(shx, 0.5)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cloud) do
local x = ((c.b + vt * c.sp) % 1.6) - 0.3
c.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, c.y)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + 0.4 * S.boltK
end
local fogK = ({0.2, 0.4, 0.45, 0.7 + lv * 0.3, 0.3, 0.32, 0.6, 0.5})[mode]
local fogC = C(140, 170, 160):Lerp(col, mode == 4 and 0.45 or 0.2)
for i, f in ipairs(E.fog) do
f.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.sin(vt * 0.12 + f.ph) * 0.08, f.y + math.sin(vt * 0.3 + f.ph) * 0.01)
f.f.BackgroundColor3 = fogC
f.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fogK * (0.35 + 0.2 * i) * (0.8 + 0.6 * S.ember))
end
local gcol = C(14, 20, 20):Lerp(C(70, 90, 110), S.boltK * 0.5)
E.ground.BackgroundColor3 = gcol:Lerp(col, 0.06 * S.kickK)
for _, tb in ipairs(E.tomb) do
local target = (t >= tb.t0) and 1 or 0
tb.r = lerp(tb.r, target, 1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
tb.bounce = tb.bounce * math.exp(-9 * dt)
if tb.r < 0.01 then
tb.c.Visible = false
else
local w = tb.w
local rise = 1 - eo3(clamp01(tb.r))
tb.c.Visible = true
tb.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, w * 1.5)
tb.c.Position = UDim2.new(tb.x, 0, tb.y, rise * w * 1.8 - tb.bounce * w * 0.1)

end

if t < M2 + 0.05 then
local open1 = smooth(clamp01((t - 0.8) / 6.2))

local wh = 0.22 + open1 * 0.42
local e = eio(clamp01((t - B(3.5)) / (M2 - B(3.5))))
ww, wh = lerp(ww, 1.2, e), lerp(wh, 1.2, e)
local l, r, tp, bt = 0.5 - ww / 2, 0.5 + ww / 2, 0.5 - wh / 2, 0.5 + wh / 2
E.pan[1].Position, E.pan[1].Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, math.max(0, tp))
E.pan[2].Position, E.pan[2].Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, math.min(1, bt)), UDim2.fromScale(1, math.max(0, 1 - bt))
E.pan[3].Position, E.pan[3].Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, math.max(0, tp)), UDim2.fromScale(math.max(0, l), math.min(1, wh))
E.pan[4].Position, E.pan[4].Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.min(1, r), math.max(0, tp)), UDim2.fromScale(math.max(0, 1 - r), math.min(1, wh))
for _, p in ipairs(E.pan) do p.Visible = true end
E.bloom.Visible, E.spill.Visible, E.rim.Visible = true, true, true
E.bloom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ww * 1.7 + 0.08, wh * 1.1)
E.bloom.BackgroundColor3 = S.mm
E.bloom.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(0.07 + 0.22 * lv + 0.25 * open1)
E.spill.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + wh / 2)
E.spill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ww * 1.25 + 0.04, 0.2 + 0.1 * open1)
E.spill.BackgroundColor3 = S.mm
E.spill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 - 0.3 * open1
E.rim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ww + 0.006, wh + 0.01)
E.rimS.Color = S.mm
E.rimS.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * e
else
for _, p in ipairs(E.pan) do p.Visible = false end
E.bloom.Visible, E.spill.Visible, E.rim.Visible = false, false, false
end
for _, ey in ipairs(E.eye) do
if ey.on then
local age = t - ey.t0
local open = smooth(clamp01(age / 0.25)) * (1 - smooth(clamp01((age - ey.life) / 0.4)))
local ph = age * 1.3 + ey.ph
if math.floor(ph) % 4 == 3 and ph % 1 < 0.12 then open = 0 end
if age > ey.life + 0.45 then
ey.on = false
ey.c.Visible = false
else
ey.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ey.x, ey.y)
ey.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ey.sz * 2.4, ey.sz * 0.8 * math.max(0.02, open))

ey.pair[s].e.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - open
end
end
end
end
for _, b in ipairs(E.bat) do
if b.on then
local age = t - b.t0

local y = b.y0 + math.sin(age * 3 + b.ph) * sy * 0.035 - age * sy * 0.012

b.on = false
b.c.Visible = false
else
local flap = math.sin(vt * (17 + 9 * S.shim) + b.ph)

b.body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7 * b.sc, 11 * b.sc)

for _, b in ipairs(E.bolt) do

b.on = false

for j = 1, #b.segs do b.segs[j].Visible = false end
end
end

for _, r in ipairs(E.ringE) do

r.on = false
r.c.Visible = false
else

r.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rad * 2, rad * 2 * r.ratio)

end

for _, r in ipairs(E.ringC) do

local k = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if k >= 1 then
r.on = false

else

for _, d in ipairs(E.dust) do

local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, VOX, LEVEL = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), {}, D.level

local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then

end

end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end

end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 10.7666
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

end
end)

local function ell(par, cx, cy, w, h, col, rot, z, o, rad)

local function bar(par, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, o)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
return ell(par, (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th, th, col, math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)), z, o)
end
local function space(par, sgn, cx, cy, size, psize, z)
local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + sgn * cx / psize, 0.5 + cy / psize), Size = UDim2.fromScale(size / psize, size / psize), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
return {g = f, s = sgn, z = size}
end
local function sEll(sp, dx, dy, w, h, col, rot, z, o, rad)
return ell(sp.g, 0.5 + sp.s * dx / sp.z, 0.5 + dy / sp.z, w / sp.z, h / sp.z, col, (rot or 0) * sp.s, z, o, rad)
end
local function sBar(sp, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, o)
return bar(sp.g, 0.5 + sp.s * x1 / sp.z, 0.5 + y1 / sp.z, 0.5 + sp.s * x2 / sp.z, 0.5 + y2 / sp.z, th / sp.z, col, z, o)
end

end

sEll(A, 0, 0, 0.21, 0.2, EB2, 0, 16, 6)

local ang, len = {-30, -13, 4, 20, 38}, {0.13, 0.17, 0.19, 0.17, 0.13}
for i = 1, 5 do

sBar(F, 0.02, -0.19, 0.02 + len[i] * math.sin(a), -0.19 - len[i] * math.cos(a), 0.04, (i % 2 == 0) and EB2 or EBk, 16, 6)

end
local H = space(R.g, 1, 0, -0.14, 0.5, 1, 20)
E.head = H.g

sBar(H, -0.03, -0.105, -0.115, -0.24, 0.115, EPk, 21, 8)

sBar(H, 0.09, -0.155, 0.012, -0.12, 0.02, BLACK, 23, 8)

end
E.cr = {}
for i = 1, 14 do

f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
f.Rotation = i * 25.7 + (i % 3) * 7
f.Visible = false
E.cr[i] = f

E.rg = {}

f.Visible = false
end

for i = 1, 22 do
local f = box(stage, 9, nil, WHITE, 1)
f.Rotation = 45
f.Visible = false

E.lbT = box(stage, 12, Vector2.new(0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.lbT.Position, E.lbT.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)

do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 7, M, K, 3) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
E.tc, E.np = hud(14, 21), hud(34, 21)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = ""})
E.prog = box(stage, 22, Vector2.new(0, 1), WHITE, 0.2)

mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)

end
local function spark(col)
local q = E.sp[1]
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if not r.on then q = r break end
end
local U = math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
q.on, q.t0, q.life = true, S.t, 0.55 + math.random() * 0.4
q.x, q.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.95, (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sy * 0.9
q.f.Visible = true
q.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
local function ringW(r0, r1, life, col)
local q = E.rg[1]
for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
if not r.on then q = r break end
end
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.r0, q.r1 = true, S.t, life, r0, r1
q.f.Visible = true
q.st.Color = col
end
local function onMode(m)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.45 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.16 * I
ringW(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.8, S.ac)
itick(0.6, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.tk = 0
elseif m == 4 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = I
S.zk = S.zk + 0.32 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.crk = S.t
S.titleN = 0
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 0.9, WHITE)
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.1, 0.7, S.ac2)
itick(0.4, 1.4)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9)
end
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.2 * I
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.8, S.ac2)
itick(0.8, 1)
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = 0
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local TL = {{2, "> LOCATING EAGLE ..."}, {6, "> WINGS LOADED"}, {10, "> MIGHTY = TRUE"}}
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then S.began = os.clock() - pos else S.began = S.began - d * 0.2 end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(sx, sy)
local mode = (t < M[1] and 1) or (t < M[2] and 2) or (t < M[3] and 3) or (t < M[4] and 4) or (t < M[5] and 5) or (t < M[6] and 6) or 7
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.ac, S.ac2, S.bgc = S.ac:Lerp(PA[mode], ck), S.ac2:Lerp(PB[mode], ck), S.bgc:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
local acc, acc2 = accent(), S.ac2
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode)
end
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local drop = mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = beatIdx % 4 == 0
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 1 or 0.55)
if drop then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.8 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
end
if beatIdx % 8 == 7 then S.blink = 1 end
if mode == 6 then
S.pulse = 1
itick(1.5 - 0.2 * (3 - math.floor((t - M[5]) / K.BEAT)), 1)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local h = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - h[1] < 0.25 then
S.kick = 1
if mode ~= 1 and mode ~= 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (0.025 + 0.02 * h[2]) * I
S.shake = S.shake + h[2] * (drop and 2.4 or 1) * I
if drop and h[2] >= 3 then
S.strobe, S.glitch = 1, 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * I)
if S.tokens >= 1 and mode ~= 5 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
ringW(U * 0.15, U * 0.9, 0.55, acc2)
end
end
itick(drop and 0.7 or 0.5, 0.35)
end
end
end
while HAT[S.hatI] and HAT[S.hatI][1] <= t do
local h = HAT[S.hatI]
S.hatI = S.hatI + 1
if drop and t - h[1] < 0.2 then spark((S.hatI % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2) end
end
while VOX[S.voxI] and VOX[S.voxI] <= t do
local v = VOX[S.voxI]
S.voxI = S.voxI + 1
if t - v < 0.4 then
S.mt, S.ph = v, v
itick(1.6, 0.4)
end
end
if mode == 3 then
local rt = clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2]))
if t >= S.tk then
S.tk = t + lerp(K.BEAT * 0.5, K.BEAT * 0.12, rt)
itick(1 + rt * 1.2, 0.5)
end
end
if mode == 1 then
local l = TL[S.tlI]
if l and beatIdx >= l[1] then
S.tlI = S.tlI + 1
S.lines[#S.lines + 1] = l[2]
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.lines, "\n")
end
end
local dk = math.exp(-dt)
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.kick = S.kick * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.glitch = S.glitch * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.strobe = S.strobe * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.blink = S.blink * math.exp(-12 * dt)
S.tp = S.tp * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.kal = lerp(S.kal, (mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt))
local rt = (mode == 3) and clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2])) or 0
local zb = (mode == 1 and 0.12 * clamp01(t / M[1])) or (mode == 2 and 0.1 + 0.04 * S.pulse) or (mode == 3 and 0.1 + rt * 0.5) or 0.02 * S.pulse
E.zs.Scale = 1 + zb + S.zk
local sh = (S.shake + rt * rt * 6) * I
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
E.world.Rotation = S.rk + math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.8 * I * (mode >= 2 and 1 or 0.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
local bgk = S.strobe * 0.5 + (mode == 3 and rt * 0.12 * (math.floor(t * 14) % 2) or 0)
E.world.BackgroundColor3 = S.bgc:Lerp(acc, bgk)
local cy = U * 0.02
local g = (S.glitch * 0.02 + rt * 0.015) * U * I
local draw = clamp01(t / (K.BAR * 2.2))
if not S.egDone then
local rv = draw * 8.6
for _, p in ipairs(E.eg) do p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(rv - (p.o - 1)) end
if draw >= 1 then S.egDone = true end
end
local fxT = ((mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1) or (mode == 6 and 0.7) or (mode == 3 and 0.3 + 0.35 * rt) or (mode == 2 and 0.18 + 0.1 * clamp01((t - M[1]) / K.BAR)) or 0
S.flex = lerp(S.flex or 0, fxT, 1 - math.exp(-((mode == 4 or mode == 7) and 16 or 4) * dt))
local fx = S.flex
local trem = (mode == 3) and (math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * rt or 0
local dR = lerp(-38, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local dL = lerp(70, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local bR = lerp(75, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6) * 3
local bL = lerp(55, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6 + 1) * 3
E.arm[1].Rotation, E.arm[2].Rotation = dR, -dL
E.fa[1].Rotation, E.fa[2].Rotation = bR, -bL
local pump = 1 + S.kick * 0.07 + S.pulse * 0.03 + 0.04 * fx
E.aS[1].Scale, E.aS[2].Scale = pump, pump
local es = U * 0.88 * (1 + 0.012 * S.pulse + 0.06 * S.kal)
E.eagle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(es, es)
E.eagle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy + U * 0.04 + math.sin(t * 1.9) * U * 0.006 - S.kick * U * 0.01)
E.eagle.Rotation = math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.8
local ot = t - S.mt
local open = ot < 0.55 and clamp01(1 - ot / 0.55) * (0.45 + 0.55 * math.abs(math.sin(ot * 24))) or 0
E.jaw.Rotation = -open * 30
E.head.Rotation = lerp(12, -5, clamp01(fx * 1.4)) + math.sin(t * 1.3) * 2 + S.pulse * 2.5 - open * 6
E.head.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36 - 0.015 * fx + 0.006 * S.pulse)
local bl = clamp01(S.blink)
E.eye.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.1 * (1 - 0.9 * bl))
E.eye.BackgroundColor3 = E.eyeC:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, rt * 0.9 + S.kick * 0.7))
E.pup.Visible = bl < 0.6
E.pup.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (0.047 + 0.012 * math.sin(t * 1.7) * (1 - S.kick)) / 0.5, 0.27)
local rayK = clamp01((t - 0.8) / 3.5) * (mode == 6 and 0.5 or 1)
local spin = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 9 or 3
for i, f in ipairs(E.rays) do
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 3.6, U * 0.06 * (1 + 0.5 * S.pulse + (mode >= 4 and 0.4 or 0)))
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.05)
f.Rotation = (i - 1) * 20 + t * spin
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.16 + 0.22 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.pulse)
end
local gs = U * (0.8 + 0.06 * S.pulse + 0.1 * S.kick)
E.glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gs, gs)
E.glow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.7)
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.3 + 0.25 * S.lv + 0.2 * S.kick)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halo) do
local d = U * (0.62 + 0.2 * i) * (1 + 0.03 * S.pulse * i)
h.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
h.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
h.st.Color = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6)
h.st.Transparency = 1 - rayK * (0.45 - 0.08 * i)
h.st.Thickness = 2 + S.kick * 3
end
for i, f in ipairs(E.cl) do
local u = (i * 0.137 + t * (0.006 + 0.003 * (i % 3))) % 1
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + 0.05 * (i % 3), 0.1 + 0.02 * (i % 2))
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.15 + u * 1.3, 0.62 + 0.04 * (i % 4))
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.75)
end
local ct = t - S.crk
local crOn = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and ct < 24
for i, f in ipairs(E.cr) do
f.Visible = crOn
if crOn then
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * (0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 37) % 10) / 10) * eo3(clamp01(ct / 0.25)), 3)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.7 * clamp01((ct - 1) / 16)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy)
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(u))
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.st.Transparency = u
r.st.Thickness = 2 + 8 * (1 - u)
end
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = U * 0.025 * (1 - u * 0.5)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, r.x, 0.5, r.y - u * U * 0.18)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = u
end
end
end
local eqOn = (mode >= 2) and 1 or 0.3
for i, f in ipairs(E.eq) do
local h = (0.04 + 0.5 * S.lv * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.abs(math.sin(i * 1.9 + t * 7 + S.kick * 3)))) * sy * 0.28 * eqOn
f.Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / 28, 0, 1, 0)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 28, -3, 0, h)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2
end
S.lbv = lerp(S.lbv, (mode == 3 and 0.11) or (mode == 6 and 0.18) or 0, 1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0)
if mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7 then
local a0 = (mode == 7) and M[6] or M[3]
local n = math.min(#TITLE, math.floor((t - a0) / K.BEAT) + 1)
if n ~= S.titleN then
S.titleN = n
S.tp = 1
itick(1.2, 0.5)
end
local ts = TITLE:sub(1, S.titleN)
local fs = math.floor(U * 0.11 * (1 + S.tp * 0.35))
local gx = g * 1.5 + S.tp * U * 0.01
for _, l in ipairs({E.tR, E.tC, E.tM}) do
l.Text, l.TextSize = ts, fs
end
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position, E.tM.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextColor3 = 0, WHITE

E.tC.TextTransparency = gx > 1 and 0.35 or 1
else
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1
end

E.name.TextTransparency = 1 - eo3(clamp01((t - B(26)) / K.BEAT))
E.name.TextColor3 = acc2
else
E.name.TextTransparency = 1
end
if mode == 6 then

E.big.TextSize = math.floor(U * (0.3 + 0.12 * S.pulse))
E.big.TextTransparency = 0
E.big.TextColor3 = acc
else
E.big.TextTransparency = 1
end
local pn = math.floor((t - S.ph) / 0.2) + 1
if pn >= 1 and t - S.ph < 1.5 and mode ~= 3 and mode ~= 6 then
E.cap.Text = table.concat(PHRASE, " ", 1, math.min(#PHRASE, pn))
E.cap.TextSize = math.floor(U * 0.07 * (1 + S.kick * 0.08))
E.cap.TextTransparency = clamp01((t - S.ph - 1.1) / 0.4)
E.cap.TextColor3 = (math.floor(t * 8) % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
else
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, (mode == 7 and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.9 * I) or 0)
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
local hf = clamp01(t / 2)
local hc = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   107 BPM", (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 2 == 0) and "* REC" or "  REC", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(32, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  LAYDOWNROT - PERFECT FACE (SLOWED)"
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3, E.term.TextColor3 = hc, hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - hf) * 0.65
E.np.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - hf) * 0.55
E.term.TextTransparency = (mode <= 2) and 0.3 or 1
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = acc
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(loop)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 7 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false

FX.Ring(MainFrame, PB[7], 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro8(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro8Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.09, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 122), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local TITLE = "THE AURA FARMER"
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local GOLD, PINK, CYAN, VIO, ORG = C(255, 196, 64), C(255, 52, 150), C(40, 220, 255), C(150, 70, 255), C(255, 140, 20)
local FUR, FUR2, FURL, MANE = C(96, 58, 42), C(58, 32, 26), C(134, 90, 64), C(26, 14, 12)
local SUIT, SUIT2, LAPEL, SKIN = C(94, 84, 230), C(136, 122, 255), C(224, 78, 52), C(226, 172, 132)
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, LEVEL, VOC = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), D.level, D.voc
local function lvAt(str, t)
local x = t * 10
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end
local function Bsec(sec) return (sec - K.OFF) / K.BAR end
local SCH = {{0, 1}, {Bsec(9.88), 2}, {Bsec(27.42), 3}, {Bsec(29.25), 4}, {Bsec(35.92), 3}, {Bsec(49.67), 5}, {29, 6}}
local DROPS = {B(7), B(19), B(26), B(30.4)}
local LY = {}
for _, r in ipairs(FX.Intro8Lyrics or {}) do
local L = {a = r[1], e = r[2], st = r[3], w = {}, wt = {}}
for wd in r[4]:gmatch("%S+") do L.w[#L.w + 1] = wd end
for x in r[5]:gmatch("%S+") do L.wt[#L.wt + 1] = tonumber(x) end
if #L.w >= 1 and #L.w <= 8 and #L.wt == #L.w then LY[#LY + 1] = L end
end
local conns, E = {}, {}
local S = {
began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, tokens = 3, t = 0, kick = 0, hk = 0, zk = 0, rk = 0, shake = 0,
flashK = 0, glitch = 0, dir = 1, bi = 0, hi = 0, di = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, scene = 0, st = 0, cut = -10, z = 1, r = 0, px = 0, py = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0,
sx = 800, sy = 450, stk = 0, stY = 0.5, fallback = false, ac = C(255, 170, 40), capPop = 0, capLast = "", gt = 0, fi = 1, ri = 1, li = 1, gf = 0,
}
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.ac
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end
return o
end
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
end
end)
local function fr(par, x, y, w, h, col, tr, z, rot, rad)
local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot or 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
if rad then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rad, 0)}) end
return f
end
local function setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th * 0.6, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function ln(par, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, tr)
local f = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, th, col, tr, z, 0, 0.5)
setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
return f
end
local function grad(f, c1, c2, rot) return mk("UIGradient", f, {Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 90}) end

end

mk("UIStroke", l, {Thickness = 3, Color = GOLD})
grad(l, C(255, 190, 90), C(40, 20, 10), 90)
H.lens[i] = fr(l, 0.3, 0.4, 0.18, 0.6, WHITE, 0.55, 1, 25, 0.5)
ln(Hd, 0.5 + sg * 0.17, 0.32, 0.5 + sg * 0.2, 0.18, 0.01, GOLD, zz + 8)
end
fr(Hd, 0.5, 0.325, 0.05, 0.012, GOLD, 0, zz + 8, 0, 0.5)
return H
end
local function hz(H, x, y, sz, rot, flex, open, glint, nod)
H.R.Position, H.R.Size, H.R.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz), rot
H.Hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + nod * 0.015)
H.Hd.Rotation = nod * 2.5
H.jaw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.63 + open * 0.05)
H.mouth.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.17, 0.02 + open * 0.07)
H.mouth.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.612 + open * 0.03)
H.teeth.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, open * 2.2)
local gx, gt = 0.15 + 0.7 * glint, 0.45 + 0.4 * math.abs(glint * 2 - 1)
for i = 1, 2 do
H.lens[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(gx, 0.4)
H.lens[i].BackgroundTransparency = gt
end
H.med.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD:Lerp(WHITE, clamp01(S.kick * 0.7))
for _, a in ipairs(H.arm) do
local sg = a.sg
local ex, ey = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.46, 0.6, flex), lerp(1.04, 0.86, flex)
local fx, fy = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.44, 0.38, flex), lerp(1.2, 0.58, flex)
setLn(a.u, 0.5 + sg * 0.36, 0.9, ex, ey, 0.17)
setLn(a.l, ex, ey, fx, fy, 0.14)
a.h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(fx, fy)
end
end

local function dancer(par, z, shirt, pants, isHorse)

d.sL, d.sR = fr(R, 0.4, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.6, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)

local hc = isHorse and FURL or SKIN
d.hL, d.hR = fr(R, 0.3, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.7, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
d.hd = mk("Frame", R, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 4, Interactable = false})
if isHorse then

fr(d.hd, 0.32, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, -10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.68, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, 10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, MANE, 0, 2, 0, 0.5)

else

fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.18, 0.84, 0.3, C(30, 22, 20), 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.74, 0.16, C(20, 16, 20), 0, 3, 0, 0.4)
end
return d
end
local function dz(d, x, y, sz, ph, kk)
d.R.Position, d.R.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(ph * math.pi)
local bx = 0.03 * math.sin(ph * math.pi * 0.5)
local hy = 0.55 - 0.012 * kk
local lxL, lxR = 0.38 + bx * 2 + 0.03 * (1 - s), 0.62 + bx * 2 - 0.03 * (1 - s)
setLn(d.lL, 0.46 + bx, hy, lxL, 0.94, 0.1)
setLn(d.lR, 0.54 + bx, hy, lxR, 0.94 - 0.03 * s, 0.1)
d.sL.Position, d.sR.Position = UDim2.fromScale(lxL - 0.02, 0.955), UDim2.fromScale(lxR + 0.02, 0.955 - 0.03 * s)
d.tor.Position, d.tor.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx, 0.42 - 0.012 * kk), (s - 0.5) * 12
d.hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx * 1.2, 0.2 - 0.02 * kk)
local hxR, hyR = 0.74 + 0.04 * s, lerp(0.56, 0.0, s)
local hxL, hyL = 0.26 - 0.04 * (1 - s), lerp(0.0, 0.56, s)
setLn(d.aR, 0.6 + bx, 0.31, hxR + bx, hyR, 0.065)
setLn(d.aL, 0.4 + bx, 0.31, hxL + bx, hyL, 0.065)
d.hR.Position, d.hL.Position = UDim2.fromScale(hxR + bx, hyR), UDim2.fromScale(hxL + bx, hyL)
end
local function wheel(par, z)
local W = {sp = {}, g = {}}
W.ring = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring, {Thickness = 4, Color = C(238, 232, 236)})
W.ring2 = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.4, 0.4, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring2, {Thickness = 2, Color = C(220, 214, 224), Transparency = 0.3})
local pal = {C(255, 70, 70), C(255, 210, 60), C(70, 190, 255), C(255, 255, 255)}
for i = 1, 12 do
W.sp[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.004, C(232, 226, 232), 0.1, z, 0, 0.5)
W.g[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.036, pal[i % 4 + 1], 0, z + 1, 0, 0.25)
end
W.hub = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.03, C(250, 246, 250), 0, z + 2, 0, 0.5)
return W
end
local function wz(W, x, y, r, a)
W.ring.Position, W.ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(2 * r, 2 * r)
W.ring2.Position, W.ring2.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(1.7 * r, 1.7 * r)
W.hub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
for i = 1, 12 do
local an = a + (i - 1) * math.pi / 6
local px, py = x + r * math.cos(an), y + r * math.sin(an)
setLn(W.sp[i], x, y, px, py, 0.004)
W.g[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(px, py + 0.02)
end
end
local function spawnRing(r0, r1, life, col)
local q = E.rg[S.ri]
S.ri = S.ri % #E.rg + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.r0, q.r1 = true, S.t, life, r0, r1
q.st.Color = col
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnSL()
local q = E.sl[S.li]
S.li = S.li % #E.sl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.a = true, S.t, 0.22 + math.random() * 0.12, math.random() * math.pi * 2
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnFlare(x, y, col, sz)
local q = E.fl[S.fi]
S.fi = S.fi % #E.fl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.sz, q.x, q.y = true, S.t, 0.4, sz, x, y
q.h.BackgroundColor3, q.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
q.c.Visible = true
end
local function onKick(s)
local I = K.INT
S.kick = math.min(1, 0.45 + 0.2 * s)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.01 * s * I
S.shake = S.shake + (1 + 1.6 * s) * I
if s >= 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + 0.7 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
if I > 0 then
spawnSL()
spawnSL()
end
end
end
local function onDrop(i)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (i == 4 and 0.6 or 1) * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.glitch = 0.4 * I
S.imp = S.t
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.5, 0.9, WHITE)
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.0, 0.7, i % 2 == 0 and CYAN or PINK)
for _ = 1, 6 do
if I > 0 then spawnSL() end
end
spawnFlare(S.sx * 0.5, S.sy * 0.45, WHITE, U * 0.9)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.04, 0.9)
end
end
local function onScene(id, t)
local prev = S.scene
for i, o in pairs(E.sc) do o.s.Visible = (i == id) end
S.scene, S.cut, S.st, S.stk = id, t, t, 0
if prev ~= 0 then
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.14 * I
S.glitch = 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
spawnRing(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.7, id % 2 == 0 and PINK or CYAN)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.04, 0.8)
end
end
end

end
local hp = eo3(clamp01(ls / K.BAR))
local flex = clamp01((t - B(30.4)) / 0.2) * (0.6 + 0.4 * S.kick)
hz(s.H, 0.5, 0.9 + 0.5 * (1 - hp) - 0.01 * S.kick, 1.55, 2 * math.sin(ls * 0.9), flex, S.vc, (t * 0.5) % 1, S.kick)
S.stk, S.stY = 0.3, 0.55
end
local PCOL = {C(255, 236, 170), C(255, 100, 220), C(255, 255, 255), C(255, 200, 90), C(255, 214, 90), C(255, 255, 255)}
local function ptUpdate(t, dt, I)
local col, sc = PCOL[S.scene] or WHITE, S.scene
for _, p in ipairs(E.pt) do
p.y = p.y - p.v * dt * ((sc == 2 or sc == 6) and 1.6 or 1)
p.x = p.x + 0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.7 + p.ph) * dt
if p.y < -0.1 then
p.y = 1.1
p.x = -0.4 + math.random() * 1.8
end
local f = p.f
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.x - S.cx * p.d, p.y - S.cy * p.d)
local sz = p.s * (1 + S.kick * 0.7) * (0.6 + 0.4 * p.d)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(0.35 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 2 + p.ph) - S.hk * 0.15)
end
end
local LCOL = {[0] = C(255, 168, 24), C(255, 200, 70), C(255, 236, 170), C(255, 96, 170), C(255, 214, 120), C(255, 92, 40), C(130, 220, 255), C(238, 228, 214), WHITE}
local LSZ = {[0] = 0.062, 0.05, 0.125, 0.07, 0.066, 0.07, 0.075, 0.05, 0.1}
local LYP = {[0] = 0.86, 0.885, 0.56, 0.84, 0.84, 0.84, 0.8, 0.885, 0.78}
local LPRE = {[0] = 0.8, 0.9, 1, 0.82, 0.8, 0.8, 1, 0.84, 1}
local LHS = {[0] = 0.35, 0.5, 1.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.35, 0.5, 0.18, 0.75}
local LWT = {[0] = 0.7, 0.35, 1.5, 0.9, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 0.4, 1.2}
local LKEY = {FARMER = 1, FLESH = 1, HEAT = 0.9, HORSE = 0.9, DOWN = 0.8, MYSELF = 0.8, GONE = 0.8, AURA = 0.6, BEST = 0.7, FRESH = 0.7, SON = 0.7, MORNING = 0.6, STRESS = 0.6, WORRIES = 0.6, THIS = 0.6, FEET = 0.6, TRYING = 0.5, KISS = 0.5, DIM = 0.5, REALIZED = 0.5}
local LSTK = C(70, 6, 0)
local LHOT = C(255, 40, 10)
local function lyMeasure(s, size)
local ok, v = pcall(function() return TextService:GetTextSize(s, size, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Vector2.new(10000, 1000)) end)
if ok and v then return v.X end
return #s * size * 0.7
end
local function lySpark(x, y, col, n)
for _ = 1, n do
local q = E.sk[S.ski]
S.ski = S.ski % #E.sk + 1
local a, v = math.random() * math.pi * 2, S.sy * (0.25 + math.random() * 0.55)
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.x, q.y = true, S.t, 0.45 + math.random() * 0.4, x, y
q.vx, q.vy, q.g = math.cos(a) * v, math.sin(a) * v - S.sy * 0.2, S.sy * 0.9
q.sz = math.max(3, S.sy * (0.006 + math.random() * 0.008))
q.f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() < 0.3) and WHITE or col
q.f.Visible = true
end
end
local function lyOnWord(L, i)
local st, I, U = L.st, K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
local w = LWT[st]
S.lyK = math.max(S.lyK, math.min(1, 0.45 + 0.3 * w))
S.kick = math.max(S.kick, 0.3 + 0.2 * w)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.005 * w * I
S.shake = S.shake + (0.6 + 1.6 * w) * I
if st == 2 or st == 8 then S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, 0.1 * I) end
if I <= 0 then return end
local word = L.w[i]:gsub("[^%w]", "")
local key = LKEY[word]
lySpark(L.bx[i], L.by, LCOL[st], (st == 2 and 14) or (key and 10) or 4)
if key then
spawnRing(U * 0.05, U * (0.5 + 0.4 * key), 0.6, LCOL[st])
spawnFlare(L.bx[i], L.by, WHITE, U * 0.6 * key)
if key >= 0.9 then S.imp = S.t end
end
end
local function lyOnLine(L)
local w, I = LWT[L.st], K.INT
S.zk = S.zk + 0.03 * w * I
S.shake = S.shake + 5 * w * I
S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, 0.12 * w * I)
S.rk = S.rk + 1.4 * w * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * w * I)
end
local function lySetLine(L, U, sx, sy)
local st = L.st
local raw = math.floor(U * LSZ[st])
local size, bs, ws, tot
for _ = 1, 2 do
size = math.min(100, raw)
bs = raw / size
ws, tot = {}, 0
for i, wd in ipairs(L.w) do
ws[i] = lyMeasure(wd, size) * 1.06
tot = tot + ws[i] * bs
end
tot = tot + raw * 0.3 * (#L.w - 1)
if tot > sx * 0.9 then raw = math.max(10, math.floor(raw * sx * 0.9 / tot)) else break end
end
L.size, L.bs, L.bx, L.by = size, bs, {}, sy * LYP[st]
local x = sx * 0.5 - tot * 0.5
for i = 1, #L.w do
L.bx[i] = x + ws[i] * bs * 0.5
x = x + ws[i] * bs + raw * 0.3
end
for i = 1, 8 do
for k = 1, 3 do
local o = E.lw[i][k]
if L.w[i] then
o.l.Text, o.l.TextSize, o.l.Size = L.w[i], size, UDim2.fromOffset(ws[i] + size * 0.2, size * 1.4)
else
o.l.Text, o.l.TextTransparency = "", 1
end
end
end
end
local function lyricUpdate(t, U, dt)
local sx, sy, I = S.sx, S.sy, K.INT
local Im = math.max(I, 0.3)
S.lyK = S.lyK * math.exp(-7 * dt)
local ik = S.t - S.imp
if I > 0 and ik >= 0 and ik < 0.16 then
E.imp.Visible = true
if ik < 0.05 then
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE, 0.05
elseif ik < 0.09 then
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 0.2
else
E.imp.BackgroundColor3, E.imp.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE, 0.55 + (ik - 0.09) * 6
end
else
E.imp.Visible = false
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.sk) do
if q.on then
local a = S.t - q.t0
local k = a / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on, q.f.Visible = false, false
else
local sz = q.sz * (1 - k * 0.6)
q.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(q.x + q.vx * a, q.y + q.vy * a + 0.5 * q.g * a * a)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
q.f.BackgroundTransparency = k * k
end
end
end
local cur = 0
for i = math.max(1, S.lyi - 1), #LY do
local L = LY[i]
if t >= L.a - 0.08 and t < L.e then cur = i break end
if t < L.a - 0.08 then break end
end
if cur ~= S.lyi then
S.lyi, S.lyw = cur, 1
if cur > 0 then
lySetLine(LY[cur], U, sx, sy)
lyOnLine(LY[cur])
end
end
local L = LY[cur]
if not L then
if S.lyVis then
S.lyVis = false
for i = 1, 8 do
for k = 1, 3 do E.lw[i][k].l.TextTransparency = 1 end
E.lw[i][3].k.Transparency = 1
end
end
S.lyZ = S.lyZ * math.exp(-6 * dt)
return
end
S.lyVis = true
local st, size = L.st, L.size
local lin = clamp01((t - (L.a - 0.08)) / 0.1)
local lout = clamp01((t - (L.e - 0.22)) / 0.22)
local kd = (st == 1 and 12) or (st == 2 and 6.5) or 9
while L.wt[S.lyw] and L.wt[S.lyw] <= t do
local i = S.lyw
S.lyw = i + 1
if t - L.wt[i] < 0.12 then lyOnWord(L, i) end
end
local off0 = U * (0.0022 + 0.012 * math.max(0, S.glitch) + 0.02 * lout)
local px, py = S.px * U * 0.12 + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake * 0.3, S.py * U * 0.12 + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake * 0.3
for i = 1, #L.w do
local dtw = t - L.wt[i]
local sung = dtw >= 0
local pop = sung and math.exp(-dtw * kd) or 0
local x, y, rot = L.bx[i], L.by, 0
if st == 2 then
rot, y = (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * 6 * pop * Im, y - U * 0.01 * pop
elseif st == 3 then
x, rot = x + (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * U * 0.14 * pop * Im, -4
elseif st == 4 then
y = y + U * 0.07 * (sung and (1 - eo3(clamp01(dtw / 0.4))) or 1)
elseif st == 5 then
y = y + math.sin(t * 43 + i * 1.7) * U * 0.004 * (1 + S.vc * 2) - (sung and U * 0.01 * pop or 0)
elseif st == 6 then
if sung then y = y - U * 0.22 * (1 - clamp01(dtw / 0.22)) ^ 2 - math.abs(math.sin(dtw * 20)) * math.exp(-dtw * 8) * U * 0.02 end
elseif st == 8 then
rot = (i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1) * 3 * pop * Im
elseif st == 1 then
y = y - U * 0.014 * pop
end
local sc = (1 + LHS[st] * pop * Im) * L.bs
local tr = sung and 0 or LPRE[st]
tr = 1 - (1 - tr) * lin
tr = tr + (1 - tr) * lout
local col = (sung and LCOL[st] or WHITE):Lerp(WHITE, 0.85 * pop)
if st == 5 then col = col:Lerp(LHOT, 0.35 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 9 + i)) end
local off = off0 + U * 0.012 * pop * (0.4 + LHS[st]) * Im
local gtr = 1 - clamp01(0.12 + 0.75 * pop + 0.5 * S.lyK + 0.9 * lout + (st == 2 and 0.25 or 0)) * (1 - tr) * 0.75
for k = 1, 3 do
local o = E.lw[i][k]
local dx = (k == 1 and -off) or (k == 2 and off) or 0
o.l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + px + dx, y + py)
o.l.Rotation = rot
o.s.Scale = sc
if k == 3 then
o.l.TextColor3, o.l.TextTransparency = col, tr
o.k.Transparency = clamp01(tr + 0.1)
o.k.Thickness = math.max(2, size * 0.045) * (1 + 0.8 * pop)
o.k.Color = LSTK:Lerp(LCOL[st], 0.5 * pop)
else
o.l.TextTransparency = gtr
end
end
end
S.lyZ = (st == 4 and -0.03 or 0.045) * eo3(clamp01((t - L.a) / math.max(0.4, L.e - L.a)))
end

local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
E.rm = FX.MountRemaster and FX.MountRemaster(stage, E, 8, DROPS, K, 13) or nil
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local now = os.clock()
if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
local d = est - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
t = now - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(sx, sy)
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(LEVEL, t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
S.vc = lerp(S.vc, lvAt(VOC, t), 1 - math.exp(-20 * dt))
S.kick = S.kick * math.exp(-8.5 * dt)
S.hk = S.hk * math.exp(-14 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.capPop = S.capPop * math.exp(-9 * dt)
while BASS[S.bi + 1] and BASS[S.bi + 1][1] <= t do
S.bi = S.bi + 1
if t - BASS[S.bi][1] < 0.15 then onKick(BASS[S.bi][2]) end
end
while HAT[S.hi + 1] and HAT[S.hi + 1][1] <= t do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.1 then S.hk = 1 end
end
while DROPS[S.di + 1] and t >= DROPS[S.di + 1] do
S.di = S.di + 1
if t - DROPS[S.di] < 0.3 then onDrop(S.di) end
end
local sid = 1
for i = #SCH, 1, -1 do
if t >= B(SCH[i][1]) - 0.001 then
sid = SCH[i][2]
break
end
end
if sid ~= S.scene then onScene(sid, t) end
local o = E.sc[S.scene]
o.q.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U, U)
E.pq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U, U)
AN[S.scene](t, dt)
for _, l in ipairs(o.L) do l.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + S.cx * l.d, 0.5 + S.cy * l.d) end
ptUpdate(t, dt, I)
E.zs.Scale = S.z + S.kick * 0.03 * I + S.zk + S.lyZ * I
E.world.Rotation = S.r + S.rk + math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.4 * I
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, S.px * U + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake + math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.004 * U * I, 0.5, S.py * U + (math.random() - 0.5) * S.shake)
if E.rm then E.rm(t, dt, S) end
local ten = 0
for _, d in ipairs(DROPS) do
local k = d - t
if k > 0 and k < K.BAR then ten = math.max(ten, 1 - k / K.BAR) end
end
local lb = sy * (0.055 + 0.04 * ten * I)
E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lb), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, lb)
for _, f in ipairs(E.vg) do f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 - 0.2 * S.kick end
local sa = clamp01(S.stk + S.kick * 0.4) * I
E.st.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - sa * 0.9
E.st.Position, E.st.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, S.stY), UDim2.new(1.6, 0, 0, math.max(3, U * 0.012))
E.st.BackgroundColor3 = CYAN:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5 + 0.5 * S.kick)
for i, f in ipairs(E.lk) do
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.3 + i * 2.1), 0.5 + 0.4 * math.cos(t * 0.23 + i * 1.7))
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.9, sx * 0.9)
f.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(0.92 - 0.25 * S.kick - 0.12 * S.lv)
end
S.gf = S.gf + 1
if S.gf % 2 == 0 then
for _, f in ipairs(E.gr) do
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(0, sx), math.random(0, sy))
local g = math.random(1, 3)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(g, g)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (math.random() > 0.5) and WHITE or BLACK
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.sl) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.f.Visible = false
else
local r = U * (0.25 + 0.75 * k)
q.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(q.a) * r * (sx / U) * 0.6, 0.5, math.sin(q.a) * r * 0.6)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 0.35, 2)
q.f.Rotation = math.deg(q.a)
q.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * k
end
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.rg) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.f.Visible = false
else
local d = lerp(q.r0, q.r1, 1 - (1 - k) ^ 3)
q.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d * 2, d * 2)
q.st.Transparency = k
end
end
end
for _, q in ipairs(E.fl) do
if q.on then
local k = (t - q.t0) / q.life
if k >= 1 then
q.on = false
q.c.Visible = false
else
q.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(q.x, q.y)
q.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(q.sz * (0.3 + k), q.sz * 0.12)
q.h.BackgroundTransparency = k
q.v.BackgroundTransparency = k
end
end
end
if S.glitch > 0 then
S.glitch = S.glitch - dt
for _, f in ipairs(E.gl) do
if math.random() < 0.4 then
f.Visible = true
f.Position = UDim2.new(math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1, 0, math.random(), 0)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(4, math.max(5, math.floor(U * 0.07))))
f.BackgroundColor3 = ({PINK, CYAN, WHITE})[math.random(1, 3)]
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 + math.random() * 0.3
else
f.Visible = false
end
end
else
for _, f in ipairs(E.gl) do f.Visible = false end
end
local wk = (t - S.cut) / 0.42
for i, f in ipairs(E.wp) do
if S.scene > 1 and wk >= 0 and wk < 1.3 then
local k = clamp01(wk * 1.25 - (i - 1) * 0.12)
f.Visible = k > 0 and k < 1
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(lerp(-0.45, 1.45, k), 0.5)
else
f.Visible = false
end
end
if not S.lyDead and #LY > 0 then
local okL, errL = pcall(lyricUpdate, t + 0.02, U, dt)
if not okL then
S.lyDead = true
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 8 lyrics disabled: " .. tostring(errL))
end
end
local T0 = B(30.4)
if t >= T0 then
local n = math.min(#TITLE, math.floor((t - T0) / 0.06) + 1)
local off = (0.002 + S.kick * 0.004 + math.max(0, S.glitch) * 0.02) * U
local fs = math.floor(U * 0.115)
for _, l in ipairs({E.tR, E.tC, E.tM}) do
l.Text, l.TextSize, l.TextTransparency = TITLE:sub(1, n), fs, 0
end
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -off, 0.4, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, off, 0.4, 0)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 0.35, 0.35
local sa2 = clamp01((t - B(30.9)) / 0.3)
E.sub.Text, E.sub.TextSize, E.sub.TextTransparency = "H O R R O R   S K U N X   -   O F F I C I A L   S O N G", math.floor(U * 0.034), 1 - sa2
E.sub.TextColor3 = accent():Lerp(GOLD, 0.5)
local na = clamp01((t - B(31)) / 0.3)
E.name.Text, E.name.TextSize, E.name.TextTransparency = NAME, math.floor(U * 0.04), 1 - na * 0.15
end
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, (t > B(31)) and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.95 * I or 0)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-9 * dt)
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
E.dark.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(t / 1.0)
local acc = accent()
local hc = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
local hf = clamp01(t / 2)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   122 BPM", (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 2 == 0) and "* REC" or "  REC", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(32, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  THE AURA FARMER - HORROR SKUNX (OFFICIAL SONG)"
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3 = hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency, E.np.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - hf) * 0.65, 0.45 + (1 - hf) * 0.55
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = acc
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 8 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, GOLD, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.BlurPulse(16, 0.04, 1.0)
end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro9(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro9Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.37, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 122.04), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.EXT, K.LOOP = 10, 12 * K.BAR
K.XB = K.EXT / K.BAR
K.EB = 32 + K.XB
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR + K.EXT
local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local sin, cos, exp, floor, abs, max, min, pi, sqrt, rad, deg, atan2 = math.sin, math.cos, math.exp, math.floor, math.abs, math.max, math.min, math.pi, math.sqrt, math.rad, math.deg, math.atan2
local V2 = Vector2.new
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local function clamp01(x) return max(0, min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function ease(x) x = clamp01(x) return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
local BG0, BG1, BG2 = C(5, 7, 16), C(17, 16, 42), C(46, 26, 72)
local PINK, TEAL, GOLD, MINT = C(255, 168, 204), C(72, 232, 212), C(255, 224, 96), C(160, 255, 235)
local YEL, YEL2, YELD = C(246, 222, 30), C(255, 238, 84), C(212, 182, 20)
local FACE, INK = C(234, 210, 36), C(9, 9, 13)
local BLUE, BLUE2, GRN = C(43, 126, 180), C(58, 146, 200), C(67, 153, 56)
local ARMY, ARMB = C(223, 200, 34), C(12, 10, 16)
local SC0, SC1, SC2 = C(10, 38, 40), C(3, 14, 16), C(30, 84, 80)
local PK0, PK1, PK2, PK3 = C(238, 210, 220), C(222, 164, 186), C(196, 100, 128), C(255, 238, 244)
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then

local KICK, LEV = {}, {}

end

end

local function lvAt(t)
local x = max(0, (t >= B(32)) and (t - K.LOOP) or t) * 10
local i = floor(x)
local a, b = LEV[i + 1] or 0, LEV[i + 2] or LEV[i + 1] or 0
return a + (b - a) * (x - i)
end

local mobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
local CW, CH = 720, 858
local function R(g, x, y, w, h, col, z, rot, rr, tr)
local f = mk("Frame", g, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale((x + w / 2) / CW, (y + h / 2) / CH), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w / CW, h / CH), BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot or 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
if rr then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rr, 0)}) end
return f
end
local function EL(g, cx, cy, w, h, col, z, tr, rot)
return R(g, cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, w, h, col, z, rot, 0.5, tr)
end
local function bar(g, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, tr)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
local len = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
return R(g, (x1 + x2) / 2 - (len + th) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2 - th / 2, len + th, th, col, z, deg(atan2(dy, dx)), 0.5, tr)
end
local function grp(parent, px, py, z)
return mk("Frame", parent, {AnchorPoint = V2(px / CW, py / CH), Position = UDim2.fromScale(px / CW, py / CH), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
end
local function spike(g, bx, by, tx, ty, w, col, z, n)
n = n or 6
local dx, dy = tx - bx, ty - by
local L = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
local c = mk("Frame", g, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(bx / CW, by / CH), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w / CW, L / CH), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = deg(atan2(dx, -dy)), ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
for i = 1, n do
mk("Frame", c, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1 - (i - 0.5) / n), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - (i - 0.5) / n, 1.5 / n), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
return c
end
local function chain(g, px, py, ws, hs, col, hi, deep, z)
local segs, parent = {}, g
for i = 1, #ws do
local f = mk("Frame", parent, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
if i == 1 then
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(px / CW, py / CH)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ws[1] / CW, hs[1] / CH)
else
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.88)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ws[i] / ws[i - 1], hs[i] / hs[i - 1])
end
mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(i == #ws and 0.5 or 0.3, 0)})
if hi then
local a = mk("Frame", f, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.27, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.78), BackgroundColor3 = hi, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
mk("UICorner", a, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
end
if deep then
local a = mk("Frame", f, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.82), BackgroundColor3 = deep, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
mk("UICorner", a, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
end
segs[i] = f
parent = f
end
return segs
end
local function blossom(g, cx, cy, s, c1, c2, c3, z, r0)
for i = 0, 4 do
local a = rad(r0 + i * 72)
EL(g, cx + s * 15 * sin(a), cy - s * 15 * cos(a), s * 26, s * 30, c1, z, 0, deg(a))
EL(g, cx + s * 18 * sin(a), cy - s * 18 * cos(a), s * 12, s * 15, c2, z + 1, 0.2, deg(a))
end
EL(g, cx, cy, s * 13, s * 13, c3, z + 2, 0)
for i = 0, 4 do
local a = rad(r0 + 36 + i * 72)
EL(g, cx + s * 8 * sin(a), cy - s * 8 * cos(a), s * 4, s * 4, C(130, 54, 80), z + 3, 0)
end
end
