boot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY + 20)
boot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 54)
end
local function impact(k, c)
punch = math.max(punch, 0.03 + 0.03 * k)
shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 6 * k)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = 1 end
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 300 + 200 * k, 0.6, 2 + k)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, math.floor(6 + 5 * k), 130 + 80 * k, 0.6)
end
local function bootTick() pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.5) end
local EV = {
{0.04, function()
flashK = 0.5
pcall(FX.Play, "open", 1.1)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12 * inten, 0.12, 1.8) end
end},
{0.35, function()
local c = iaccent()
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 420, 0.7, 3)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, 10, 200, 0.7)
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 1)
end},
{1.05, function() glitch = 0.8 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end},
{1.45, function() glitch = 0.6 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.9) end},
{1.95, function()
impact(1, iaccent())
pcall(function() T.yawVel = T.yawVel + 10 end)
pcall(FX.Play, "hit", 1)
end},
{bootAt[1], bootTick}, {bootAt[2], bootTick}, {bootAt[3], bootTick},
{3.95, function() impact(0.6, iaccent()) pcall(FX.Play, "reform", 1) end},
{TH, function()
local s = sg.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = s.X * 0.5, math.min(46, s.Y * 0.1), 40
local b = D.Button
if b and b.Parent then
local p, bs = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = p.X + bs.X / 2, p.Y + bs.Y / 2, math.max(bs.X, bs.Y)
end
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 0.9)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.1, 0.6) end
end},
}
local function step(t, dt, sx, sy)
while ev <= #EV and t >= EV[ev][1] do
if t - EV[ev][1] < 0.4 then pcall(EV[ev][2]) end
ev = ev + 1
end
if sx ~= lsx or sy ~= lsy then
lsx, lsy = sx, sy
layout(sx, sy)
end
local u, col = U, iaccent()
local outK = clamp01((t - TH) / (DUR - TH))
local inK = clamp01(t / 0.35)
local vis = inK * (1 - eIn(outK))
local fo = 1 - clamp01(outK * 3)
pulse = pulse * math.exp(-7 * dt)
punch = punch * math.exp(-8 * dt)
shake = shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
flashK = math.max(0, flashK - dt * 3.2)
glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 2.4)
local beat = math.floor(t / PERIOD)
if beat ~= lastBeat then
lastBeat = beat
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse or 0, 0.55) end
end
stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.94 * vis
if inK < 1 or outK > 0 then
for i = 1, #vign do vign[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vis end
end
local R = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) * 0.5
local sp = (0.35 + 3.2 * math.exp(-((t - 0.9) / 0.55) ^ 2)) * (1 - outK * 0.8)
local ex = 0.8 * vis
for i = 1, #stars do
local s = stars[i]
s.r = s.r + s.v * sp * dt * 0.6
if s.r > 1 then
s.r = math.random() * 0.08
s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
end
local rr = s.r * s.r
local f = s.f
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5 + math.cos(s.a) * rr * R, sy * 0.5 + math.sin(s.a) * rr * R)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + sp * rr * 46, 2)
f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, rr * 2.5) * ex
if s.hot then f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local k = eInOut(outK)
mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sx * 0.5, tx, k), lerp(CY + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 4 * u * (1 - outK), ty, k))
ms.Scale = math.max(0.01, eBack(clamp01((t - 0.12) / 0.8)) * lerp(u, tsz / 240 * 1.1, k) * (1 + pulse * 0.035 * (1 - outK)))
local tIn = clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.75)
local lockK = eOut(clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.9))
if not titleDone and t >= 1.0 then
local n = math.floor(#name * tIn)
if n ~= lastN then
lastN = n
if n > 0 and n % 2 == 0 then pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end
end
local s = scr(name, tIn)
lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
titleDone = tIn >= 1
end
local c = (1 - lockK) * 22 * u + pulse * 3
lblR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -c, 0.5, 0)
lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, c, 0.5, 0)
local ta = clamp01((t - 1.0) / 0.12) * fo
lblM.TextTransparency = 1 - ta
lblR.TextTransparency = 1 - ta * (0.12 + 0.43 * (1 - lockK))
lblB.TextTransparency = lblR.TextTransparency
if not subDone and t >= 2.0 then
sub.Text = scr(subText, (t - 2.05) / 0.6)
subDone = t >= 2.65
end
local blink = (t > 3.95 and t < TH) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.55) or 1
sub.TextColor3 = col
sub.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - 2.05) / 0.2) * fo * blink
if not bootDone and t >= bootAt[1] then
local parts = {}
for i = 1, #bootLines do
local f = clamp01((t - bootAt[i]) / 0.3)
if f > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = scr(bootLines[i], f) end
end
boot.Text = table.concat(parts, "\n")
bootDone = t >= bootAt[#bootAt] + 0.3
end
boot.TextColor3 = col
boot.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - bootAt[1]) / 0.15) * fo * 0.9
if t >= 1.0 and t < 1.95 then
scan.Visible = true
scan.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * ((t - 1.0) / 0.95) - 60)
scan.BackgroundColor3, scanLine.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
elseif scan.Visible then
scan.Visible = false
end
for i = 1, #tears do
local f = tears[i]
if glitch > 0.05 and math.random() < glitch * 0.8 then
f.Visible = true
f.Position = UDim2.new(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 40 * glitch, 0, math.random() * sy)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 10))
f.BackgroundColor3 = math.random() < 0.5 and col or WHITE
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
elseif f.Visible then
f.Visible = false
end
end
local bh = sy * 0.085 * eOut(clamp01(t / 0.6)) * (1 - eIn(outK))
barTop.Size, barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh)
local hin = eOut(clamp01((t - 0.1) / 0.7))
local inset = (22 + (1 - hin) * 80) * u
for i = 1, #hud do
local b = hud[i]
b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
local tr = 1 - hin * (1 - outK)
if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
end
tcL.Text = string.format("DELTA // BOOT  %04.2f / %04.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
modL.Text = D.Api and "CUSTOMIZER LINKED" or "CUSTOMIZER WAITING"
ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / TH) * 100))
local hudA = math.min(1, 1 - hin * 0.85 * fo + (1 - fo))
for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
l.TextColor3 = col
l.TextTransparency = hudA
end
progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / TH), 0, 1, 0)
progFill.BackgroundColor3, progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
local pf = clamp01(outK * 1.5)
progFill.BackgroundTransparency = pf
progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(pf, math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1))
progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 + pulse * 5, 6 + pulse * 5)
progBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.1 * vis
local sv = fo * vis
skipBtn.TextColor3, skipStroke.Color = col, col
skipBtn.TextTransparency = 1 - sv
skipBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.7 * sv
skipStroke.Transparency = math.min(1, 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3) + (1 - sv))
local endF = clamp01((t - (DUR - 0.3)) / 0.3) * 0.25
flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35)
flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.max(math.min(0.8, flashK * math.clamp(inten, 0, 1.2)), endF * math.clamp(inten, 0.4, 1))
worldZoom.Scale = 1 + punch * inten
if shake > 0.1 then
world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten)
elseif shake ~= 0 then
shake = 0
world.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
end
end
local function doSkip()
if t0 and os.clock() - t0 < TH then t0 = os.clock() - TH end
end
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not t0 or os.clock() - t0 < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local kc = input.KeyCode
if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Space or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Return or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then doSkip() end
end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.Activated:Connect(doSkip)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1.12}) end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end)
t0 = os.clock()
local last = t0
while sg.Parent do
local now = os.clock()
local t = now - t0
if t >= DUR then break end
local dt = math.min(0.1, now - last)
last = now
local sz = sg.AbsoluteSize
if sz.X >= 2 and sz.Y >= 2 then step(t, dt, sz.X, sz.Y) end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if D.Logo then pcall(D.Logo.Bloom, D.Logo) end
if D.LogoHost then pcall(FX.Ring, D.LogoHost, iaccent(), math.max(tsz * 1.8, 90), 0.7, 2) end
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.06, 0.5) end
end)
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if T then pcall(function() T:Destroy() end) end
pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end
function D.PlayIntro(force)
if D.IntroBusy or not (D.Detected and D.Active) then return end
if not force and (D.IntroPlayed or cfg("DeltaIntro") ~= true or FX.IsLowEnd()) then return end
D.IntroBusy, D.IntroPlayed = true, true
task.spawn(function()
local t0 = os.clock()
while FX.IntroActive and not force and os.clock() - t0 < 120 do task.wait(0.1) end
local ok, err = pcall(D.RunIntro)
if not ok then
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.IntroBusy = false
end)
end
function D.Apply()
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if D.Detected and D.Active then pcall(D.ApplyLogo) return end
if D.Detected and not D.Starting and cfg("DeltaEnabled") ~= false then
D.Started = false
task.spawn(D.Start)
end
end
function D.Start()
if D.Started or D.Starting then return end
D.Started, D.Starting = true, true
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if not D.Detected then
D.Status = "skipped (executor: " .. (D.Executor ~= "" and D.Executor or "unknown") .. ")"
D.Starting = false
return
end
if cfg("DeltaEnabled") == false then
D.Status = "turned off on the Customization page (applies on the next start)"
D.Starting = false
return
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if not D.Boot() then error(D.Status, 0) end
local btn, api = D.WaitIcon(75)
if not btn then error("Delta icon not found", 0) end
D.Button, D.Api = btn, api
D.Main = btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
D.Active = true
D.Status = "active"
D.ApplyLogo()
D.BindMotion()
D.PlayIntro(false)
end)
if not ok then
D.Active = false
D.Status = tostring(err)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta bridge off (script unaffected): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.Starting = false
end
D.Exec = (function()
local X = {Version = "1.0"}
local RS = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local stats = {hits = 0, misses = 0, compiled = 0, failed = 0, runs = 0, errors = 0, jobs = 0, compileMs = 0, savedMs = 0}
local cache, entries, bytes, stamp = {}, {}, 0, 0
local jobs, head, tail, conn = {}, 1, 0, nil
local once = {}
local function tier()
local prof = type(_G) == "table" and _G.UHDevProfile
return type(prof) == "table" and tonumber(prof.Tier) or 3
end
local function limits()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 then return 8, 1048576 end
if t == 2 then return 16, 2097152 end
return 32, 4194304
end
local function frameBudget()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 or FX.IsLowEnd() then return 0.002 end
return t == 2 and 0.003 or 0.005
end
local function evict()
local maxN, maxB = limits()
while #entries > maxN or bytes > maxB do
local oi, ot = 1, math.huge
for i, e in ipairs(entries) do
if e.t < ot then oi, ot = i, e.t end
end
local e = table.remove(entries, oi)
if not e then break end
local bc = cache[e.chunk]
if bc then
bc[e.src] = nil
if next(bc) == nil then cache[e.chunk] = nil end
end
bytes -= e.size
end
end
local function tb(e)
local ok, t = pcall(debug.traceback, tostring(e), 2)
return ok and t or tostring(e)
end
function X.Compile(src, chunk, opts)
if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then return nil, "empty source" end
chunk = chunk or "=UhDelta"
local ls = loadstring or load
if type(ls) ~= "function" then return nil, "loadstring unavailable" end
local bc = cache[chunk]
local e = bc and bc[src]
if e then
stats.hits += 1
stats.savedMs += e.ms
stamp += 1
e.t = stamp
return e.fn
end
local t0 = os.clock()
local fn, err = ls(src, chunk)
local ms = (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
stats.misses += 1
if type(fn) ~= "function" then
stats.failed += 1
return nil, err
end
stats.compiled += 1
stats.compileMs += ms
local _, maxB = limits()
if not (type(opts) == "table" and opts.nocache) and #src <= maxB // 2 then
stamp += 1
local ent = {chunk = chunk, src = src, fn = fn, size = #src, ms = ms, t = stamp}
if not bc then bc = {} cache[chunk] = bc end
bc[src] = ent
entries[#entries + 1] = ent
bytes += ent.size
evict()
end
return fn
end
function X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
local fn, err = X.Compile(src, chunk)
if not fn then
stats.errors += 1
return false, err
end
stats.runs += 1
local res = table.pack(xpcall(fn, tb, ...))
if not res[1] then stats.errors += 1 end
return table.unpack(res, 1, res.n)
end
function X.RunAsync(src, chunk, ...)
return task.spawn(function(...)
local ok, err = X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] " .. tostring(err)) end
end, ...)
end
function X.ReadFile(path)
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil, "readfile unavailable" end
local okE, ex = pcall(isfile, path)
if not (okE and ex) then return nil, "file not found: " .. tostring(path) end
local ok, body = pcall(readfile, path)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body end
return nil, "unreadable or empty file: " .. tostring(path)
end
function X.RunFile(path, ...)
local body, err = X.ReadFile(path)
if not body then return false, err end
return X.Run(body, "@" .. tostring(path), ...)
end
local function stop()
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
end
local function runJob(j)
local ok, err = pcall(j.fn, table.unpack(j.args, 1, j.n))
if not ok then
stats.errors += 1
warn("[UhDelta] queued job failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
local function pump()
local t0, budget = os.clock(), frameBudget()
while head <= tail do
local j = jobs[head]
jobs[head] = nil
head += 1
if j and not j.cancelled then
stats.jobs += 1
task.spawn(runJob, j)
end
if os.clock() - t0 >= budget then break end
end
if head > tail then
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
end
local function cancelJob(j) j.cancelled = true end
function X.Queue(fn, ...)
if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
local j = {fn = fn, args = {...}, n = select("#", ...), Cancel = cancelJob}
tail += 1
jobs[tail] = j
if not conn then conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(pump) end
return j
end
function X.Batch(list, onDone)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local total = #list
local left = total
for i = 1, total do
local item = list[i]
X.Queue(function()
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if type(item) == "function" then
item()
elseif type(item) == "table" then
local okR, errR
if item.File then okR, errR = X.RunFile(item.File) else okR, errR = X.Run(item.Source, item.Name) end
if not okR then error(errR, 0) end
end
end)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] batch item " .. i .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
left -= 1
if left == 0 and type(onDone) == "function" then onDone() end
end)
end
return total
end
function X.Preload(list)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
for _, item in ipairs(list) do
if type(item) == "table" then X.Queue(X.Compile, item.Source, item.Name) end
end
return #list
end
function X.Once(key, fn, ...)
if once[key] then return false end
once[key] = true
return true, fn(...)
end
function X.Debounce(fn, wait)
local token = 0
return function(...)
token += 1
local my, n, args = token, select("#", ...), {...}
task.delay(wait or 0.25, function()
if my == token then fn(table.unpack(args, 1, n)) end
end)
end
end
function X.Throttle(fn, interval)
local last = -math.huge
return function(...)
local now = os.clock()
if now - last >= (interval or 0.25) then
last = now
return fn(...)
end
end
end
function X.Memo(fn, max)
local store, count = {}, 0
max = max or 256
return function(k)
if k == nil then return fn(k) end
local v = store[k]
if v == nil then
v = fn(k)
if v ~= nil then
if count >= max then table.clear(store) count = 0 end
store[k] = v
count += 1
end
end
return v
end
end
function X.Stats()
return {
Hits = stats.hits, Misses = stats.misses, Compiled = stats.compiled, Failed = stats.failed,
Runs = stats.runs, Errors = stats.errors, JobsRun = stats.jobs,
Cached = #entries, CachedBytes = bytes, Queued = math.max(0, tail - head + 1),
CompileMs = math.floor(stats.compileMs + 0.5),
EstimatedSavedMs = math.floor(stats.savedMs + 0.5),
}
end
function X.Clear()
table.clear(cache)
table.clear(entries)
bytes = 0
for i = head, tail do
local j = jobs[i]
if j then j.cancelled = true end
jobs[i] = nil
end
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
function X.Sync()
local on = D.Detected and FX.Cfg.DeltaExecHelpers ~= false
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
pcall(function()
local cur = rawget(genv, "UhDeltaAPI")
if on then
if cur ~= X then
if type(cur) == "table" and type(cur.Clear) == "function" then pcall(cur.Clear) end
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", X)
end
elseif cur == X then
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", nil)
end
end)
if not on then X.Clear() end
end
return X
end)()
pcall(D.Detect)
FX.OnLowEnd(function() pcall(D.Apply) end)
return D
end)()
return FX
end)()
Util.LoopedHSV = function(h, s, v)
h %= 1
s = math.clamp(s, 0, 1)
v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
end
Util.DiscoPalette = {
Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 160), Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 48), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90),
Color3.fromRGB(70, 222, 255), Color3.fromRGB(160, 110, 255),
}
Util.DiscoColor = function(step)
local p = Util.DiscoPalette
local n = #p
step = step % n
local i = math.floor(step)
return p[i + 1]:Lerp(p[(i + 1) % n + 1], step - i)
end
Util.Instance = function(cl, p)
local i = Instance.new(cl)
i.Name = Util.RandomString()
i.Parent = p
return i
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C = function(a, b)
a.Destroying:Once(function()
b:Disconnect()
end)
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2I = function(a, b)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(b, a.Destroying:Once(function()
task.defer(b.Destroy, b)
end))
end
Util.ClearAllChildrenGui = function(a)
for _,v in a:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("GuiObject") then
v:Destroy()
end
end
end
Util.GetTransparency = function(part)
return 1 - (1 - part.Transparency) * (1 - part.LocalTransparencyModifier)
end
Util.ScaleCFrame = function(cf, scale)
return cf + cf.Position * (scale - 1)
end
Util.IsGuiVisible = function(guiObject)
if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
while guiObject do
if not guiObject.Visible then
return false
end
guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
end
return true
end
Util.GetTouchJump = function()
local c = Util.TouchCache
if not c then c = {next = 0} Util.TouchCache = c end
local tg = c.tg
if not tg or not tg.Parent then
tg, c.tg, c.jb = nil, nil, nil
local now = os.clock()
if now >= c.next then
c.next = now + 0.5
local pl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local pg = pl and pl:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
tg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
c.tg = tg
end
end
if not tg then return nil, nil end
local jb = c.jb
if not jb or not jb:IsDescendantOf(tg) then
local tf = tg:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
jb = tf and tf:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
c.jb = jb
end
return tg, jb
end
Util.IsGuiInteractable = function(guiObject)
if not guiObject or not guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
while guiObject do
if not guiObject.Visible or not guiObject.Interactable then
return false
end
guiObject = guiObject:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiObject")
end
return true
end
Util.WillGuiSinkInput = function(guiObject)
return Util.IsGuiInteractable(guiObject) and (guiObject.Active or guiObject:IsA("GuiButton"))
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Scale = function(x)
return Vector2.new(x.X.Scale, x.Y.Scale)
end
Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset = function(x)
return Vector2.new(x.X.Offset, x.Y.Offset)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale = function(x)
return UDim2.fromScale(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset = function(x)
return UDim2.fromOffset(x.X, x.Y)
end
Util.ForceTextSize = function(inst)
if inst:IsA("TextLabel") then
local original = inst.TextSize
local conn conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
local size = GuiService.PreferredTextSize.Name
if size == "Medium" then
inst.TextSize = original
elseif size == "Large" then
inst.TextSize = original - 4
elseif size == "Larger" then
inst.TextSize = original - 9
elseif size == "Largest" then
inst.TextSize = original - 14
end
end)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(inst, conn)
end
end
Util.QueryPlayerSelector = function(query, excludespeaker)
if #query == 0 then return end
query = query:lower()
local t = {}
for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
if player ~= Player or not excludespeaker then
local a = player.DisplayName:lower():find(query)
local b = player.Name:lower():find(query)
if a then table.insert(t, {player, 1, a}) end
if b then table.insert(t, {player, 0, b}) end
end
end
table.sort(t, function(a, b)
if a[2] == b[2] then
return a[3] < b[3]
end
return a[2] < b[2]
end)
if t[1] then
return t[1][1]
end
return nil
end

	TickRate = 1,

		local part = ctx.Torso or ctx.RootPart

		if lastCF and lastT and now - lastT < (CRM.LowEnd() and 0.05 or 0.033) and (p - lastPos).Magnitude < 4 then

		local y = p.Y - (ctx.Streaming and 16 or 64)

		return st
	end,

		if st then R.ReplicateFPS10 = st.fps10 end
		lastCF = nil
	end,
	Tick = function(R)

			if typeof(k) == "Instance" and not k.Parent then R._TempNotFling[k] = nil end
		end

local redownloadeverything = SaveData.CDNVersion ~= CDNVersion
local theresassetsmissing = redownloadeverything
for _,rfile in AllFileNames do
local fil = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. rfile
local s, d = pcall(isfile, fil)
if not (s and d) then
theresassetsmissing = true
end
end
if theresassetsmissing then
local downloaded = 0
local skipped = 0
local assetsdownload = 0
local downloadfile = function(meta)
local fil = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. meta.name
if not redownloadeverything then
local s, d = pcall(isfile, fil)
if s and d then
downloaded += 1
return
end
end
if not pcall(function()
writefile(fil, game:HttpGet(meta.download_url))
end) then skipped += 1 end
downloaded += 1
end
local Downloading = Util.Instance("TextLabel", UIMainFrame)
Downloading.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
Downloading.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
Downloading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
Downloading.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
Downloading.ClipsDescendants = true
Downloading.BorderSizePixel = 0
Downloading.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Downloading.TextSize = 20
Downloading.Font = Enum.Font.Code
Downloading.Text = "Fetching Assets metadata..."
Util.ForceTextSize(Downloading)
TweenService:Create(Downloading, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
}):Play()
task.wait(0.5)
local s, assetsof = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/uiassets/")
if s and assetsof then
s, assetsof = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, assetsof)
if s and assetsof then
for i,file in assetsof do
if not table.find(AllFileNames, file.name) then
continue
end
assetsdownload += 1
task.spawn(downloadfile, file)
end
repeat
Downloading.Text = `Downloading assets {downloaded}/{assetsdownload}... ({skipped} skipped)`
Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
task.wait()
until downloaded == assetsdownload
Downloading.Text = "Download complete! \\(^o^)/"
Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 1, 0)
theresassetsmissing = false
end
end
SaveData.CDNVersion = CDNVersion
if theresassetsmissing then
Downloading.Text = "Asset downloading failed. 3:"
Downloading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
end
TweenService:Create(Downloading, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
}):Play()
task.wait(0.5)
Downloading:Destroy()
end
end
Util.GetCDNAsset = function(filename)
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. filename
local s, id = pcall(isfile, path)
if s and id then
s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
if s then return id end
end
return ""
end
Util.MakeTriforce = function(tris, color, dur)
dur = dur or 8
local function CreateTriangle(parent, radius, width, rotation, color)
local height = (math.sqrt(3) / 2) * width
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
pivot.Rotation = rotation
local tri = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", pivot)
tri.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
tri.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - radius, 0)
tri.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, height, 0)
tri.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tri.BorderSizePixel = 0
tri.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("letriangul.graphic.png")
local grey = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B) * 0.5
tri.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(grey, grey, grey)
TweenService:Create(tri, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
ImageColor3 = color
}):Play()
end
local radius = 0.1
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
local width = 2 * radius * math.sin(math.pi / tris) * 2
for i=1, tris do
CreateTriangle(pivot, radius, width, (i / tris) * 360, color)
end
return pivot
end
Util.MakeText = function(text)
text = text:upper()
local ls = "BCDEIKOPQRSTUVYZ\\_`N^MJ"
local lt = ""
lt ..= "DDDDD@DFF@@@@@FSFSFSF@@@@@@@@@@@@@@EMMUKKTDD@@@@@DEEEEEDDBBBBBD@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@DE@@@G@@@@@@@@@DABBDEEI"
lt ..= "GJJJJJGDVDDDDSGJAGIISRAAGAARWJJSAAASIIRAARGIIRJJGSAABBDDGJJGJJGGJJHAAG"
lt ..= "@DD@DD@@DD@DE@@BDEDB@@@G@G@@@EDBDE@GJABD@D@@@@@@@"
lt ..= "DFJSJJJRJJRJJRGJIIIJGRJJJJJRSIIRIISSIIRIIIHIILJJHJJJSJJJGDDDDDGAAAAAJHJKMOMKJIIIIIISJQNJJJJJJPNLJJGJJJJJGRJJRIIIGJJJNGCRJJRMKJGJIGAJGSDDDDDDJJJJJJGJJJJJFDJJJNQJJJJFDFJJJJFDDDDSABDEIS"
local pixs = {}
local totalsize = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = {}
for j=1, text:len() do
local c = text:byte(j, j)
local w = 0
if c ~= 0x20 then
local k = (c - 33) * 7 + i
w = lt:byte(k + 1, k + 1)
if w ~= nil and w > 64 then
w = ls:byte(w - 64, w - 64) - 65
else
w = 0
end
end
for k=0, 5 do
local h = (j - 1) * 6 + (4 - k)
totalsize = math.max(totalsize, h + 1)
local p = (w // math.pow(2, k)) % 2
if p > 0 then
row[h] = true
end
end
end
pixs[i] = row
end
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalsize, 0, 7)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = pixs[i]
local olde = nil
local olds = 0
for j=0, totalsize - 1 do
local pix = row[j]
if pix == true then
if olde ~= nil then
olds += 1
olde.Size = UDim2.new(olds / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
else
olde = Util.Instance("Frame", pivot)
olde.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
olde.Position = UDim2.new(j / totalsize, 0, i / 7, 0)
olde.Size = UDim2.new(1 / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
olde.BackgroundTransparency = 1
olde.BorderSizePixel = 0
olds = 1
end
else
olde = nil
olds = 0
end
end
end
return pivot
end

for _,v in text:GetChildren() do
v.BackgroundColor3 = color
v.BackgroundTransparency = tran
end
end

TS.Samples = TS.Samples or {
{1, "49443303000000000023545353450000"},
{368895, "81688de9aa99ef04dfee573b97c4d729"},
{737790, "4ed0c37d8d4a414b1a58afd000087b5c"},
{1106670, "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"},
}
TS.Progress = 0
TS.Why = nil
local B64, La, Lb, Lc, Ld = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
do
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
for i = 1, 64 do
local v, ch = i - 1, alphabet:byte(i)
B64[ch] = v
La[ch] = v * 4
Lb[ch] = v // 16 + (v % 16) * 4096
Lc[ch] = (v // 4) * 256 + (v % 4) * 4194304
Ld[ch] = v * 65536
end
B64[61], La[61], Lb[61], Lc[61], Ld[61] = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end
local function hex(s)
return (s:gsub(".", function(ch) return string.format("%02x", ch:byte()) end))
end
local function verify(body)
if type(body) ~= "string" or #body ~= TS.Bytes or body:sub(1, 3) ~= "ID3" then return false end
for _, sm in ipairs(TS.Samples) do
if hex(body:sub(sm[1], sm[1] + 15)) ~= sm[2] then return false end
end
return true
end
local function decodeNative(chunks)
local joined = table.concat(chunks)
local getters = {
function() return crypt.base64decode end,
function() return crypt.base64_decode end,
function() return crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return syn.crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return base64_decode end,
function() return base64decode end,
function() return base64.decode end,
}
for _, get in ipairs(getters) do
local okG, fn = pcall(get)
if okG and type(fn) == "function" then
local okD, res = pcall(fn, joined)
if okD and verify(res) then return res end
end
end
return nil
end
local function decodeLua(chunks)
local sbyte, schar, concat = string.byte, string.char, table.concat
local nchars = 0
for _, s in ipairs(chunks) do nchars = nchars + #s end
local lastChunk = chunks[#chunks]
local pad = (lastChunk:sub(-2) == "==") and 2 or ((lastChunk:sub(-1) == "=") and 1 or 0)
local size = nchars // 4 * 3 - pad
local t0 = os.clock()
local total = #chunks
if type(buffer) == "table" and buffer.create and buffer.writeu32 and buffer.readstring then
local buf = buffer.create(size + 8)
local writeu32 = buffer.writeu32
local pos = 0
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
writeu32(buf, pos, La[a] + Lb[b] + Lc[c] + Ld[d])
pos = pos + 3
end
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
return buffer.readstring(buf, 0, size)
end
local out = {}
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
local parts, pn = {}, 0
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
local v = (B64[a] or 0) * 262144 + (B64[b] or 0) * 4096 + (B64[c] or 0) * 64 + (B64[d] or 0)
pn = pn + 1
parts[pn] = schar(v // 65536, (v // 256) % 256, v % 256)
end
out[ci] = concat(parts)
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
local body = concat(out)
if pad > 0 then body = body:sub(1, #body - pad) end
return body
end
local function unpack64(chunks)
local okN, res = pcall(decodeNative, chunks)
if okN and res then return res end
local okL, body = pcall(decodeLua, chunks)
if okL and verify(body) then return body end
TS.Why = okL and "bundled data failed verification (script text damaged?)" or ("decode error: " .. tostring(body))
return nil
end
TS.Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. TS.File
TS.Period = 60 / TS.Bpm
local busy, failed = false, false
local function url()
if X then return nil end
local u = _G.UhhhhhhThemeSongUrl
if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then u = THEME_SONG_URL end
u = tostring(u):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if u:match("^https?://%S+$") then return u end
return nil
end
local verified = false
function TS.Cached()
if verified then return true end
local ok, v = pcall(isfile, TS.Path)
if not (ok and v == true) then return false end
if type(readfile) == "function" then
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
if okR and type(data) == "string" and #data < TS.MinBytes then
pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(TS.Path) end end)
return false
end
end
verified = true
return true
end
local function fetch(u)
local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, u)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then return body end
if type(request) == "function" then
local ok2, res = pcall(request, {Url = u, Method = "GET"})
if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Success == true) and type(res.Body) == "string" then
return res.Body
end
end
return nil
end
local function looksLikeMp3(b)
if #b < TS.MinBytes then return false end
if b:sub(1, 3) == "ID3" then return true end
local b1, b2 = b:byte(1, 2)
return b1 == 0xFF and b2 ~= nil and b2 >= 0xE0
end
function TS.Ensure(wait)
if TS.Cached() then return true end
local u = url()
local chunks = (X and X.Data or THEME_SONG_DATA)()
local bundled = type(chunks) == "table" and #chunks > 0
if failed or not (u or bundled) then return false end
if not busy then
busy = true
task.spawn(function()
local function sizeOk()
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return true end
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
return okR and type(data) == "string" and #data == TS.Bytes
end
local function save(body)
pcall(function()
if not isfolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") then makefolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") end
end)
local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, TS.Path, body)
if okW and sizeOk() then return true end
if type(appendfile) == "function" then
local okP = pcall(function()
for i = 1, #body, 262144 do
local piece = body:sub(i, i + 262143)
if i == 1 then writefile(TS.Path, piece) else appendfile(TS.Path, piece) end
end
end)
if okP and sizeOk() then return true end
end
TS.Why = "could not write " .. TS.Path .. (okW and " (file came out the wrong size)" or (": " .. tostring(errW)))
return false
end
local ok = pcall(function()
if bundled then
local body = unpack64(chunks)
if body and save(body) then return end
end
if u then
for attempt = 1, 2 do
local body = fetch(u)
if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
end
end
end)
if not (ok and TS.Cached()) then
failed = true
local why = TS.Why or "no bundled data and no valid THEME_SONG_URL"
warn("[Uhhhhhh] " .. (X and "Intro 2 song" or "theme song") .. " unavailable - " .. why .. (X and ". Using the original intro." or ". Using the old default track."))
pcall(function() Util.UINotify((X and "Intro 2 song" or "Theme song") .. " unavailable: " .. why) end)
end
busy = false
end)
end
local t0 = os.clock()
while busy and os.clock() - t0 < (wait or 0) do task.wait(0.1) end
return TS.Cached()
end
function TS.IsPlaying(snd)
local ok, r = pcall(function() return snd.Name == TS.Title and snd.IsPlaying end)
return ok and r == true
end
function TS.Beat(pos)
local n = (pos - TS.Offset) / TS.Period
local i = math.floor(n)
return i, n - i
end
return TS
end

Util.Color = (function()
local C = {}
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
C.Cur = WHITE
C.ThemeCol = WHITE
local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
return (a + d * k) % 1
end
function C.Init()
local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2)
end
end
function C.Base()
local c = cfg()
return Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
end
function C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
elseif m == 5 then return {h}
end
return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
end
local function music()
local ok, v = pcall(function()
local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
return 0
end)
return ok and v or 0
end
function C.Resolve(t, theme)
local c = cfg()
C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
local mode = c.AccentMode or 1
local sp = c.ColorSpeed or 1
local out = C.ThemeCol
local base = C.Base()
local bh, bs, bv = base:ToHSV()
if mode == 2 then
out = Util.ParseHex(c.UIAccent or "") or C.ThemeCol
elseif mode == 3 then
out = Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.1 * sp) % 1, 0.8, 1)
elseif mode == 4 then
local hues = C.HarmonyHues(bh)
local pos = (t * 0.12 * sp) % #hues
local i = math.floor(pos)
local k = pos - i
k = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
local h = hueLerp(hues[i + 1], hues[(i + 1) % #hues + 1], k)
out = Color3.fromHSV(h, math.max(bs, 0.55), math.max(bv, 0.85))
elseif mode == 5 then
local h = bh + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.5 * sp) + 0.07 * math.sin(t * 0.31 * sp + 1.7)
out = Color3.fromHSV(h % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.9 + 0.1 * math.sin(t * 0.8 * sp))
elseif mode == 6 then
local l = clamp(music() / 700, 0, 1)
C._ml = (C._ml or 0) + (l - (C._ml or 0)) * 0.25
out = Color3.fromHSV((bh + C._ml * 0.28) % 1, math.max(bs, 0.6), 0.7 + 0.3 * C._ml)
elseif mode == 7 then
local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) + tonumber(os.date("%M")) / 60
local stops = {{0, 0.64, 0.7}, {5, 0.62, 0.8}, {7, 0.06, 1}, {12, 0.53, 1}, {17, 0.08, 1}, {19.5, 0.92, 0.9}, {22, 0.7, 0.75}, {24, 0.64, 0.7}}
local a, b = stops[1], stops[2]
for i = 1, #stops - 1 do if hr >= stops[i][1] and hr <= stops[i + 1][1] then a, b = stops[i], stops[i + 1] end end
local k = (hr - a[1]) / math.max(0.001, b[1] - a[1])
out = Color3.fromHSV(hueLerp(a[2], b[2], k), 0.75, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * k)
end
local FA = Util.FX and Util.FX.Audio
if FA and mode ~= 6 then out = FA.Tint(out) end
if (c.ColorSat or 1) == 1 and (c.ColorBright or 1) == 1 then C.Cur = out return out end
local h, s, v = out:ToHSV()
out = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * (c.ColorSat or 1), 0, 1), clamp(v * (c.ColorBright or 1), 0, 1))
C.Cur = out
return out
end
function C.Palette(t)
local a = C.Cur
local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
local sec, ter
if m == 5 then
sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
else
sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
end
return {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
end
return C
end)()
Util.FX.InitCustom(SaveData)
do
pcall(function()
local FX = Util.FX
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if genv.NA_AUTO_PERF == false or _G.NA_AUTO_PERF == false then return end
local function try(f, ...)
local ok, r = pcall(f, ...)
if ok then return r end
end
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local pn = tostring(try(function() return UIS:GetPlatform() end) or "")
local mobile
if pn:find("IOS") or pn:find("Android") then
mobile = true
elseif pn:find("Windows") or pn:find("OSX") or pn:find("Linux") or pn:find("SteamOS") then
mobile = false
else
mobile = try(function() return UIS.TouchEnabled and not (UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled) end) == true
end
local function toGB(v)
v = tonumber(v)
if not v or v ~= v or v <= 0 then return nil end
local g
if v < 256 then g = v
elseif v < 131072 then g = v / 1024
elseif v < 2e8 then g = v / 1048576
else g = v / 2 ^ 30 end
if g < 0.5 or g > 256 then return nil end
return g
end
local BAD = {"avail", "free", "used", "usage", "limit", "process", "heap", "swap", "virtual", "cache"}
local function badKey(k)
for _, w in ipairs(BAD) do if k:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end
return false
end
local function fromTable(t, depth)
if type(t) ~= "table" or depth > 2 then return nil, 0 end
local best, bestRank = nil, 0
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
local g, rank = nil, 0
if type(v) == "table" then
g, rank = fromTable(v, depth + 1)
elseif ks ~= "" and not badKey(ks) then
local mem = ks:find("memory", 1, true) or ks:find("^ram") or ks:find("[^a-z]ram") or ks:find("ram$")
if mem and (ks:find("total", 1, true) or ks:find("physical", 1, true) or ks:find("install", 1, true)) then
rank = 2
elseif ks == "ram" or ks == "memory" or ks == "ramgb" or ks == "ram_gb" or ks == "memorygb" then
rank = 1
end
if rank > 0 then g = toGB(v) end
end
if g and rank > bestRank then best, bestRank = g, rank end
end
return best, bestRank
end
local function procMB() return tonumber(try(function() return game:GetService("Stats"):GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)) end
local gb, src, conf
gb = toGB(genv.NA_RAM_GB or _G.NA_RAM_GB)
if gb then src, conf = "manual", "exact" end
if not gb then
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceram", "getdevicememory", "gettotalram", "getsystemram", "getsystemmemory", "getramsize", "getphysicalmemory", "gettotalmemory", "getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo"}) do
local fn = genv[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = try(fn)
local g, rank
if type(r) == "table" then g, rank = fromTable(r, 0) else g, rank = toGB(r), 2 end
if g then
gb, src, conf = g, n, (rank >= 2) and "high" or "medium"
break
end
end
end
end
local manualTier = tonumber(genv.NA_PERF_TIER or _G.NA_PERF_TIER)
local tier = manualTier
if tier then
src, conf = src or "manual-tier", conf or "exact"
elseif gb then
tier = (gb < 2.5 and 1) or (gb < 5 and 2) or (gb < 9 and 3) or 4
if mobile and conf == "medium" then
for _, bd in ipairs({2.5, 5, 9}) do
if gb >= bd and gb < bd + 0.4 then tier = math.max(1, tier - 1) break end
end
end
else
tier = mobile and 2 or 4
src, conf = "fallback", "none"
end
tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tier), 1, 4)
local prof = {Mobile = mobile, RAM = gb, PhysicalGB = gb, RAMSource = src, Confidence = conf, ProcessMB = procMB(), Pressure = false}
FX.Device = prof
_G.UHDevProfile = prof
pcall(function() genv.UHDevProfile = prof end)
local function apply(t)
prof.Tier, prof.Class = t, ({"low", "low", "mid", "high"})[t]
prof.LowEnd, prof.AntiLag, prof.AssetMode = t == 1, t == 1, ({"Batch", "Medium", "Medium"})[t]
FX.LowEndTriFPS = t == 1 and 20 or 30
FX.LowEndUIFPS = t == 1 and 20 or 30
local store = FX.Store
if store then
local want = t == 1
local was = store.AutoLow
if was == nil and type(store.AutoTier) == "number" then was = store.AutoTier <= 2 end
if was ~= want then
if want then FX.SetLowEnd(true) elseif was then FX.SetLowEnd(false) end
store.AutoLow = want
end
end
if t < 4 then
try(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = string.format("Level%02d", ({1, 3, 5})[t]) end)
try(function() game:GetService("Lighting").GlobalShadows = false end)
if t <= 2 then
try(function()
local tr = workspace.Terrain
tr.WaterWaveSize = 0
tr.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
tr.WaterReflectance = 0
end)
elseif type(setfpscap) == "function" then
try(setfpscap, mobile and 120 or 999)
end
if mobile and t <= 2 then
try(function() workspace.Terrain.Decoration = false end)
try(function() settings().Rendering.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level04 end)
if type(setfpscap) == "function" then try(setfpscap, t == 1 and 30 or 60) end
end
end
end
apply(tier)
if mobile and gb and not manualTier then
task.delay(20, function()
pcall(function()
local used = procMB()
if not used then return end
prof.ProcessMB = used
if used / 1024 > gb * 0.6 and prof.Tier > 1 then
prof.Pressure = true
apply(prof.Tier - 1)
end
end)
end)
end
if SaveData.ModuleLoadMode == nil and tier <= 2 then
SaveData.ModuleLoadMode = tier == 1 and 4 or 2
end
end)
end

Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
local U = Util.UhAdmin
local S = U.State
local function each(f)
for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do

elseif ev == "close" then
S.open = false
elseif ev == "type" then
S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
elseif ev == "run" then
S.flash = 1
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
elseif ev == "unknown" then
S.shake = 1
each(function(t)
t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
end
end
local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
local UH_TAG_BG = "UhAdmin_BG"
local UH_TAG_TEXT = "UhAdmin_Text"
local function uhTag(obj, kind)
local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
end
do
local uhThemeLast, uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = 0, nil, nil, nil, -1, 0
local uhTagLists, uhIsStroke = {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function uhQualAccent(o)
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then uhIsStroke[o] = true return true end
return o:IsA("GuiObject")
end
local function uhQualGui(o) return o:IsA("GuiObject") end
local function uhQualText(o) return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") end
local function uhTagList(tag, qualifies)
local c = uhTagLists[tag]
if c then return c end
c = {n = 0, arr = {}, idx = {}}
uhTagLists[tag] = c
local function add(o)
if c.idx[o] or not qualifies(o) then return end
local n = c.n + 1
c.n, c.arr[n], c.idx[o] = n, o, n
end
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(add)
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(function(o)
local at = c.idx[o]
if not at then return end
local n = c.n
local last = c.arr[n]
c.arr[at], c.idx[last] = last, at
c.arr[n], c.idx[o], c.n = nil, nil, n - 1
end)
for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do add(o) end
return c
end
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local now = os.clock()
if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
uhThemeLast = now
local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
end
local uhSig = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText).n
if accent == uhLastA and bg == uhLastB and textCol == uhLastT and uhSig == uhLastN and now - uhFullAt < 0.4 then return end
uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = accent, bg, textCol, uhSig, now
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do
local o = arr[n]
if uhIsStroke[o] then o.Color = accent else o.BackgroundColor3 = accent end
end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].BackgroundColor3 = bg end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].TextColor3 = textCol end
end
end)
end
local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end

local bringc = {}
commandcount = 0
cmd = {}
cmd._lastError = nil
cmd.add = function(...)
local vars = {...}
local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then return false end
local primary = aliases[1]
if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then
cmd._blocked = cmd._blocked or {}
for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do cmd._blocked[tostring(n):lower()] = true end
return false
end
local meta = {}
if type(info) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(info) do meta[k] = v end end
meta[1] = tostring(meta[1] or primary)
meta[2] = tostring(meta[2] or "")
primary = primary:lower()
local registration = {func, meta, aliases = {}}
if Commands[primary] == nil then commandcount = commandcount + 1 end
Commands[primary] = registration
for i = 2, #aliases do
local alias = aliases[i]
if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then
Aliases[alias:lower()] = registration
registration.aliases[#registration.aliases + 1] = alias:lower()
end
end
return true
end
cmd.run = function(args)
cmd._lastError = nil
if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
if not registration then
cmd._lastError = (cmd._blocked and cmd._blocked[caller]) and ("Command is disabled: " .. tostring(args[1])) or ("Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]))
return false, cmd._lastError
end
local arguments = {}
for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
return true
end

return coroutine.wrap(f)()
end

local wait = function(int)
if not int then int = 0 end
local t = tick()
repeat
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
until (tick() - t) >= int
return (tick() - t), t
end

local getPlr = function(Name)
if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
local players = Players:GetPlayers()
if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
if query == "" then return nil end
local prefixMatch, containsMatch
for _, x in ipairs(players) do
local user = x.Name:lower()
local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
if user == query or display == query then return x end
if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
end
return prefixMatch or containsMatch
end

elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 1
elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 1
elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T then keyboardControl.E = -1
end
end)

elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.D then keyboardControl.R = 0
elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Y then keyboardControl.Q = 0

end

local function apply(root, hum)
local bg = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyGyro") or Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.Name = "UHAdminFlyGyro"
bg.P = 100000
bg.D = 1000
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
bg.Parent = root
local bv = root:FindFirstChild("UHAdminFlyVelocity") or Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.Name = "UHAdminFlyVelocity"
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
bv.P = 10000
bv.Parent = root
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local cf = camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame
local move = Vector3.zero
move = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X, 0, cf.RightVector.Z)
if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then move = move.Unit else move = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
if right.Magnitude > 0.001 then right = right.Unit else right = Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
move = move * (keyboardControl.F + keyboardControl.B)
+ right * (keyboardControl.R + keyboardControl.L)
+ Vector3.new(0, keyboardControl.Q + keyboardControl.E, 0)
if move.Magnitude > 0.001 then
bv.Velocity = move.Unit * activeSpeed
else
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
end
local flatLook = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
flatLook = flatLook.Unit
else
flatLook = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
end
bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)
hum.AutoRotate = false
if not vfly then
hum.PlatformStand = true
else
hum.PlatformStand = false
end
end

end

lib.lock = function(instance, par)
locks[instance] = true
instance.Parent = par or instance.Parent

end
lock = lib.lock
locks = {}
lib.find = function(t, v)
for i, e in pairs(t) do
if i == v or e == v then
return i
end
end
return nil
end
lib.parseText = function(text, watch)
local parsed = {}
if type(text) ~= "string" then return parsed end
local delimiter = tostring(watch or " ")
if delimiter == "" then return {text} end
local token, quote, escape = {}, nil, false
local function push() if #token > 0 then parsed[#parsed + 1] = table.concat(token); token = {} end end
for i=1,#text do
local ch=text:sub(i,i)
if escape then token[#token+1]=ch; escape=false
elseif ch=="\\" and quote then escape=true
elseif quote then if ch==quote then quote=nil else token[#token+1]=ch end
elseif ch=="'" or ch=='"' then quote=ch
elseif delimiter==opt.prefix and ch==delimiter then push()
elseif delimiter==opt.tupleSeparator and ch==delimiter then push()
elseif delimiter==" " and ch:match("%s") then push()
else token[#token+1]=ch end
end
push(); return parsed
end
lib.parseCommand = function(text, requirePrefix)
if type(text) ~= "string" then return false end
local prefix=tostring(opt.prefix or ".")
if prefix == "" then prefix = "." end
local source=text
if requirePrefix and source:sub(1,#prefix) ~= prefix then return false end
while source:sub(1,#prefix)==prefix do source=source:sub(#prefix+1) end
if source:match("^%s*$") then return false end
local segments,current,quote={}, {}, nil
for i=1,#source do
local ch=source:sub(i,i)
if ch=="'" or ch=='"' then if quote==ch then quote=nil elseif not quote then quote=ch end; current[#current+1]=ch
elseif ch==";" and not quote then segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current); current={}
else current[#current+1]=ch end
end
segments[#segments+1]=table.concat(current)
local ran=false
for _,segment in ipairs(segments) do
local args=lib.parseText(segment," ")
if #args>0 then local ok,err=cmd.run(args); if ok then ran=true else Util.Notify("Command failed: "..tostring(err)) end end
end
return ran
end
local connections = {}
lib.connect = function(name, connection)
connections[name .. tostring(math.random(1000000, 9999999))] = connection
return connection
end
lib.disconnect = function(name)
for title, connection in pairs(connections) do
if title:find(name) == 1 then
connection:Disconnect()
end
end
end

argument.getPlayers = function(str)
local playerNames, players = lib.parseText(str, opt.tupleSeparator), {}
for _, arg in pairs(playerNames or {"me"}) do
arg = arg:lower()
local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()
if arg == "me" or arg == nil then
table.insert(players, localPlayer)
elseif arg == "all" then
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
table.insert(players, plr)
end
elseif arg == "others" then
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
if plr ~= localPlayer then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
elseif arg == "random" then
if #playerList > 0 then table.insert(players, playerList[math.random(1,#playerList)]) end
elseif arg:find("%%") == 1 then
local teamName = arg:sub(2)
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
local team=plr.Team
if team and tostring(team.Name):lower():find(teamName,1,true)==1 then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
else
for _, plr in pairs(playerList) do
if plr.Name:lower():find(arg) == 1 or (plr.DisplayName and plr.DisplayName:lower():find(arg) == 1) or (tostring(plr.UserId):lower():find(arg) == 1) then
table.insert(players, plr)
end
end
end
end
return players
end

local function SaveAdminPrefix(value)
local PrefixChange = tostring(value or "")
PrefixChange = PrefixChange:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if PrefixChange == "" or PrefixChange == "p" or PrefixChange == "[" or PrefixChange == "P" then return false end
opt.prefix = PrefixChange
if FileSupport then
pcall(function()
if isfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) and delfile then delfile(NA_PREFIX_FILE) end
writefile(NA_PREFIX_FILE, PrefixChange)
end)
end
return true
end

local pos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector + z + x + y
local look = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector - pos).unit
handle.BodyPosition.Position = pos + TargetPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
end
wait()
Mode8()
end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local AllBool = false
local GetPlayer = function(Name)
Name = Name:lower()
if Name == "all" or Name == "others" then
AllBool = true
return
elseif Name == "random" then
local GetPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
if table.find(GetPlayers,Player) then table.remove(GetPlayers,table.find(GetPlayers,Player)) end
return GetPlayers[math.random(#GetPlayers)]
elseif Name ~= "random" and Name ~= "all" and Name ~= "others" then
for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
if x ~= Player then
if x.Name:lower():match("^"..Name) then
return x;
elseif x.DisplayName:lower():match("^"..Name) then
return x;
end
end
end
else
return
end
end

local SkidFling = function(TargetPlayer)
local Character = Player.Character
local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.RootPart
local TCharacter = TargetPlayer.Character
local THumanoid
local TRootPart
local THead
local Accessory
local Handle
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
THumanoid = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.RootPart then
TRootPart = THumanoid.RootPart
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head") then
THead = TCharacter.Head
end
if TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") then
Accessory = TCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
end
if Accessoy and Accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
Handle = Accessory.Handle
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
if RootPart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
getgenv().OldPos = RootPart.CFrame
end
if THumanoid and THumanoid.Sit and not AllBool then
end
if THead then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THead
elseif not THead and Handle then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Handle
elseif THumanoid and TRootPart then
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = THumanoid
end
if not TCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then
return
end
local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
RootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
RootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
end
local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
local TimeToWait = 2
local Time = tick()
local Angle = 0
repeat
if RootPart and THumanoid then
if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
Angle = Angle + 100
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle),0 ,0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(2.25, 1.5, -2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(-2.25, -1.5, 2.25) + THumanoid.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THumanoid.MoveDirection,CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
task.wait()
else
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THumanoid.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, TRootPart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5 ,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
task.wait()
FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
task.wait()
end
else
break
end
until BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude > 500 or BasePart.Parent ~= TargetPlayer.Character or TargetPlayer.Parent ~= Players or not TargetPlayer.Character == TCharacter or THumanoid.Sit or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or tick() > Time + TimeToWait
end
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
BV.Name = "EpixVel"
BV.Parent = RootPart
BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
if TRootPart and THead then
if (TRootPart.CFrame.p - THead.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then
SFBasePart(THead)
else
SFBasePart(TRootPart)
end
elseif TRootPart and not THead then
SFBasePart(TRootPart)
elseif not TRootPart and THead then
SFBasePart(THead)
elseif not TRootPart and not THead and Accessory and Handle then
SFBasePart(Handle)
else
end
BV:Destroy()
Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
repeat
RootPart.CFrame = getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0)
Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(getgenv().OldPos * CFrame.new(0, .5, 0))
Humanoid:ChangeState("GettingUp")
table.foreach(Character:GetChildren(), function(_, x)
if x:IsA("BasePart") then
x.Velocity, x.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(), Vector3.new()
end
end)
task.wait()
until (RootPart.Position - getgenv().OldPos.p).Magnitude < 25
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = getgenv().FPDH
else
end
end
getgenv().Welcome = true
if Targets[1] then for _,x in next, Targets do GetPlayer(x) end else return end
if AllBool then
for _,x in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
SkidFling(x)
end
end
for _,x in next, Targets do
if GetPlayer(x) and GetPlayer(x) ~= Player then
if GetPlayer(x).UserId ~= 1414978355 then
local TPlayer = GetPlayer(x)
if TPlayer then
SkidFling(TPlayer)
end
else
end
elseif not GetPlayer(x) and not AllBool then
end
end
end
end)
end)

local Ping = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Pingtext = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local UIAspectRatioConstraint = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
Ping.Name = "Ping"

local WalkFling = {Enabled = false, Running = false}
Util.UhAdmin.WalkFling = WalkFling
local function setWalkFling(enabled)
WalkFling.Enabled = enabled and true or false
if not WalkFling.Enabled or WalkFling.Running then return end
WalkFling.Running = true
task.spawn(function()
local movel = 0.1
while WalkFling.Enabled do
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
if not WalkFling.Enabled then break end
local c = Player.Character
local hrp = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
if c and c.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent then
local vel = hrp.Velocity
hrp.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
hrp.Velocity = vel
end
RunService.Stepped:Wait()
if WalkFling.Enabled and c.Parent and hrp.Parent then
hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
movel = movel * -1
end
end
end
WalkFling.Running = false
end)
end

cf = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

local abort = 0
local function getTools(amt)
if not amt then amt = 1 end
local toolAmount, grabbed = 0, {}
local lastCF = character.PrimaryPart.CFrame
local ab = abort
for i, v in pairs(localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("BackpackItem") then
toolAmount = toolAmount + 1
end
end
if toolAmount >= amt then return localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):GetChildren() end
if not localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack"):FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem") then return end
repeat
repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
wrap(function()
repeat wait() until backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BackpackItem")
for _, tool in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
if #grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort then break end
if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
tool.Parent = localPlayer
table.insert(grabbed, tool)
end
end
end)
respawn()
wait(.1)
until
#grabbed >= amt or ab ~= abort
repeat wait() until localPlayer.Character and tostring(localPlayer.Character) ~= "respawn_" and localPlayer.Character == character
wait(.2)
repeat wait() until localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack") or ab ~= abort
local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
for _, tool in pairs(grabbed) do
if tool:IsA("BackpackItem") then
tool.Parent = backpack
end
end
wrap(function()
repeat wait() until character.PrimaryPart
wait(.2)
character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(lastCF)
end)
wait(.2)
return grabbed
end

BaseParts = {};
FakeConnections = {};
Connections = {};
Output = {
Enabled = true;
Prefix = "[NETWORK] ";
Send = function(Type,Output,BypassOutput)
if typeof(Type) == "function" and (Type == print or Type == warn or Type == error) and typeof(Output) == "string" and (typeof(BypassOutput) == "nil" or typeof(BypassOutput) == "boolean") then
if Network["Output"].Enabled == true or BypassOutput == true then
Type(Network["Output"].Prefix..Output);
end;
elseif Network["Output"].Enabled == true then
error(Network["Output"].Prefix.."Output Send Error : Invalid syntax.");
end;
end;
};
CharacterRelative = false;
}
Network["Output"].Send(print,": Loading.")
Network["Velocity"] = Vector3.new(14.46262424,14.46262424,14.46262424);
Network["RetainPart"] = function(Part,ReturnFakePart)
assert(typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(workspace),Network["Output"].Prefix.."RetainPart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg1 (Part) must be a BasePart which is a descendant of workspace.")
assert(typeof(ReturnFakePart) == "boolean" or typeof(ReturnFakePart) == "nil",Network["Output"].Prefix.."RetainPart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg2 (ReturnFakePart) must be a boolean or nil.")
if not table.find(Network["BaseParts"],Part) then
if Network.CharacterRelative == true then
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
if Character and Character.PrimaryPart then
local Distance = (Character.PrimaryPart.Position-Part.Position).Magnitude
if Distance > 1000 then
Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as it is more than "..gethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer,"MaximumSimulationRadius").." studs away.")
return false
end
else
Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as the LocalPlayer Character's PrimaryPart does not exist.")
return false
end
end
table.insert(Network["BaseParts"],Part)
Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,0,0,0,0)
Network["Output"].Send(print,"PartOwnership Output : PartOwnership applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..".")
if ReturnFakePart == true then
return FakePart
end
else
Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RetainPart Warning : PartOwnership not applied to BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..", as it already active.")
return false
end
end
Network["RemovePart"] = function(Part)
assert(typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart"),Network["Output"].Prefix.."RemovePart Error : Invalid syntax: Arg1 (Part) must be a BasePart.")
local Index = table.find(Network["BaseParts"],Part)
if Index then
table.remove(Network["BaseParts"],Index)
Network["Output"].Send(print,"RemovePart Output: PartOwnership removed from BasePart "..Part:GetFullName()..".")
else
Network["Output"].Send(warn,"RemovePart Warning : BasePart "..Part:GetFullName().." not found in BaseParts table.")
end
end

if Target and Position and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent) and Target.Parent.Humanoid.Health > 0 or Target and Position and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Target.Parent.Parent) and Target.Parent.Parent.Humanoid.Health > 0 then

Click()
elseif TPlayer.Team == PlayerTeam and TPlayer ~= Player then
if Mode == "FFA" then
Click()
end
end
end

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local SPEED_MULTIPLIER = (...)
local JUMP_POWER = 60
local JUMP_GAP = 0.3
if (...) == nil then
SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 30
end

for i,v in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
v.CanCollide = false
end
end

params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
local tc = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
ball.CanCollide = true
humanoid.PlatformStand = true
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("W") then
ball.RotVelocity -= Camera.CFrame.RightVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("A") then
ball.RotVelocity -= Camera.CFrame.LookVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("S") then
ball.RotVelocity += Camera.CFrame.RightVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown("D") then
ball.RotVelocity += Camera.CFrame.LookVector * delta * SPEED_MULTIPLIER
end
end)

ball.Position,
Vector3.new(
0,
-((ball.Size.Y/2)+JUMP_GAP),
0
),
params
)
if result then
ball.Velocity = ball.Velocity + Vector3.new(0,JUMP_POWER,0)
end
end)
Camera.CameraSubject = ball
humanoid.Died:Connect(function() tc:Disconnect() end)
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
ismobile = uis.TouchEnabled
local MAX_LENGTH = 900000
local active = false
local ENABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(1.7, 0, 0)
local DISABLED_OFFSET = CFrame.new(-1.7, 0, 0)
local function UpdateAutoRotate(BOOL)
humanoid.AutoRotate = BOOL
end
local function GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(ROOT, CAMERA)
return CFrame.new(root.Position, Vector3.new(CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.X * MAX_LENGTH, root.Position.Y, CAMERA.CFrame.LookVector.Z * MAX_LENGTH))
end
local function EnableShiftlock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
UpdateAutoRotate(false)
root.CFrame = GetUpdatedCameraCFrame(root, camera)
camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * ENABLED_OFFSET
end
local function DisableShiftlock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
UpdateAutoRotate(true)
camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * DISABLED_OFFSET
pcall(function()
active:Disconnect()
active = nil
end)
end
active = false
function ShiftLock()
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local humanoid = character.Humanoid
if not active then
active = runservice.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
EnableShiftlock()
end)
else
DisableShiftlock()
end
end

local function AKIHDI_fake_script()
local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Main)
_G.functionspy = {
instance = script.Parent.Parent;
logging = true;
connections = {};
}
_G.functionspy.shutdown = function()
for i,v in pairs(_G.functionspy.connections) do
v:Disconnect()
end
_G.functionspy.connections = {}
_G.functionspy = nil
script.Parent.Parent:Destroy()
end
local connections = {}
local currentInfo = nil
function log(name, text)
local btn = script.Parent.LeftPanel.example:Clone()
btn.Parent = script.Parent.LeftPanel
btn.Name = name
btn.name.Text = name
btn.Visible = true
table.insert(connections, btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
script.Parent.RightPanel.output.Text = text
currentInfo = text
end))
end
script.Parent.RightPanel.copy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
if currentInfo ~= nil then
setclipboard(currentInfo)
end
end)
script.Parent.RightPanel.clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
for i,v in pairs(connections) do
v:Disconnect()
end
for i,v in pairs(script.Parent.LeftPanel:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("TextButton") and v.Visible == true then
v:Destroy()
end
end
script.Parent.RightPanel.output.Text = ""
currentInfo = nil
end)
local hooked = {}
local Seralize = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://api.irisapp.ca/Scripts/SeralizeTable.lua', true))()
for i,v in next, toLog do
if type(v) == "string" then
local suc,err = pcall(function()
local func = loadstring("return "..v)()
hooked[i] = hookfunction(func, function(...)
local args = {...}
if _G.functionspy then
pcall(function()
out = ""
out = out..(v..", Args -> {")..("\n"):format()
for l,k in pairs(args) do
if type(k) == "function" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k)..", Name -> "..getinfo(k).name)..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "table" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k)..", Data -> "..Seralize(k))..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "boolean" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k).." -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "nil" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] null")..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "number" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
else
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
end
end
out = out..("}, Result -> "..tostring(nil))..("\n"):format()
if _G.functionspy.logging == true then
log(v,out)
end
end)
end
return hooked[i](...)
end)
end)
if not suc then
warn("Something went wrong while hooking "..v..". Error: "..err)
end
elseif type(v) == "function" then
local suc,err = pcall(function()
hooked[i] = hookfunction(v, function(...)
local args = {...}
if _G.functionspy then
pcall(function()
out = ""
out = out..(getinfo(v).name..", Args -> {")..("\n"):format()
for l,k in pairs(args) do
if type(k) == "function" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k)..", Name -> "..getinfo(k).name)..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "table" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k)..", Data -> "..Seralize(k))..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "boolean" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k).." -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "nil" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] null")..("\n"):format()
elseif type(k) == "number" then
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
else
out = out..("    ["..tostring(l).."] Value -> "..tostring(k)..", Type -> "..type(k))..("\n"):format()
end
end
out = out..("}, Result -> "..tostring(nil))..("\n"):format()
if _G.functionspy.logging == true then
log(getinfo(v).name,out)
end
end)
end
return hooked[i](...)
end)
end)
if not suc then
warn("Something went wrong while hooking "..getinfo(v).name..". Error: "..err)
end
end
end

local function KVVJTK_fake_script()
local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', FakeTitle)
local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local frame = script.Parent.Parent
local dragToggle = nil
local dragSpeed = 0.25
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil
local function updateInput(input)
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
end
table.insert(_G.functionspy.connections, frame.Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
dragToggle = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPos = frame.Position
input.Changed:Connect(function()
if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
dragToggle = false
end
end)
end
end))
table.insert(_G.functionspy.connections, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
if dragToggle then
updateInput(input)
end
end
end))
end
coroutine.wrap(KVVJTK_fake_script)()

cmd.add({"freecam", "fc", "fcam"}, {"freecam [speed] (fc, fcam)", "Enable free camera"}, function(speed)
if not speed then speed = 5 end
if connections["freecam"] then lib.disconnect("freecam") camera.CameraSubject = character wrap(function() character.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false end) end
local dir = {w = false, a = false, s = false, d = false}
local cf = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
local camPart = Instance.new("Part")
camPart.Transparency = 1
camPart.Anchored = true
camPart.CFrame = camera.CFrame
wrap(function()
character.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
end)
lib.connect("freecam", RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
local primaryPart = camPart
camera.CameraSubject = primaryPart
local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0
if dir.w then z = -1 * speed end
if dir.a then x = -1 * speed end
if dir.s then z = 1 * speed end
if dir.d then x = 1 * speed end
if dir.q then y = 1 * speed end
if dir.e then y = -1 * speed end
primaryPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(
primaryPart.CFrame.p,
(camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -100)).p
)
local moveDir = CFrame.new(x,y,z)
cf.Value = cf.Value:lerp(moveDir, 0.2)
primaryPart.CFrame = primaryPart.CFrame:lerp(primaryPart.CFrame * cf.Value, 0.2)
end))
lib.connect("freecam", UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, event)

local function getAllTools()
local tools = {}
local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
if backpack then
for i, v in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
for i, v in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if v:IsA("Tool") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
return tools
end

cmd.add({"circlemath", "cm"}, {"circlemath <mode> <size>", "Gay circle math\nModes: abc..."}, function(mode, size)
local mode = mode or "a"
local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Backpack")
lib.disconnect("cm")
if backpack and character.Parent then
local tools = getAllTools()
for i, tool in pairs(tools) do
local cpos, g = (math.pi*2)*(i/#tools), CFrame.new()
local tcon = {}
tool.Parent = backpack
if mode == "a" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(0, 0, size)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
elseif mode == "b" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(i - #tools/2, 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, 0)
)
elseif mode == "c" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(cpos/3, 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos*2)
)
elseif mode == "d" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(clamp(tan(cpos), -3, 3), 0, 0)*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
elseif mode == "e" then
size = tonumber(size) or 2
g = (
CFrame.new(0, 0, clamp(tan(cpos), -5, 5))*
CFrame.Angles(rad(90), 0, cpos)
)
end
tool.Grip = g
tool.Parent = character
tcon[#tcon] = lib.connect("cm", mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
tool:Activate()
end))
tcon[#tcon] = lib.connect("cm", tool.Changed:Connect(function(p)
if p == "Grip" and tool.Grip ~= g then
tool.Grip = g
end
end))
lib.connect("cm", tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
for i = 1, #tcon do
tcon[i]:Disconnect()
end
end))
end
end
end)

"Chat",
"All",
Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat,
Enum.CoreGuiType.All
}
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local FixCore = function(x)
local CoreHook; CoreHook = hookmetamethod(x, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
local Method = getnamecallmethod()
local Arguments = {...}
if self == x and Method == "SetCoreGuiEnabled" and not checkcaller() then
local CoreType = Arguments[1]
local Enabled = Arguments[2]
if table.find(WhitelistedCoreTypes, CoreType) and not Enabled then
if CoreType == ("Chat" or Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat) then
OldSetting = Enabled
end
ChatChanged = true
end
end
return CoreHook(self, ...)
end)
x.CoreGuiChangedSignal:Connect(function(Type)
if table.find(WhitelistedCoreTypes, Type) and ChatChanged then
task.wait()
if not StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat) then
x:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, true)
end
wait(1)
if StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat) then
x:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, OldSetting)
end
ChatChanged = false
end
end)
