					return
				end
				boundOptions[option] = true
				local locked = false
				local function choose()
					if locked then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					task.defer(applyTheme, themeName, true)
					task.delay(0.12, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connectTheme(option.MouseButton1Click, choose)
				connectTheme(option.Activated, choose)
				connectTheme(option.TouchTap, choose)
			end
			local function bindThemeOptions()
				local dropdown = getThemeDropdown()
				if not dropdown then
					return
				end
				for optionName, themeName in themeMap do
					bindOption(dropdown:FindFirstChild(optionName), themeName)
				end
			end
			bindThemeOptions()
			connectTheme(mainGui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
				task.defer(function()
					if not (themeRuntime.alive and object and object.Parent) then
						return
					end
					capture(object)
					if object:IsA("GuiObject") or object:IsA("UIStroke") then
						applyObject(object, currentTheme)
					end
					if object:IsA("GuiButton") and themeMap[object.Name] and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "Dropdown" then
						bindOption(object, themeMap[object.Name])
					end
				end)
			end)
			local fx = {
				acc = 0,
				state = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				selected = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
				watch = {},
				accentColor = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242),
				strokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 80),
				pressInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				releaseInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			}
			themeRuntime.fx = fx
			local fxTweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
			local fxRunService = game:GetService("RunService")
			local fxInput = game:GetService("UserInputService")
			local fxTouchOnly = fxInput.TouchEnabled and not fxInput.MouseEnabled

			function fx.tween(object, info, props)
				if not (object and object.Parent) then
					return nil
				end
				local ok, tween = pcall(function()
					local t = fxTweenService:Create(object, info, props)
					t:Play()
					return t
				end)
				return ok and tween or nil
			end

			function fx.apply(object, info, props, instant)
				if instant then
					for property, value in props do
						pcall(function()
							object[property] = value
						end)
					end
					return nil
				end
				return fx.tween(object, info, props)
			end

			function fx.updateAccent()
				if not (fx.sidebar and fx.sidebar.Parent) then
					fx.sidebar = mainGui:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
				end
				fx.active = fx.sidebar and fx.sidebar:FindFirstChild("ActiveColor") or nil
				local palette = palettes[currentTheme]
				local accent = palette and palette.accent or Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
				if fx.active and fx.active:IsA("Color3Value") then
					accent = fx.active.Value
				end
				local stroke = palette and palette.stroke or Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 80)
				local iui = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaImmersiveUIRuntime")
				if type(iui) == "table" and type(iui.getColors) == "function" then
					local ok, a, s = pcall(iui.getColors)
					if ok and typeof(a) == "Color3" and typeof(s) == "Color3" then
						accent, stroke = a, s
					end
				end
				fx.accentColor = accent
				fx.strokeColor = stroke
			end

			function fx.isSelected(button)
				local flag = button:GetAttribute("LT_FXSelected")
				if type(flag) == "boolean" then
					return flag
				end
				if fx.active and fx.active:IsA("Color3Value") then
					local c, a = button.BackgroundColor3, fx.active.Value
					if button.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 and math.abs(c.R - a.R) + math.abs(c.G - a.G) + math.abs(c.B - a.B) < 0.12 then
						return true
					end
				end
				local checked = button:FindFirstChild("Checked", true)
				if checked and checked:IsA("GuiObject") then
					return checked.Visible
				end
				if button:IsA("TextButton") then
					local t = string.upper(button.Text)
					if t == "ON" or string.sub(t, -4) == ": ON" then
						return true
					end
				end
				return false
			end

			function fx.makeOverlay(button)
				local overlay = button:FindFirstChild("LT_FXOverlay")
				if overlay then
					return overlay
				end
				for _, child in button:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIGridStyleLayout") then
						return nil
					end
				end
				overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
				overlay.Name = "LT_FXOverlay"
				overlay:SetAttribute("LT_NoImmersiveStyle", true)
				overlay.BackgroundColor3 = fx.accentColor
				overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
				overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				overlay.Active = false
				overlay.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
				local corner = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
				if corner then
					local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
					c.CornerRadius = corner.CornerRadius
					c.Parent = overlay
				end
				overlay.Parent = button
				return overlay
			end

			function fx.getScale(button, st)
				local scale = st.scale
				if not (scale and scale.Parent) then
					scale = button:FindFirstChild("LT_FXPress")
					if not scale then
						scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
						scale.Name = "LT_FXPress"
						scale.Parent = button
					end
					st.scale = scale
				end
				return scale
			end

			function fx.pop(button)
				local st = fx.state[button]
				if st then
					local scale = fx.getScale(button, st)
					scale.Scale = 1.1
					fx.tween(scale, fx.releaseInfo, { Scale = 1 })
				end
			end

			function fx.paint(button, instant)
				local st = fx.state[button]
				if not st or not button.Parent then
					return
				end
				local live = button.Visible
				local pressed = live and st.pressed
				local hover = live and st.hover and not fxTouchOnly
				local selected = live and fx.isSelected(button) or false
				st.selected = selected
				local lit = pressed or hover or selected
				local accent = fx.accentColor
				local big = button.AbsoluteSize.X > 140 or button.AbsoluteSize.Y > 60

				local stroke = st.stroke
				if not (stroke and stroke.Parent) then
					stroke = button:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke") or button:FindFirstChild("LT_FXStroke")
					if not stroke and lit then
						stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
						stroke.Name = "LT_FXStroke"
						stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
						stroke.Thickness = 1
						stroke.Transparency = 0.35
						stroke.Parent = button
					end
					st.stroke = stroke
				end
				if stroke and stroke.Parent then
					stroke.Color = lit and accent or fx.strokeColor
					if selected and not pressed and not hover then
						fx.selected[button] = true
					else
						fx.selected[button] = nil
						fx.apply(stroke, fx.fadeInfo, {
							Thickness = pressed and 2.4 or (hover and 1.6 or 1),
							Transparency = pressed and 0.02 or (hover and 0.15 or 0.35),
						}, instant)
					end
				end

				if pressed then
					fx.apply(fx.getScale(button, st), fx.pressInfo, { Scale = big and 0.985 or 0.92 }, instant)
				elseif st.scale and st.scale.Parent then
					fx.apply(st.scale, fx.releaseInfo, { Scale = 1 }, instant)
				end

				local overlay = st.overlay
				if lit and not (overlay and overlay.Parent) then
					overlay = fx.makeOverlay(button)
					st.overlay = overlay
				end
				if overlay and overlay.Parent then
					overlay.BackgroundColor3 = accent
					overlay.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
					fx.apply(overlay, fx.fadeInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = pressed and 0.55 or (hover and 0.82 or (selected and 0.88 or 1)),
					}, instant)
				end

				if pressed and not st.tint then
					local tint = {}
					st.tint = tint
					local count = 0
					local function add(img)
						if count < 6 and (img:IsA("ImageLabel") or img:IsA("ImageButton")) and string.sub(img.Name, 1, 3) ~= "LT_" then
							count += 1
							local prev = img.ImageColor3
							local target = prev:Lerp(accent, 0.55)
							tint[img] = { prev = prev, target = target, tween = fx.tween(img, fx.pressInfo, { ImageColor3 = target }) }
						end
					end
					add(button)
					for _, d in button:GetDescendants() do
						add(d)
					end
				elseif not pressed and st.tint then
					for img, c in st.tint do
						if img.Parent then
							local playing = c.tween and c.tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
							if c.tween then
								pcall(function()
									c.tween:Cancel()
								end)
							end
							local cur = img.ImageColor3
							local close = math.abs(cur.R - c.target.R) + math.abs(cur.G - c.target.G) + math.abs(cur.B - c.target.B) < 0.03
							if playing or close then
								img.ImageColor3 = c.prev
							end
						end
					end
					st.tint = nil
				end
			end

			function fx.bind(button)
				if fx.state[button] or not button:IsA("GuiButton") or string.sub(button.Name, 1, 5) == "LT_FX" then
					return
				end
				local st = { hover = false, pressed = false, pressId = 0 }
				st.sidebar = fx.sidebar ~= nil and button:IsDescendantOf(fx.sidebar)
				fx.state[button] = st
				if st.sidebar then
					fx.watch[button] = true
				end
				if button.BackgroundTransparency < 0.9 and not (button:FindFirstChild("LT_IUIStroke") or button:FindFirstChild("LT_FXStroke")) then
					local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
					stroke.Name = "LT_FXStroke"
					stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
					stroke.Thickness = 1
					stroke.Transparency = 0.35
					stroke.Color = fx.strokeColor
					stroke.Parent = button
				end
				button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					if themeRuntime.alive then
						st.hover = true
						fx.paint(button)
					end
				end)
				button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					if themeRuntime.alive then
						st.hover = false
						st.pressed = false
						fx.paint(button)
					end
				end)
				button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
					if not themeRuntime.alive then
						return
					end
					st.pressed = true
					st.pressId += 1
					local id = st.pressId
					fx.paint(button)
					task.delay(2, function()
						if st.pressed and st.pressId == id and themeRuntime.alive then
							st.pressed = false
							fx.paint(button)
						end
					end)
				end)
				button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
					if themeRuntime.alive then
						st.pressed = false
						fx.paint(button)
					end
				end)
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					task.defer(function()
						if themeRuntime.alive then
							fx.paint(button)
						end
					end)
				end)
				fx.paint(button, true)
			end

			function fx.refresh()
				if not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				fx.updateAccent()
				for button in fx.state do
					if button.Parent then
						pcall(fx.paint, button, true)
					end
				end
			end
			themeRuntime.fxRefresh = fx.refresh

			fx.updateAccent()
			if fx.active then
				connectTheme(fx.active:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"), fx.refresh)
			end
			connectTheme(fxRunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
				if not themeRuntime.alive then
					return
				end
				fx.acc += dt
				if fx.acc < 0.033 then
					return
				end
				fx.acc = 0
				local t = os.clock()
				for button in fx.selected do
					local st = fx.state[button]
					local stroke = st and st.stroke
					if button.Parent and stroke and stroke.Parent and not st.pressed and not st.hover then
						local w = (math.sin(t * 2.6) + 1) * 0.5
						stroke.Transparency = 0.08 + w * 0.32
						stroke.Thickness = 1.7 + w * 1.1
					end
				end
				for button in fx.watch do
					local st = fx.state[button]
					if not (button.Parent and st) then
						fx.watch[button] = nil
					else
						local now = button.Visible and fx.isSelected(button) or false
						if now ~= st.selected then
							fx.paint(button)
							if now then
								fx.pop(button)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			connectTheme(mainGui.DescendantAdded, function(object)
				if object:IsA("GuiButton") and string.sub(object.Name, 1, 5) ~= "LT_FX" then
					task.defer(function()
						if themeRuntime.alive and object.Parent then
							pcall(fx.bind, object)
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local n = 0
				for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
					if not themeRuntime.alive then
						return
					end
					if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
						pcall(fx.bind, object)
						n += 1
						if n % 40 == 0 then
							task.wait()
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			local fxStop = themeRuntime.stop
			themeRuntime.stop = function()
				fxStop()
				for _, object in mainGui:GetDescendants() do
					if string.sub(object.Name, 1, 5) == "LT_FX" then
						pcall(object.Destroy, object)
					end
				end
			end
			local config = readThemeConfig()
			local savedTheme = type(config.DeltaTheme) == "table" and config.DeltaTheme.name or nil
			applyTheme(savedTheme, false)
		end)
	end
end

do
	local previous = rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime")
	if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.stop) == "function" then
		pcall(previous.stop)
	end

	local runtime = {
		alive = true,
		version = "2.5.5",
		connections = {},
		instances = {},
		originalButtons = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		restorers = {},
	}
	__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = runtime
	__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = runtime

	local function addConnection(connection)
		if connection then
			table.insert(runtime.connections, connection)
		end
		return connection
	end

	local function connect(signal, callback)
		if not signal then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, connection = pcall(function()
			return signal:Connect(callback)
		end)
		if ok then
			return addConnection(connection)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function addRestorer(callback)
		if type(callback) == "function" then
			table.insert(runtime.restorers, callback)
		end
	end

	local function track(instance)
		if instance then
			table.insert(runtime.instances, instance)
		end
		return instance
	end

	local function restoreOriginalButtons()
		for button, wasVisible in runtime.originalButtons do
			if button and button.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					local nativeVisible = button:GetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible")
					button.Visible = typeof(nativeVisible) == "boolean" and nativeVisible or wasVisible
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(runtime.originalButtons)
	end

	runtime.stop = function()
		if not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		runtime.alive = false
		restoreOriginalButtons()
		for i = #runtime.restorers, 1, -1 do
			pcall(runtime.restorers[i])
		end
		table.clear(runtime.restorers)
		for name in _naConns do
			NAlib.disconnect(name)
		end
		for i = #runtime.connections, 1, -1 do
			local connection = runtime.connections[i]
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end
		table.clear(runtime.connections)
		for i = #runtime.instances, 1, -1 do
			local instance = runtime.instances[i]
			if instance and instance.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					instance:Destroy()
				end)
			end
		end
		table.clear(runtime.instances)
		if rawget(__dcm_env, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime") == runtime then
			__dcm_env.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = nil
		end
		if rawget(__dcm_shared, "__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime") == runtime then
			__dcm_shared.__DeltaCustomizationV2Runtime = nil
		end
	end

	NAlib.disconnect("FpsCap_Enforce")

	local function findMainGui()
		local best
		local bestScore = 0
		for _, gui in root:GetChildren() do
			if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local score = 0
				for _, name in { "Executor", "Sidebar", "Scripthub", "Settings", "Home", "Console" } do
					if gui:FindFirstChild(name) then
						score += (name == "Executor" or name == "Sidebar") and 4 or 2
					elseif gui:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
						score += 1
					end
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					best = gui
					bestScore = score
				end
			end
		end
		if bestScore >= 10 then
			return best
		end
	end

	local v2Main = findMainGui()
	local attempts = 0
	while runtime.alive and not v2Main and attempts < 80 do
		attempts += 1
		task.wait(0.1)
		v2Main = findMainGui()
	end
	if not (runtime.alive and v2Main) then
		return
	end

	local executorRoot = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Executor") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Executor", true)
	local executorImage = executorRoot and executorRoot:FindFirstChild("Executor")
	local executorOverlay = executorImage and executorImage:FindFirstChild("Overlay")
	local tabsFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Tabs", true)
	local codeFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Code", true)
	local buttonsFrame = executorOverlay and executorOverlay:FindFirstChild("Buttons", true)
	if not (executorOverlay and tabsFrame and codeFrame and buttonsFrame) then
		return
	end

	for _, object in codeFrame:GetChildren() do
		if object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay") or object.Name:match("^LT_Syntax_") then
			object:Destroy()
		elseif object:IsA("TextBox") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
			local originalTransparency = object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency")
			local originalZ = object:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex")
			object.TextTransparency = typeof(originalTransparency) == "number" and originalTransparency or 0
			object.ZIndex = typeof(originalZ) == "number" and originalZ or 1
			object:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", nil)
			object:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", nil)
		end
	end
	local staleToolbar = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("LT_EditorToolbar")
	if staleToolbar then
		staleToolbar:Destroy()
	end
	for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
		local button = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			button:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
			button.Visible = true
		end
	end
	buttonsFrame.Visible = true

	local function readCurrentConfig()
		local config = {}
		if
			type(isfile) == "function"
			and type(readfile) == "function"
			and isfile(settingsPath)
		then
			local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, settingsPath)
			if ok and type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
				local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function()
					return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", raw)
				end)
				if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
					config = decoded
				end
			end
		end
		return config
	end

	local function readBool(key, defaultValue)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local value = config[key]
		if type(value) == "table" and value.enabled ~= nil then
			return value.enabled and true or false
		end
		return defaultValue
	end

	local function saveBool(key, enabled)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config[key] = { enabled = enabled and true or false }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	local function readNumber(key, defaultValue, minimum, maximum)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local value = config[key]
		local number = type(value) == "table" and tonumber(value.value) or nil
		return math.clamp(number or defaultValue, minimum, maximum)
	end

	local function saveNumber(key, value)
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config[key] = { value = value }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	do
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		if config.UiBlur ~= nil or config.UiBlurSize ~= nil then
			config.UiBlur = nil
			config.UiBlurSize = nil
			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
		end
	end

	local autoRestoreEnabled = readBool("AutoRestoreTabs", true)
	local editorToolbarEnabled = readBool("EditorToolbar", true)
	local editorStatusEnabled = readBool("EditorStatus", true)
	local wideEditorEnabled = readBool("WideEditor", false)
	local compactTabsEnabled = readBool("CompactTabs", false)
	local editorWordWrapEnabled = readBool("EditorWordWrap", false)
	local syntaxHighlightEnabled = readBool("EditorSyntaxHighlight", true)
	__dcm_env.__DeltaFastExec = { enabled = readBool("FastExecution", true), untilT = 0, hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) }
	do
		local F = __dcm_env.__DeltaFastExec
		function F.remaining()
			if not F.enabled then
				return 0
			end
			local r = F.untilT - os.clock()
			return r > 0 and r or 0
		end
		function F.mark()
			if F.enabled then
				F.untilT = os.clock() + 1.5
			end
		end
		function F.hook(button)
			if not button or F.hooked[button] or not button:IsA("GuiButton") then
				return
			end
			F.hooked[button] = true
			connect(button.MouseButton1Down, F.mark)
			connect(button.Activated, F.mark)
		end
	end
	local exploitSyntaxEnabled = readBool("ExploitSyntaxHighlight", true)
	local editorFontSize = math.floor(readNumber("EditorFontSize", 14, 10, 24) + 0.5)
	local toolbarButtons = {}
	local toolbarLayout = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local originalToolbarPadding = toolbarLayout and toolbarLayout.Padding or nil
	local nativeButtonOriginals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local statusFrame
	local statusLabel
	local editorCanvas
	local originalCodePosition = codeFrame.Position
	local originalCodeSize = codeFrame.Size
	local originalButtonsVisible = buttonsFrame.Visible
	local statusUpdateQueued = false
	local hookedBoxes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local sidebar = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
	local sidebarLayout = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
	local originalSidebarSortOrder = sidebarLayout and sidebarLayout.SortOrder or nil
	local sidebarNames = { "Home", "Executor", "Scripthub", "Music", "Console", "Settings", "ToggleUI" }
	local sidebarNameSet = {}
	local sidebarOriginalOrders = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	for _, name in sidebarNames do
		sidebarNameSet[name] = true
		local button = sidebar and sidebar:FindFirstChild(name)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			sidebarOriginalOrders[button] = button.LayoutOrder
		end
	end

	local function normalizeSidebarOrder(value)
		local result = {}
		local used = {}
		if type(value) == "table" then
			for _, name in value do
				if sidebarNameSet[name] and not used[name] then
					used[name] = true
					table.insert(result, name)
				end
			end
		end
		local musicWasMissing = not used.Music
		for _, name in sidebarNames do
			if not used[name] then
				used[name] = true
				table.insert(result, name)
			end
		end
		if musicWasMissing then
			local musicIndex = table.find(result, "Music")
			if musicIndex then
				table.remove(result, musicIndex)
				local hubIndex = table.find(result, "Scripthub") or math.min(3, #result)
				table.insert(result, hubIndex + 1, "Music")
			end
		end
		return result
	end

	local function readSidebarOrder()
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		local saved = config.SidebarButtonOrder
		if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.order) == "table" then
			saved = saved.order
		end
		return normalizeSidebarOrder(saved)
	end

	local sidebarOrder = readSidebarOrder()
	local sidebarApplyingOrder = false

	local function saveSidebarOrder()
		local config = readCurrentConfig()
		config.SidebarButtonOrder = { order = table.clone(sidebarOrder) }
		writeJsonFile(settingsPath, config)
	end

	local function applySidebarOrder()
		if sidebarApplyingOrder or not sidebar then
			return
		end
		sidebarApplyingOrder = true
		if sidebarLayout then
			sidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		end
		for index, name in sidebarOrder do
			local button = sidebar:FindFirstChild(name)
			if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				if sidebarOriginalOrders[button] == nil then
					sidebarOriginalOrders[button] = button.LayoutOrder
				end
				button.LayoutOrder = index
			end
		end
		sidebarApplyingOrder = false
	end

	local function moveSidebarButton(name, direction)
		local index = table.find(sidebarOrder, name)
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local target = math.clamp(index + direction, 1, #sidebarOrder)
		if target == index then
			return
		end
		sidebarOrder[index], sidebarOrder[target] = sidebarOrder[target], sidebarOrder[index]
		applySidebarOrder()
		saveSidebarOrder()
	end

	local function getCodeBoxes()
		local boxes = {}
		for _, object in codeFrame:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("TextBox") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(boxes, object)
			end
		end
		table.sort(boxes, function(a, b)
			local ai = tonumber(a.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			return ai < bi
		end)
		return boxes
	end

	local function getActiveCodeBox()
		local focused = UIS and UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
		if focused and focused:IsDescendantOf(codeFrame) then
			return focused
		end
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			if box.Visible then
				return box
			end
		end
		return getCodeBoxes()[1]
	end


	runtime.clipboardCache = tostring(runtime.clipboardCache or "")

	local function writeClipboard(value)
		value = tostring(value or "")
		runtime.clipboardCache = value
		local writer = type(setclipboard) == "function" and setclipboard
			or type(toclipboard) == "function" and toclipboard
			or type(setrbxclipboard) == "function" and setrbxclipboard
		if writer then
			pcall(writer, value)
		end
		return writer ~= nil
	end

	local function readClipboard()
		local reader = type(getclipboard) == "function" and getclipboard
			or type(readclipboard) == "function" and readclipboard
		if reader then
			local ok, value = pcall(reader)
			if ok and type(value) == "string" then
				runtime.clipboardCache = value
				return value, true
			end
		end
		if runtime.clipboardCache ~= "" then
			return runtime.clipboardCache, false
		end
		return nil, false
	end


	local function insertIntoActive(text)
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		text = tostring(text or "")
		local current = box.Text or ""
		local cursor = tonumber(box.CursorPosition) or -1
		if cursor < 1 or cursor > #current + 1 then
			cursor = #current + 1
		end
		box.Text = current:sub(1, cursor - 1) .. text .. current:sub(cursor)
		local nextCursor = cursor + #text
		task.defer(function()
			if box and box.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					box:CaptureFocus()
					box.CursorPosition = nextCursor
					box.SelectionStart = nextCursor
				end)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end


	local function copyActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return
		end
		writeClipboard(box.Text or "")
		notify({
			Title = "Delta Customization",
			Description = "Copied the active editor tab.",
			Duration = 3,
		})
	end

	local function pasteIntoActive()
		local value = readClipboard()
		if type(value) == "string" then
			insertIntoActive(value)
			return
		end
		notify({
			Title = "Delta Customization",
			Description = "Clipboard access is unavailable in this Delta build.",
			Duration = 5,
		})
	end

	local function executeSource(source, chunkName)
		source = tostring(source or ""):gsub("^\239\187\191", "")
		if source:match("^%s*$") then
			return false
		end
		local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
		if type(loader) ~= "function" then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "Script execution is unavailable in this Delta build.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		local compiled, compileError = loader(source, chunkName or "=Delta V2")
		if type(compiled) ~= "function" then
			warn("[DeltaCustomization] compile error in " .. tostring(chunkName or "script") .. ": " .. tostring(compileError))
			notify({
				Title = "Delta V2 compile error",
				Description = __dcm_boot.clip(compileError or "Unknown compile error"),
				Duration = 7,
			})
			return false
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, runtimeError = xpcall(compiled, __dcm_boot.trace)
			if not ok then
				warn("[DeltaCustomization] runtime error in " .. tostring(chunkName or "script") .. ":\n" .. tostring(runtimeError))
				notify({
					Title = "Delta V2 runtime error",
					Description = __dcm_boot.clip(runtimeError or "Unknown runtime error"),
					Duration = 7,
				})
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local function executeActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		return executeSource(box.Text or "", "=" .. tostring(box.Name))
	end

	local function clearActiveCode()
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			return false
		end
		box.Text = ""
		task.defer(function()
			if box and box.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					box.CursorPosition = 1
					box.SelectionStart = -1
				end)
			end
		end)
		return true
	end

	local function executeClipboardCode()
		local value = readClipboard()
		if type(value) ~= "string" then
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = "Clipboard access is unavailable in this Delta build.",
				Duration = 5,
			})
			return false
		end
		return executeSource(value, "=Delta V2 Clipboard")
	end

	local function activateOriginal(button)
		if not button then
			return false
		end
		if type(firesignal) == "function" then
			if type(getconnections) == "function" then
				for _, signalName in { "MouseButton1Click", "Activated" } do
					local signal = button[signalName]
					local ok, connections = pcall(getconnections, signal)
					if ok and type(connections) == "table" and #connections > 0 then
						local fired = pcall(firesignal, signal)
						if fired then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local ok = pcall(firesignal, button.MouseButton1Click)
			if ok then
				return true
			end
		end
		return pcall(function()
			button:Activate()
		end)
	end

	local function removeScripts(instance)
		for _, object in instance:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				object:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local function setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = text
		end
	end

	local function captureNativeButton(button)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiObject")) or nativeButtonOriginals[button] then
			return
		end
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		nativeButtonOriginals[button] = {
			Size = button.Size,
			LayoutOrder = button.LayoutOrder,
			Title = title,
			Text = title and title.Text or nil,
			TextScaled = title and title.TextScaled or nil,
			TextSize = title and title.TextSize or nil,
			TextTruncate = title and title.TextTruncate or nil,
		}
	end

	local function restoreNativeButton(button)
		local original = nativeButtonOriginals[button]
		if not (original and button and button.Parent) then
			return
		end
		button.Size = original.Size
		button.LayoutOrder = original.LayoutOrder
		button.Visible = true
		local title = original.Title
		if title and title.Parent then
			title.Text = original.Text
			title.TextScaled = original.TextScaled
			title.TextSize = original.TextSize
			title.TextTruncate = original.TextTruncate
		end
	end

	local function styleNativeButton(button, text, width, order)
		if not (button and button:IsA("GuiObject")) then
			return
		end
		captureNativeButton(button)
		button.Visible = true
		button.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, 0.7, 0)
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextScaled = false
			title.TextSize = buttonsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X < 650 and 10 or 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
	end

	local function createToolbarButton(parent, template, name, text, order, callback)
		local button = template:Clone()
		button.Name = name
		removeScripts(button)
		button.Visible = true
		button.Active = true
		button.Interactable = true
		button.Selectable = true
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 6, -4, 1, -6)
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		button.ZIndex = parent.ZIndex + 1
		button.Parent = parent
		for _, object in button:GetDescendants() do
			if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				object.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
			end
		end
		setButtonTitle(button, text)
		local title = button:FindFirstChild("Title", true) or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.TextScaled = false
			title.TextSize = buttonsFrame.AbsoluteSize.X < 650 and 10 or 12
			title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		end
		track(button)
		local locked = false
		local function activate()
			if locked or not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			locked = true
			callback()
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				locked = false
			end)
		end
		if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
			connect(button.MouseButton1Click, activate)
			connect(button.Activated, activate)
			connect(button.TouchTap, activate)
		else
			connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
				if
					input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					activate()
				end
			end)
		end
		return button
	end

	local function clearToolbar()
		for i = #toolbarButtons, 1, -1 do
			local button = toolbarButtons[i]
			if button and button.Parent then
				button:Destroy()
			end
			toolbarButtons[i] = nil
		end
		for _, name in { "LT_Copy", "LT_Paste", "LT_NewLine" } do
			local stale = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
			if stale then
				stale:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
			restoreNativeButton(buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name))
		end
		if toolbarLayout and originalToolbarPadding then
			toolbarLayout.Padding = originalToolbarPadding
		end
	end

	local function addToolbarButton(template, name, text, order, width, callback)
		local button = createToolbarButton(buttonsFrame, template, name, text, order, callback)
		button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		button.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, 0.7, 0)
		table.insert(toolbarButtons, button)
		return button
	end

	local function buildToolbar()
		clearToolbar()
		for _, name in {
			"CopyCode",
			"LT_EditorToolbar",
			"LT_Execute",
			"LT_Clear",
			"LT_ExecuteClipboard",
			"LT_Copy",
			"LT_Paste",
			"LT_NewLine",
		} do
			local stale = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
			if stale then
				stale:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local executeButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("Execute")
		local clearButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("Clear")
		local clipboardButton = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild("ExecuteClipboard")
		for _, button in { executeButton, clearButton, clipboardButton } do
			if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
				button:SetAttribute("LT_NativeVisible", true)
				button.Visible = true
			end
		end
		if not editorToolbarEnabled then
			return
		end
		local template = clipboardButton or executeButton or clearButton
		if not (executeButton and clearButton and clipboardButton and template and template:IsA("GuiObject")) then
			return
		end
		if toolbarLayout then
			toolbarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
		end
		styleNativeButton(executeButton, "RUN", 0.14, 0)
		styleNativeButton(clearButton, "CLEAR", 0.13, 1)
		styleNativeButton(clipboardButton, "RUN CLIP", 0.20, 2)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_Copy", "COPY", 3, 0.13, copyActiveCode)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_Paste", "PASTE", 4, 0.13, pasteIntoActive)
		addToolbarButton(template, "LT_NewLine", "ADD LINE", 5, 0.16, function()
			insertIntoActive("\n")
		end)
	end

	local function updateStatusPosition()
		if not (statusFrame and statusFrame.Parent and codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent == executorOverlay) then
			return
		end
		statusFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			codeFrame.Position.X.Scale + codeFrame.Size.X.Scale * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.X),
			codeFrame.Position.X.Offset + codeFrame.Size.X.Offset * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.X) - 6,
			codeFrame.Position.Y.Scale + codeFrame.Size.Y.Scale * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.Y),
			codeFrame.Position.Y.Offset + codeFrame.Size.Y.Offset * (1 - codeFrame.AnchorPoint.Y) - 5
		)
		statusFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.58), 210, 360), 0, 22)
	end

	local function updateStatus()
		statusUpdateQueued = false
		if not (statusFrame and statusLabel) then
			return
		end
		statusFrame.Visible = editorStatusEnabled
		if not editorStatusEnabled then
			return
		end
		local box = getActiveCodeBox()
		if not box then
			statusLabel.Text = "No active editor tab"
			return
		end
		local text = box.Text or ""
		local _, lineBreaks = text:gsub("\n", "\n")
		local lines = lineBreaks + 1
		statusLabel.Text = string.format("%s   •   %d lines   •   %d chars   •   autosave", box.Name, lines, #text)
	end

	local function queueStatusUpdate()
		if statusUpdateQueued then
			return
		end
		statusUpdateQueued = true
		local hold = __dcm_env.__DeltaFastExec.remaining()
		if hold > 0 then
			task.delay(hold, updateStatus)
		else
			task.defer(updateStatus)
		end
	end

	local saveTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local tabDirectory = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs"
	editorCanvas = (function()
		local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
		local hooked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originals = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local resizeTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local originalCanvasSize = codeFrame.CanvasSize
		local originalAutomaticCanvasSize = codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize
		local originalCanvasPosition = codeFrame.CanvasPosition

		local function effectiveScale(object)
			local scale = 1
			local current = object
			while current do
				for _, child in current:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIScale") then
						scale *= child.Scale
					end
				end
				current = current.Parent
			end
			return math.max(scale, 0.05)
		end

		local function remember(box)
			if originals[box] == nil then
				originals[box] = {
					AutomaticSize = box.AutomaticSize,
					Position = box.Position,
					Size = box.Size,
				}
			end
		end

		local function resize(box)
			if not (runtime.alive and box and box.Parent and box:IsA("TextBox")) then
				return
			end
			remember(box)
			local token = (resizeTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			resizeTokens[box] = token
			task.defer(function()
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local scale = effectiveScale(codeFrame)
				local windowWidth = math.max(140, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / scale))
				local windowHeight = math.max(100, math.floor(codeFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / scale))
				local availableTextWidth = math.max(120, windowWidth - 20)
				local text = box.Text ~= "" and box.Text or " "
				local params = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				params.Text = text
				params.Width = box.TextWrapped and availableTextWidth or 1000000
				params.Font = box.FontFace
				params.Size = box.TextSize
				local ok, bounds = pcall(function()
					return TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(params)
				end)
				params:Destroy()
				local _, lineBreaks = (box.Text or ""):gsub("\n", "\n")
				local lineHeight = math.max(1, box.LineHeight) * box.TextSize
				local minimumTextHeight = math.ceil((lineBreaks + 1) * lineHeight)
				if not ok then
					bounds = Vector2.new(availableTextWidth, minimumTextHeight)
				end
				if not (runtime.alive and box.Parent and resizeTokens[box] == token) then
					return
				end
				local measuredWidth = math.ceil(bounds.X)
				local measuredHeight = math.max(math.ceil(bounds.Y), minimumTextHeight)
				local contentWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and availableTextWidth
					or math.max(availableTextWidth, measuredWidth + 28)
				local contentHeight = math.max(windowHeight - 12, measuredHeight + math.ceil(lineHeight) + 28)
				local canvasWidth = box.TextWrapped
					and windowWidth
					or math.max(windowWidth, 8 + contentWidth + 32)
				local canvasHeight = math.max(windowHeight, 6 + contentHeight + 36)
				box.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
				box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
				box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(contentWidth, contentHeight)
				if box.Visible then
					codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
					codeFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(canvasWidth, canvasHeight)
					local maximumX = math.max(0, canvasWidth - windowWidth)
					local maximumY = math.max(0, canvasHeight - windowHeight)
					codeFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.X, 0, maximumX),
						math.clamp(codeFrame.CanvasPosition.Y, 0, maximumY)
					)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function hook(box)
			if hooked[box] or not box:IsA("TextBox") or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				return
			end
			hooked[box] = true
			remember(box)
			for _, property in { "Text", "Visible", "TextWrapped", "TextSize", "FontFace", "LineHeight" } do
				connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
					resize(box)
				end)
			end
			resize(box)
		end

		local function resizeAll()
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				hook(box)
				resize(box)
			end
		end

		local function restore()
			if codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent then
				codeFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize = originalAutomaticCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasSize = originalCanvasSize
				codeFrame.CanvasPosition = originalCanvasPosition
			end
			for box, values in originals do
				if box and box.Parent then
					box.AutomaticSize = values.AutomaticSize
					box.Position = values.Position
					box.Size = values.Size
				end
			end
		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resizeAll)
		pcall(function()
			connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"), resizeAll)
		end)
		return { hook = hook, resize = resize, resizeAll = resizeAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

	local function applyToolbarLayout()
		buttonsFrame.Visible = true
		codeFrame.Position = originalCodePosition
		codeFrame.Size = originalCodeSize
		task.defer(updateStatusPosition)
		task.delay(0.05, function()
			if runtime.alive then
				editorCanvas.resizeAll()
			end
		end)
	end

	addRestorer(function()
		for button, layoutOrder in sidebarOriginalOrders do
			if button and button.Parent then
				button.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
			end
		end
		if sidebarLayout and originalSidebarSortOrder then
			sidebarLayout.SortOrder = originalSidebarSortOrder
		end
	end)

	if sidebar then
		applySidebarOrder()
		connect(sidebar.ChildAdded, function(object)
			if sidebarNameSet[object.Name] and object:IsA("GuiObject") then
				task.defer(applySidebarOrder)
			end
		end)
	end

	addRestorer(function()
		if codeFrame and codeFrame.Parent then
			codeFrame.Position = originalCodePosition
			codeFrame.Size = originalCodeSize
		end
		if buttonsFrame and buttonsFrame.Parent then
			for _, name in { "LT_Copy", "LT_Paste", "LT_NewLine" } do
				local button = buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
				if button then
					button:Destroy()
				end
			end
			for _, name in { "Execute", "Clear", "ExecuteClipboard" } do
				restoreNativeButton(buttonsFrame:FindFirstChild(name))
			end
			if toolbarLayout and originalToolbarPadding then
				toolbarLayout.Padding = originalToolbarPadding
			end
			buttonsFrame.Visible = originalButtonsVisible
		end
	end)

	local syntaxHighlighter = (function()
		local overlays = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local updateTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local keywords = {
			["and"] = true, ["break"] = true, ["continue"] = true, ["do"] = true,
			["else"] = true, ["elseif"] = true, ["end"] = true, ["export"] = true,
			["false"] = true, ["for"] = true, ["function"] = true, ["if"] = true,
			["in"] = true, ["local"] = true, ["nil"] = true, ["not"] = true,
			["or"] = true, ["repeat"] = true, ["return"] = true, ["then"] = true,
			["true"] = true, ["type"] = true, ["until"] = true, ["while"] = true,
		}
		local builtins = {
			assert = true, collectgarbage = true, error = true, getfenv = true, getmetatable = true,
			ipairs = true, load = true, loadstring = true, next = true, pairs = true, pcall = true,
			print = true, rawequal = true, rawget = true, rawlen = true, rawset = true, require = true,
			select = true, setfenv = true, setmetatable = true, tonumber = true, tostring = true,
			typeof = true, unpack = true, warn = true, xpcall = true,
			bit32 = true, buffer = true, coroutine = true, debug = true, math = true, os = true,
			string = true, table = true, task = true, utf8 = true, vector = true,
			Axes = true, BrickColor = true, CFrame = true, Color3 = true, ColorSequence = true,
			ColorSequenceKeypoint = true, DateTime = true, DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo = true,
			Enum = true, Faces = true, Font = true, Instance = true, NumberRange = true,
			NumberSequence = true, NumberSequenceKeypoint = true, OverlapParams = true,
			PathWaypoint = true, PhysicalProperties = true, Random = true, Ray = true,
			RaycastParams = true, Rect = true, Region3 = true, Region3int16 = true,
			TweenInfo = true, UDim = true, UDim2 = true, Vector2 = true, Vector2int16 = true,
			Vector3 = true, Vector3int16 = true,
			any = true, boolean = true, never = true, number = true, string = true,
			table = true, thread = true, unknown = true,
		}
		local globals = {
			_G = true, game = true, plugin = true, script = true, shared = true, workspace = true,
		}
		local executorApis = {
			appendfile = true, base64_decode = true, base64_encode = true, base64decode = true,
			base64encode = true, checkcaller = true, checkclosure = true, cloneref = true,
			clonefunction = true, compareinstances = true, crypt = true, decompile = true,
			delfile = true, delfolder = true, dofile = true, Drawing = true, dumpstring = true,
			fireclickdetector = true, fireproximityprompt = true, firesignal = true,
			firetouchinterest = true, fluxus = true, getcallbackvalue = true, getcallingscript = true,
			getclipboard = true, getconnections = true, getconstant = true, getconstants = true,
			getcustomasset = true, getexecutorname = true, getfflag = true, getfflags = true,
			getfpscap = true, getgc = true, getgenv = true, gethiddenproperties = true,
			gethiddenproperty = true, gethui = true, getidentity = true, getinstances = true,
			getloadedmodules = true, getnamecallmethod = true, getnilinstances = true,
			getproto = true, getprotos = true, getrawmetatable = true, getreg = true,
			getrenv = true, getrunningscripts = true, getscriptbytecode = true,
			getscriptclosure = true, getscriptfromthread = true, getscriptfunction = true,
			getscripts = true, getstack = true, getsynasset = true, getthreadidentity = true,
			getupvalue = true, getupvalues = true, hookfunction = true, hookmetamethod = true,
			http_request = true, identifyexecutor = true, is_c_closure = true, iscclosure = true,
			isexecutorclosure = true, isfile = true, isfolder = true, iskrnlclosure = true,
			islclosure = true, isourclosure = true, isreadonly = true, isscriptable = true,
			listfiles = true, loadfile = true, lz4compress = true, lz4decompress = true,
			make_readonly = true, make_writeable = true, makefolder = true, newcclosure = true,
			protect_gui = true, queue_on_teleport = true, queueonteleport = true, readclipboard = true,
			readfile = true, replaceclosure = true, request = true, saveinstance = true,
			setclipboard = true, setconstant = true, setfflag = true, setfpscap = true,
			sethiddenproperty = true, setidentity = true, setnamecallmethod = true,
			setproto = true, setreadonly = true, setrbxclipboard = true, setscriptable = true,
			setstack = true, setthreadidentity = true, setupvalue = true, syn = true,
			toclipboard = true, unprotect_gui = true, WebSocket = true, websocket = true,
			writeclipboard = true, writefile = true,
		}

		local function escape(value)
			return tostring(value or ""):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")
		end

		local function palette()
			local background = codeFrame.BackgroundColor3
			local light = background.R * 0.299 + background.G * 0.587 + background.B * 0.114 > 0.58
			if light then
				return {
					text = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 42), keyword = "#AF00DB", builtin = "#267F99",
					global = "#001080", func = "#795E26", string = "#A31515",
					number = "#098658", comment = "#008000", executor = "#B44700",
				}
			end
			return {
				text = Color3.fromRGB(218, 222, 232), keyword = "#C586C0", builtin = "#4EC9B0",
				global = "#9CDCFE", func = "#DCDCAA", string = "#CE9178",
				number = "#B5CEA8", comment = "#6A9955", executor = "#FF9E64",
			}
		end

		local function paint(value, color)
			return '<font color="' .. color .. '">' .. (value:find("[&<>]") and escape(value) or value) .. "</font>"
		end

		local function longBracketAt(source, index)
			local equals = source:match("^%[(=*)%[", index)
			if equals == nil then
				return nil
			end
			local closing = "]" .. equals .. "]"
			local finish = source:find(closing, index + #equals + 2, true)
			return finish and finish + #closing - 1 or #source
		end

		local function tokenize(source)
			local colors = palette()
			local output = table.create(math.max(32, math.floor(#source / 6)))
			local index = 1
			local expectFunctionName = false
			local deadline, steps = os.clock() + 0.15, 0
			while index <= #source do
				steps += 1
				if steps % 400 == 0 and os.clock() > deadline then
					return nil
				end
				local char = source:sub(index, index)
				local pair = source:sub(index, index + 1)
				if pair == "--" then
					local longFinish = longBracketAt(source, index + 2)
					local finish = longFinish or ((source:find("\n", index + 2, true) or (#source + 1)) - 1)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.comment)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "\"" or char == "'" then
					local quote = char
					local finish = index + 1
					while finish <= #source do
						local current = source:sub(finish, finish)
						if current == "\\" then
							finish += 2
						elseif current == quote then
							break
						else
							finish += 1
						end
					end
					finish = math.min(finish, #source)
					output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char == "[" then
					local finish = longBracketAt(source, index)
					if finish then
						output[#output + 1] = paint(source:sub(index, finish), colors.string)
						index = finish + 1
					else
						output[#output + 1] = escape(char)
						index += 1
					end
				elseif char:match("[%a_]") then
					local finish = index
					while finish < #source and source:sub(finish + 1, finish + 1):match("[%w_]") do
						finish += 1
					end
					local word = source:sub(index, finish)
					local color
					if keywords[word] then
						color = colors.keyword
						expectFunctionName = word == "function"
					elseif exploitSyntaxEnabled and executorApis[word] then
						color = colors.executor
					elseif builtins[word] then
						color = colors.builtin
					elseif globals[word] then
						color = colors.global
					else
						local nextIndex = finish + 1
						while nextIndex <= #source and source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex):match("%s") do
							nextIndex += 1
						end
						if expectFunctionName or source:sub(nextIndex, nextIndex) == "(" then
							color = colors.func
						end
						expectFunctionName = false
					end
					output[#output + 1] = color and paint(word, color) or word
					index = finish + 1
				elseif char:match("%d") or (char == "." and source:sub(index + 1, index + 1):match("%d")) then
					local rest = source:sub(index, index + 63)
					local number = rest:match("^0[xX][%da-fA-F_]+")
						or rest:match("^0[bB][01_]+")
						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*[eE][+-]?[%d_]+")
						or rest:match("^%d[%d_]*%.?[%d_]*")
						or rest:match("^%.%d[%d_]*")
					number = number ~= "" and number or char
					output[#output + 1] = paint(number, colors.number)
					index += #number
				else
					output[#output + 1] = (char == "<" or char == ">" or char == "&") and escape(char) or char
					index += 1
				end
			end
			return table.concat(output), colors.text
		end

		local function sync(box)
			local state = overlays[box]
			if not state then
				return
			end
			local label = state.label
			if not (box.Parent and label.Parent) then
				return
			end
			label.AnchorPoint = box.AnchorPoint
			label.Position = box.Position
			label.Size = box.Size
			label.Rotation = box.Rotation
			label.TextXAlignment = box.TextXAlignment
			label.TextYAlignment = box.TextYAlignment
			label.TextWrapped = box.TextWrapped
			label.FontFace = box.FontFace
			label.TextSize = box.TextSize
			label.LineHeight = box.LineHeight
			local showOverlay = syntaxHighlightEnabled and box.Visible and box.Text ~= "" and not state.plain
			label.Visible = showOverlay
			if showOverlay then
				box.TextTransparency = 1
				box.ZIndex = state.originalZ + 1
				label.ZIndex = state.originalZ
			else
				box.TextTransparency = state.originalTransparency
				box.ZIndex = state.originalZ
			end
		end

		local function update(box)
			local state = overlays[box]
			if not state then
				return
			end
			sync(box)
			if not syntaxHighlightEnabled then
				return
			end
			local text = box.Text or ""

			local richText, textColor

			if #text <= 70000 then

				richText, textColor = tokenize(text)

			end

			-- too large / too slow to colour: show the plain editor text instead of a truncated overlay

			if richText and #richText <= 190000 then

				state.plain = nil

				state.label.TextColor3 = textColor

				state.label.Text = richText

			else

				state.plain = true

			end

			sync(box)
		end

		local function queue(box)
			local token = (updateTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			updateTokens[box] = token
			task.delay(math.max(#(box.Text or "") > 60000 and 0.08 or 0.025, __dcm_env.__DeltaFastExec.remaining()), function()
				if runtime.alive and box.Parent and updateTokens[box] == token then
					update(box)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function hook(box)
			if overlays[box] or not box:IsA("TextBox") or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				return
			end
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = "LT_Syntax_" .. box.Name
			label:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOverlay", true)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.BorderSizePixel = 0
			label.RichText = true
			label.TextScaled = false
			label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
			label.Active = false
			label.Interactable = false
			label.Selectable = false
			label.Parent = box.Parent
			track(label)
			local originalTransparency = box:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency")
			if typeof(originalTransparency) ~= "number" then
				originalTransparency = box.TextTransparency < 1 and box.TextTransparency or 0
			end
			local originalZ = box:GetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex")
			if typeof(originalZ) ~= "number" then
				originalZ = math.max(1, box.ZIndex)
			end
			box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", originalTransparency)
			box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", originalZ)
			overlays[box] = {
				label = label,
				originalTransparency = originalTransparency,
				originalZ = originalZ,
			}
			for _, property in {
				"Text", "Visible", "Position", "Size", "AnchorPoint", "Rotation", "TextWrapped",
				"TextSize", "FontFace", "LineHeight", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment",
			} do
				connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property), function()
					queue(box)
				end)
			end
			connect(box.Destroying, function()
				local state = overlays[box]
				if state and state.label and state.label.Parent then
					state.label:Destroy()
				end
				overlays[box] = nil
			end)
			queue(box)
		end

		local function applyAll()
			for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
				hook(box)
				update(box)
			end
		end

		local function restore()
			for box, state in overlays do
				if box and box.Parent then
					box.TextTransparency = state.originalTransparency
					box.ZIndex = state.originalZ
					box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalTransparency", nil)
					box:SetAttribute("LT_SyntaxOriginalZIndex", nil)
				end
				if state.label and state.label.Parent then
					state.label:Destroy()
				end
			end
			table.clear(overlays)
		end

		connect(codeFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"), applyAll)
		return { hook = hook, sync = queue, applyAll = applyAll, restore = restore }
	end)()

	local function hookCodeBox(box)
		if
			not (box and box:IsA("TextBox") and not hookedBoxes[box])
			or not box.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$")
		then
			return
		end
		hookedBoxes[box] = true
		editorCanvas.hook(box)
		syntaxHighlighter.hook(box)
		local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. box.Name
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(path) then
			local ok, data = pcall(readfile, path)
			if ok and type(data) == "string" then
				box.Text = data
			end
		elseif type(writefile) == "function" then
			pcall(writefile, path, box.Text or "")
		end
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
			queueStatusUpdate()
			local token = (saveTokens[box] or 0) + 1
			saveTokens[box] = token
			task.delay(#(box.Text or "") > 60000 and 1.2 or 0.3, function()
				if
					runtime.alive
					and box.Parent
					and saveTokens[box] == token
					and type(writefile) == "function"
				then
					pcall(writefile, tabDirectory .. "/" .. box.Name, box.Text or "")
				end
			end)
		end)
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), queueStatusUpdate)
		connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"), queueStatusUpdate)
		connect(box.Focused, queueStatusUpdate)
	end

	local function buildStatus()
		if statusFrame and statusFrame.Parent then
			statusFrame:Destroy()
		end
		statusFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		statusFrame.Name = "LT_EditorStatus"
		statusFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
		statusFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 22)
		statusFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
		statusFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
		statusFrame.ZIndex = math.max(codeFrame.ZIndex + 50, 800)
		statusFrame.Visible = editorStatusEnabled
		statusFrame.Parent = executorOverlay
		track(statusFrame)
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
		corner.Parent = statusFrame
		track(corner)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness = 1
		stroke.Transparency = 0.45
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(79, 164, 242)
		stroke.Parent = statusFrame
		track(stroke)
		statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		statusLabel.Name = "Text"
		statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0)
		statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0)
		statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		statusLabel.TextSize = 11
		statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 228, 238)
		statusLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		statusLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		statusLabel.ZIndex = statusFrame.ZIndex + 1
		statusLabel.Parent = statusFrame
		track(statusLabel)
		updateStatusPosition()
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			hookCodeBox(box)
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
	end

	local normalizingTabs = false
	local managedCloseBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local managedCloseBusy = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local normalizeTabSequence
	local selectTabByName
	local tabSelectToken = 0

	local function getOrderedTabButtons()
		local entries = {}
		for ordinal, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(entries, { tab = tab, ordinal = ordinal })
			end
		end
		table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
			local ao = a.tab.LayoutOrder
			local bo = b.tab.LayoutOrder
			if ao ~= bo then
				return ao < bo
			end
			local ai = tonumber(a.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			local bi = tonumber(b.tab.Name:match("%d+")) or math.huge
			if ai ~= bi then
				return ai < bi
			end
			return a.ordinal < b.ordinal
		end)
		local result = {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			table.insert(result, entry.tab)
		end
		return result
	end

	local function closeManagedTab(tab)
		if not (runtime.alive and tab and tab.Parent) then
			return
		end
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		if #tabs <= 1 then
			return
		end
		local index = table.find(tabs, tab)
		if not index then
			return
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local box = boxes[index]
		local wasVisible = box and box.Visible or false
		if tab.Parent then
			tab:Destroy()
		end
		if box and box.Parent then
			box:Destroy()
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if not runtime.alive then
				return
			end
			normalizeTabSequence()
			if wasVisible then
				local remaining = getCodeBoxes()
				local nextBox = remaining[math.min(index, #remaining)] or remaining[#remaining]
				if nextBox then
					for _, current in remaining do
						current.Visible = current == nextBox
					end
					for _, currentTab in getOrderedTabButtons() do
						currentTab.BackgroundTransparency = currentTab.Name == nextBox.Name and 0 or 1
					end
				end
			end
			queueStatusUpdate()
		end)
	end

	local managedSelectBound = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function bindManagedSelect(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("GuiButton")) or managedSelectBound[tab] then
			return
		end
		managedSelectBound[tab] = true
		local lastTap = 0
		local function activateSelect()
			if not (runtime.alive and tab.Parent) then
				return
			end
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastTap < 0.12 then
				return
			end
			lastTap = now
			tabSelectToken += 1
			local token = tabSelectToken
			selectTabByName(tab.Name)
			task.delay(0.08, function()
				if runtime.alive and tab.Parent and token == tabSelectToken then
					selectTabByName(tab.Name)
				end
			end)
		end
		connect(tab.Activated, activateSelect)
		connect(tab.MouseButton1Click, activateSelect)
	end

	local function bindManagedClose(tab)
		bindManagedSelect(tab)
		if not (tab and tab:IsA("GuiButton")) or managedCloseBound[tab] then
			return
		end
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if not (closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton")) then
			return
		end
		managedCloseBound[tab] = true
		local function activateClose()
			if managedCloseBusy[tab] then
				return
			end
			managedCloseBusy[tab] = true
			closeManagedTab(tab)
			task.delay(0.1, function()
				managedCloseBusy[tab] = nil
			end)
		end
		connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, activateClose)
		connect(closeButton.Activated, activateClose)
	end

	local function normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local directory = tabDirectory
		if
			type(isfolder) ~= "function"
			or type(listfiles) ~= "function"
			or type(readfile) ~= "function"
			or type(writefile) ~= "function"
			or not isfolder(directory)
		then
			return
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local saved = {}
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			local index = name and tonumber(name:match("^script(%d+)%.lua$"))
			if index then
				local readOk, text = pcall(readfile, path)
				if readOk and type(text) == "string" then
					table.insert(saved, { index = index, name = name, text = text })
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(saved, function(a, b)
			return a.index < b.index
		end)
		local keep = {}
		for index, item in saved do
			local name = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[name] = true
			pcall(writefile, directory .. "/" .. name, item.text)
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, item in saved do
				if not keep[item.name] then
					local path = directory .. "/" .. item.name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	normalizeTabSequence = function()
		if normalizingTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		normalizingTabs = true
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local tabs = getOrderedTabButtons()
		local usedTabs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local entries = {}
		local keep = {}
		for index, box in boxes do
			local oldName = box.Name
			local newName = "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
			keep[newName] = true
			local tab
			for _, candidate in tabs do
				if not usedTabs[candidate] and candidate.Name == oldName then
					tab = candidate
					break
				end
			end
			if not tab then
				for _, candidate in tabs do
					if not usedTabs[candidate] then
						tab = candidate
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if tab then
				usedTabs[tab] = true
			end
			table.insert(entries, {
				box = box,
				tab = tab,
				oldName = oldName,
				newName = newName,
				text = box.Text or "",
			})
		end
		for _, tab in tabs do
			if not usedTabs[tab] and tab.Parent then
				tab:Destroy()
			end
		end
		for index, entry in entries do
			if entry.box.Parent then
				entry.box.Name = entry.newName
			end
			local tab = entry.tab
			if tab and tab.Parent then
				tab.Name = entry.newName
				tab.LayoutOrder = index
				local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
				if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
					title.Text = entry.newName
				end
				bindManagedClose(tab)
			end
		end
		if type(writefile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				pcall(writefile, tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.newName, entry.text)
			end
		end
		if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				if entry.oldName ~= entry.newName and not keep[entry.oldName] then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. entry.oldName
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		normalizingTabs = false
	end

	local function savedTabNames()
		normalizeSavedTabFiles()
		local names = {}
		local directory = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs"
		if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not isfolder(directory) then
			return names
		end
		local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, directory)
		if not ok or type(files) ~= "table" then
			return names
		end
		for _, path in files do
			local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)$")
			if name and name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				table.insert(names, name)
			end
		end
		table.sort(names, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a:match("%d+")) or math.huge) < (tonumber(b:match("%d+")) or math.huge)
		end)
		return names
	end

	local function fireAddTab(addButton)
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local fired = activateOriginal(addButton)
		if not fired then
			return false
		end
		local deadline = os.clock() + 0.5
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until #getCodeBoxes() > before or os.clock() >= deadline
		return #getCodeBoxes() > before
	end

	selectTabByName = function(name)
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		local target
		for _, box in boxes do
			if box.Name == name then
				target = box
				break
			end
		end
		if not target then
			for index, tab in getOrderedTabButtons() do
				if tab.Name == name then
					target = boxes[index]
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if not target then
			return
		end
		for _, box in boxes do
			box.Visible = box == target
		end
		for _, tab in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if tab:IsA("GuiButton") and tab.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				tab.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Name == target.Name and 0 or 1
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
	end

	local function nextAvailableTabName()
		local used = {}
		for _, box in getCodeBoxes() do
			used[tonumber(box.Name:match("%d+"))] = true
		end
		local index = 1
		while used[index] do
			index += 1
		end
		return "script" .. tostring(index) .. ".lua"
	end

	local function createFallbackTab(name)
		if tabsFrame:FindFirstChild(name) and codeFrame:FindFirstChild(name, true) then
			return true
		end
		local sourceTab
		for _, object in tabsFrame:GetChildren() do
			if object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Name:match("^script%d+%.lua$") then
				sourceTab = object
				break
			end
		end
		local sourceBox = getCodeBoxes()[1]
		if not (sourceTab and sourceBox) then
			return false
		end
		local index = tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or (#getCodeBoxes() + 1)
		local tab = sourceTab:Clone()
		tab.Name = name
		tab.LayoutOrder = index
		tab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		removeScripts(tab)
		local title = tab:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = name
		end
		tab.Parent = tabsFrame
		track(tab)
		local box = sourceBox:Clone()
		box.Name = name
		box.Text = ""
		box.Visible = false
		box.Parent = sourceBox.Parent
		track(box)
		connect(tab.MouseButton1Click, function()
			selectTabByName(tab.Name)
		end)
		local closeButton = tab:FindFirstChild("ImageButton")
		if closeButton and closeButton:IsA("GuiButton") then
			connect(closeButton.MouseButton1Click, function()
				if #getCodeBoxes() <= 1 then
					return
				end
				local wasVisible = box.Visible
				if type(delfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" then
					local path = tabDirectory .. "/" .. name
					if isfile(path) then
						pcall(delfile, path)
					end
				end
				if tab.Parent then
					tab:Destroy()
				end
				if box.Parent then
					box:Destroy()
				end
				if wasVisible then
					local remaining = getCodeBoxes()[1]
					if remaining then
						selectTabByName(remaining.Name)
					end
				end
				queueStatusUpdate()
			end)
		end
		return true
	end

	local restoringTabs = false
	local function restoreSavedTabs(showResult)
		if restoringTabs or not runtime.alive then
			return
		end
		restoringTabs = true
		normalizeTabSequence()
		local saved = savedTabNames()
		local addButton = tabsFrame:FindFirstChild("AddTab")
		local before = #getCodeBoxes()
		local target = 0
		for _, name in saved do
			target = math.max(target, tonumber(name:match("%d+")) or 0)
		end
		local attemptsMade = 0
		while runtime.alive and #getCodeBoxes() < target and attemptsMade < math.max(target * 3, 8) do
			attemptsMade += 1
			local nextIndex = #getCodeBoxes() + 1
			local created = addButton and fireAddTab(addButton) or false
			if not created then
				created = createFallbackTab("script" .. tostring(nextIndex) .. ".lua")
			end
			if not created then
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.08)
		end
		local boxes = getCodeBoxes()
		if type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
			for _, box in boxes do
				local path = "DeltaCustom/DeltaTabs/" .. box.Name
				if isfile(path) then
					local ok, text = pcall(readfile, path)
					if ok and type(text) == "string" then
						box.Text = text
					end
				end
				hookCodeBox(box)
			end
		end
		queueStatusUpdate()
		if showResult then
			local after = #boxes
			local description
			if #saved == 0 then
				description = "No saved tabs were found."
			elseif after >= target then
				description = string.format("Restored %d saved tab%s.", #saved, #saved == 1 and "" or "s")
			else
				description = string.format("Restored %d of %d saved tabs.", math.max(after - before, 0), #saved)
			end
			notify({
				Title = "Delta Customization",
				Description = description,
				Duration = 4,
			})
		end
		restoringTabs = false
	end

	local function findSettingsTemplate()
		local settings = v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings") or v2Main:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
		local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
		if not holder then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local template
		for _, child in holder:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "Button" then
				template = child
				break
			end
		end
		return holder, template
	end

	local function createSettingRow(name, titleText, descText, buttonText, callback)
		local holder, template = findSettingsTemplate()
		if not (holder and template) then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local existing = holder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if existing then
			existing:Destroy()
		end
		local row = template:Clone()
		row.Name = name
		row.Visible = true
		row.LayoutOrder = -2
		removeScripts(row)
		local title = row:FindFirstChild("Title", true)
		local desc = row:FindFirstChild("Desc", true)
		if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") then
			title.Text = titleText
		end
		if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
			desc.Text = descText
		end
		local button = row:FindFirstChild("Button", true)
		if button and button:IsA("GuiObject") then
			setButtonTitle(button, buttonText)
			if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
				button.Active = true
				button.Interactable = true
				local locked = false
				local function activate()
					if locked or not runtime.alive then
						return
					end
					locked = true
					callback()
					task.delay(0.1, function()
						locked = false
					end)
				end
				connect(button.MouseButton1Click, activate)
				connect(button.Activated, activate)
				connect(button.TouchTap, activate)
			else
				connect(button.InputEnded, function(input)
					if
						input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						callback()
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		row.Parent = holder
		track(row)
		return row, button
	end

	local sidebarSortMenu
	local sidebarSortList
	local refreshSidebarSortMenu

	local function makeSortButton(parent, text, position, size, callback)
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 31, 36)
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.Position = position
		button.Size = size
		button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		button.Text = text
		button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		button.TextSize = 12
		button.AutoButtonColor = true
		button.ZIndex = 10003
		button.Parent = parent
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		corner.Parent = button
		connect(button.Activated, callback)
		return button
	end

	local function ensureSidebarSortMenu()

			return sidebarSortMenu
		end
		local menu = Instance.new("Frame")

		menu.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

		menu.Parent = v2Main
		track(menu)
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
		corner.Parent = menu
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(72, 72, 82)
		stroke.Thickness = 1
		stroke.Parent = menu
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 12)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 30)
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.Text = "Sidebar button order"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		title.TextSize = 17
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.ZIndex = 10001
		title.Parent = menu
		local description = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		description.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		description.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 44)
		description.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 34)
		description.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		description.Text = "Reorders Home, Executor, Scripthub, Music, Console, Settings, and the classic ToggleUI button."
		description.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 188)
		description.TextSize = 12
		description.TextWrapped = true

		description.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
