local StylizedObjs = {}
local function Stylize(obj, options)
options = options or {}
local Cor = Util.Instance("UICorner", obj)
Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Util.FX.Cfg.UIRound)
local Out = Util.Instance("UIStroke", obj)
Out.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
Out.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Out.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
Out.Thickness = Util.FX.Cfg.UIBorder
Out.Transparency = 0.7
if not (Util.FX.IsLowEnd and Util.FX.IsLowEnd()) then
local rg = Util.Instance("UIGradient", Out)
rg.Rotation = 38
rg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.32, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1)})
end
Out.Enabled = true
obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
if not options.BgTr and obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.3 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 end
local Glos = {}
if options.Glow == true then
local GloF = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainFrame)
Util.LinkDestroyI2I(obj, GloF)
GloF.Interactable = false
GloF.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local function update()
GloF.AnchorPoint = obj.AnchorPoint
GloF.Position = obj.Position - Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset((obj.AnchorPoint * 2 - Vector2.one) * 5)
GloF.Size = obj.Size - UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
GloF.Visible = obj.Visible
GloF.ZIndex = obj.ZIndex - 2
end
update()
obj.Changed:Connect(update)
local tex = Util.GetCDNAsset("lightinursoul.graphic.png")
for x=0, 2 do
for y=0, 2 do
local Glo = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", GloF)
Glo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1 - math.min(x, 1), 1 - math.min(y, 1))
Glo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.max(x - 1, 0), math.max(y - 1, 0))
Glo.Size = UDim2.new(1 - math.abs(x - 1), x == 1 and 0 or 32, 1 - math.abs(y - 1), y == 1 and 0 or 32)
Glo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Glo.Image = tex
Glo.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(math.min(x, 1) * 256, math.min(y, 1) * 256)
Glo.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(x == 1 and 0 or 256, y == 1 and 0 or 256)
table.insert(Glos, Glo)
end
end
end
table.insert(StylizedObjs, {
obj = obj,
Cor = Cor,
Out = Out,
Glos = Glos,
options = options,
})
end
local ForceUIColor = nil
local ForceUIBGColor = nil
local function GetUIColor(t)
local m = Util.UIColMemo
if m and m.t == t and m.f == ForceUIColor then return m.c end
local r
if ForceUIColor then
local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
local h, s, v = ForceUIColor:ToHSV()
if s < 0.2 then
v *= 0.8 + si * 0.2
else
h += si * 0.01
end
r = Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
else
r = Util.DiscoColor(t / 2)
end
if not m then m = {} Util.UIColMemo = m end
m.t, m.f, m.c = t, ForceUIColor, r
return r
end
local function GetUIBGColor(t)
local m = Util.UIBgMemo
if m and m.t == t and m.f == ForceUIBGColor then return m.c end
local r
if ForceUIBGColor then
local si = math.sin(math.pi * 2 * t / 10)
local h, s, v = ForceUIBGColor:ToHSV()
if s < 0.2 then
if v > 0.5 then
v *= 0.95 + si * 0.05
else
v *= 1.05 + si * 0.05
end
else
h += si * 0.01
end
r = Util.LoopedHSV(h, s, v)
else
r = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
end
if not m then m = {} Util.UIBgMemo = m end
m.t, m.f, m.c = t, ForceUIBGColor, r
return r
end
local UITextColor = Util.Instance("Color3Value")
UITextColor.Value = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
if Util.UhAdmin then Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme = function(t) return GetUIColor(t), GetUIBGColor(t), UITextColor.Value end end
local function RegisterTextLabel(obj)
if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
obj.TextColor3 = val
end))
end
if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
local h, s, v = UITextColor.Value:ToHSV()
obj.TextColor3 = UITextColor.Value
obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(obj, UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(val)
h, s, v = val:ToHSV()
obj.TextColor3 = val
obj.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 0.5 + (v - 0.5) * 0.4)
end))
end
end
local function UpdateGrads(t, all)
local CFG = Util.FX.Cfg
local c = Util.Color.Resolve(t, GetUIColor(t))
local bgc = GetUIBGColor(t)
local h, s, v = bgc:ToHSV()
local bgcd = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * 0.9)
local h2, s2, v2 = c:ToHSV()
local glc = c
if v > v2 then
glc = bgc
end
local list = StylizedObjs
local n = #list
if not all and n > 0 then
local dtG = t - (Util.GradT or t)
Util.GradT = t
local cur = Util.GradCursor or 0
for _ = 1, math.min(n, math.max(24, math.ceil(n * math.clamp(dtG, 0, 0.25) / 0.3))) do
cur = cur + 1
if cur > n then cur = 1 end
local g = list[cur]
local o = g.obj
if o.Parent == nil and not pcall(Util.GradProbe, o) then
list[cur] = list[n]
list[n] = nil
n = n - 1
cur = cur - 1
if n == 0 then break end
else
g.vis = o.Parent ~= nil and (not o:IsA("GuiObject") or Util.IsGuiVisible(o))
g.force = true
end
end
Util.GradCursor = cur
end
for gi = 1, n do
local grad = list[gi]
if all or grad.vis ~= false or grad.force then
grad.force = nil
local obj, Out, Glos, options = grad.obj, grad.Out, grad.Glos, grad.options
Out.Color = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55)
if grad.thick ~= CFG.UIBorder then
grad.thick = CFG.UIBorder
Out.Thickness = CFG.UIBorder
end
if grad.Cor and grad.round ~= CFG.UIRound then
grad.round = CFG.UIRound
grad.Cor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, CFG.UIRound)
end
if options.BgTr and grad.btr ~= CFG.UIBgTr then
grad.btr = CFG.UIBgTr
obj.BackgroundTransparency = CFG.UIBgTr
end
if options.Depthed then
obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgcd
else
obj.BackgroundColor3 = bgc
end
local gl = grad.glc
if Glos[1] and (all or not gl or grad.glv ~= CFG.UIGlow or math.abs(gl.R - glc.R) + math.abs(gl.G - glc.G) + math.abs(gl.B - glc.B) > 0.004) then
grad.glc, grad.glv = glc, CFG.UIGlow
for _,v in Glos do
v.ImageColor3 = glc
v.Visible = CFG.UIGlow
end
end
end
end
end
Util.GradProbe = function(o) o.Parent = o.Parent end

local function processtable(t)
if typeof(t.Fore) == "Color3" then
theme[1] = t.Fore
end
if typeof(t.Back) == "Color3" then
theme[2] = t.Back
end
if typeof(t.Text) == "Color3" then
theme[3] = t.Text
end
if typeof(t.Fore) == "string" then
theme[1] = Color3.fromHex(t.Fore)
end
if typeof(t.Back) == "string" then
theme[2] = Color3.fromHex(t.Back)
end
if typeof(t.Text) == "string" then
theme[3] = Color3.fromHex(t.Text)
end
if typeof(t.Text) == "string" then
theme[3] = Color3.fromHex(t.Text)
end
if typeof(t.SndClick) == "string" then
theme[4] = t.SndClick
end
end

local function _registerclicksnd(v)

if _clicksndclicked then return end

_clicksndclicked = true
end
end)
end

local lastDay, n, lastTc, lastAc = -1, 0, nil, nil
local function update()
local t = DateTime.now():ToLocalTime()
local tc, ac = UITextColor.Value, stroke and stroke.Color or UITextColor.Value
sP.Rotation = t.Second * 6
mP.Rotation = t.Minute * 6 + t.Second * 0.1
hP.Rotation = (t.Hour % 12) * 30 + t.Minute * 0.5
if ac ~= lastAc then
lastAc = ac
rim.Color = ac
for _, f in ipairs(accParts) do f.BackgroundColor3 = ac end
end
if tc ~= lastTc then
lastTc = tc
for _, f in ipairs(txtParts) do f.BackgroundColor3 = tc end
end
if t.Day ~= lastDay then
lastDay = t.Day
local ok, s = pcall(function() return DateTime.now():FormatLocalTime("ddd MMM D", "en-us") end)
dateL.Text = ok and s or os.date("%a %b %d")
end
n += 1
if n % 2 == 1 then
local ok, mb = pcall(Stats.GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats)
if ok then memL.Text = string.format("MEM %.0fMB", mb) end
end
end

local dragref = nil
local offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
TopBarFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if dragref then return end
if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
WindowContent.Interactable = false
local screen = Util.GetScreenSize()
local ch = (Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + SCREENGUI.AbsolutePosition) / screen
offset = Util.UDim2ToVector2Scale(UIMainWindow.Position) - ch
dragref = input
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragref then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and dragref == input) then
local screen = Util.GetScreenSize()
local ch = (Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + SCREENGUI.AbsolutePosition) / screen
local pos = ch + offset
local dowsize = Util.UDim2ToVector2Offset(UIMainWindow.Size)
local imjollx = (dowsize.X * 0.5 - 100) / screen.X
local imjolly = dowsize.Y * -0.5 / screen.Y
local boxy = 31 / screen.Y
pos = Vector2.new(
math.clamp(pos.X, -imjollx, 1 + imjollx),
math.clamp(pos.Y, -imjolly, 1 - imjolly - boxy)
)
UIMainWindow.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Scale(pos)
end
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
local same = dragref and (dragref == input or (dragref.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1))
if same then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
dragref = nil
end
end
end)

dragref = nil
WindowContent.Interactable = not MainWindowClosed
end

local _funcrefreshes = {}
local function AddToRenderStep(func, linkto)
table.insert(_funcrefreshes, func)
if linkto then
linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
local i = table.find(_funcrefreshes, func)
if i then
table.remove(_funcrefreshes, i)
end
end)
end
return func
end
Util.DecoHooks = {}
Util.AddDecoStep = function(func, linkto)
local list = Util.DecoHooks
list[#list + 1] = func
if linkto then
linkto.Destroying:Connect(function()
local i = table.find(list, func)
if i then
table.remove(list, i)
end
end)
end
return func
end
local _totalrendertime = 0
local _lowAcc = 0
do
local decoList = Util.DecoHooks
local warned = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local govAcc, govN = 0, 0
local Gov = Util.FX.Gov
RunService:BindToRenderStep("Uhhhhhh_Render" .. Util.RandomString(), Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value - 69, function(dt)
_totalrendertime += dt
local vis = UIMainWindow.Size.Y.Offset > 35
if WindowContent.Visible ~= vis then WindowContent.Visible = vis end
local decoDt, runDeco = dt, true
if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then
govAcc, govN = 0, 0
_lowAcc += dt
if _lowAcc < 1 / Util.FX.LowEndUIFPS then
return
end
dt, _lowAcc = _lowAcc, 0
decoDt = dt
else
_lowAcc = 0
local gs = Gov and Gov.Stride or 1
if gs > 1 then
govAcc += dt
govN += 1
if govN >= gs then
decoDt, govAcc, govN = govAcc, 0, 0
else
runDeco = false
end
else
govAcc, govN = 0, 0
end
end
if runDeco then UpdateGrads(_totalrendertime) end
for _, func in _funcrefreshes do
local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, dt)
if not s and not warned[func] then warned[func] = true warn(e) end
end
if runDeco then
for _, func in decoList do
local s, e = pcall(func, _totalrendertime, decoDt)
if not s and not warned[func] then warned[func] = true warn(e) end
end
end
end)
end

Util.AdminTheme = (function()
local AT = {}
local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local roots = Util.AdminThemeRoots or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
Util.AdminThemeRoots = roots
local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local queue, qh, qt = {}, 1, 0
local SKIP = {ColorPreview = true, CPBackground = true, MainCP = true, ColorSlider = true}
local th = {accent = WHITE, bg = BLACK, text = WHITE, h = 0, light = false}
local last, F = {}, {}
local PS_STROKE, PS_GRAD, PS_TEXT, PS_SCROLL, PS_GUI = {"Color"}, {"Color"}, {"BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3"}, {"BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3"}, {"BackgroundColor3"}
local function near(a, b, tol)
return math.abs(a.R - b.R) + math.abs(a.G - b.G) + math.abs(a.B - b.B) < (tol or 0.02)
end
local function isAcc(c, fresh)
if near(c, th.accent, 0.06) then return true end
local nu = NAUISTROKER
if typeof(nu) == "Color3" and near(c, nu, 0.06) then return true end
local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
return s >= 0.4 and v >= 0.45 and h >= 0.46 and h <= 0.86 and (fresh or math.abs(h - th.h) > 0.03)
end
local function classify(p, c, fresh)
if isAcc(c, fresh) then return "accent" end
local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
if s >= 0.4 and v >= 0.45 then return nil end
if p == "TextColor3" then
if s < 0.35 then
if v > 0.6 then return "text" end
if v > 0.3 then return "mute" end
end
return nil
end
if v >= 0.04 and v <= 0.5 and (s <= 0.4 or (h >= 0.46 and h <= 0.86)) then return "surf" end
return nil
end
local function gradHasAcc(seq, fresh)
for _, kp in seq.Keypoints do
if isAcc(kp.Value, fresh) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function colorFor(kind, orig)
if kind == "accent" then return th.accent end
if kind == "text" then return th.text end
if kind == "mute" then return th.text:Lerp(th.bg, 0.45) end
local _, _, v = orig:ToHSV()
local d = math.max(v - 0.078, 0)
if th.light then return th.bg:Lerp(BLACK, d * 0.8) end
return th.bg:Lerp(WHITE, d * 1.2)
end
local function skipped(o)
local p = o
while p do
if SKIP[p.Name] then return true end
p = p.Parent
end
return false
end
local function track(o)
local ps
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then ps = PS_STROKE
elseif o:IsA("UIGradient") then ps = PS_GRAD
elseif o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then ps = PS_TEXT
elseif o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then ps = PS_SCROLL
elseif o:IsA("GuiObject") then ps = PS_GUI
else return end
if skipped(o) then return end
local isG = ps == PS_GRAD
local recs = {}
for _, p in ps do
local c = o[p]
local r = {orig = c}
if isG then
r.grad = true
r.kind = gradHasAcc(c, true)
else
r.kind = classify(p, c, true) or false
end
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
recs[p] = r
end
tracked[o] = recs
end
local function doObj(o, recs, slow)
for p, r in recs do
if r.kind or slow or F.force then
if r.grad then
local cur = o.Color
local ck, rk = cur.Keypoints, (r.wrote or r.orig).Keypoints
if #ck ~= #rk or not near(ck[1].Value, rk[1].Value) or not near(ck[#ck].Value, rk[#rk].Value) then
r.orig, r.wrote = cur, nil
r.kind = gradHasAcc(cur, false)
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
end
if r.kind and (r.dirty or F.a) then
local out = {}
for i, kp in r.orig.Keypoints do
out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, isAcc(kp.Value, true) and th.accent or kp.Value)
end
local seq = ColorSequence.new(out)
r.wrote, r.dirty = seq, nil
o.Color = seq
end
else
local cur = o[p]
if not near(cur, r.wrote or r.orig) then
r.orig, r.wrote = cur, nil
r.kind = classify(p, cur, false) or false
if r.kind then r.dirty = true end
end
local k = r.kind
if k and (r.dirty or F.force or (k == "accent" and F.a) or ((k == "surf" or k == "mute") and F.b) or ((k == "text" or k == "mute") and F.x)) then
local nv = colorFor(k, r.orig)
r.wrote, r.dirty = nv, nil
if not near(cur, nv, 0.004) then o[p] = nv end
end
end
end
end
end
local function hook(g)
if hooked[g] or typeof(g) ~= "Instance" then return end
hooked[g] = true
g.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
qt += 1
queue[qt] = d
end)
for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
qt += 1
queue[qt] = d
end
end
local SKIPGUI = {RobloxGui = true, TopBarApp = true, ThemeProvider = true, PurchasePromptApp = true, InGameMenu = true, RobloxNetworkPauseNotification = true, UhAdmin = true}
local checked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function isExecUI(g)
local hasBox, hasEx, hasUp, n = false, false, false, 0
for _, d in g:GetDescendants() do
n += 1
if n > 4000 then break end
if d:IsA("TextBox") then
if string.find(string.lower(d.PlaceholderText), "^search for scripts") then hasBox = true end
elseif d:IsA("TextButton") then
local t = string.upper(d.Text)
if t == "EXECUTE" then hasEx = true elseif t == "UPLOAD" then hasUp = true end
end
if hasBox or (hasEx and hasUp) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function findExecUIs(now)
local hosts = {}
local okH, hui = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
if okH and typeof(hui) == "Instance" then hosts[#hosts + 1] = hui end
local okC, cg = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if okC and cg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = cg end
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if pg then hosts[#hosts + 1] = pg end
for _, h in hosts do
for _, g in h:GetChildren() do
if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and not roots[g] and not SKIPGUI[g.Name] and now - (checked[g] or -100) >= 10 then
checked[g] = now
local ok, hit = pcall(isExecUI, g)
if ok and hit then roots[g] = true end
end
end
end
end
local scanAt = 0
local lastAt, lastSlow, lastTab = 0, 0, nil
function AT.Tick(force)
local now = os.clock()
if not force and now - lastAt < 0.1 then return end
lastAt = now
local acc = (Util.Color and Util.Color.Cur) or GetUIColor(_totalrendertime)
local bg = GetUIBGColor(_totalrendertime)
local tx = UITextColor.Value
F.force = force or false
F.a = F.force or not last.a or not near(acc, last.a, 0.004)
F.b = F.force or not last.b or not near(bg, last.b, 0.006)
F.x = F.force or not last.x or not near(tx, last.x, 0.006)
if F.a then
last.a, th.accent = acc, acc
th.h = acc:ToHSV()
end
if F.b then
last.b, th.bg = bg, bg
local _, _, bv = bg:ToHSV()
th.light = bv > 0.5
end
if F.x then last.x, th.text = tx, tx end
NAUISTROKER = acc
if F.a then
if NAgui then
if NAgui.applyMainColorToRegisteredStrokes then pcall(NAgui.applyMainColorToRegisteredStrokes, acc) end
if NAgui.applyMainColorToAccentSurfaces then pcall(NAgui.applyMainColorToAccentSurfaces, acc) end
if NAgui.scheduleMainColorTabRefresh and (F.force or not lastTab or not near(acc, lastTab, 0.02)) then
lastTab = acc
pcall(NAgui.scheduleMainColorTabRefresh, acc)
end
end
if NAmanage and NAmanage.SideSwipe_UpdateHandleColors then pcall(NAmanage.SideSwipe_UpdateHandleColors, acc) end
end
if NAStuff and typeof(NAStuff.NASCREENGUI) == "Instance" then roots[NAStuff.NASCREENGUI] = true end
if now - scanAt >= 5 then
scanAt = now
pcall(findExecUIs, now)
end
for g in roots do hook(g) end
local slow = now - lastSlow >= 1
if slow then lastSlow = now end
for o, recs in tracked do
if o.Parent then pcall(doObj, o, recs, slow) end
end
end

local n = 0
while qh <= qt and n < 120 do
local d = queue[qh]
queue[qh] = nil
qh += 1
n += 1
if d and not tracked[d] and d.Parent then pcall(track, d) end
end
if qh > qt then qh, qt = 1, 0 end
pcall(AT.Tick, false)
end)
return AT
end)()

local PositionProcessor = {
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local d = pos.Magnitude
if d > 0 then
local r = math.atan2(pos.X / d, pos.Y / d)
local a = math.pi * 0.375
local out = Vector2.new(math.sin(r + a), math.cos(r + a))
local tp = out * (40 + pbl / 12)
local tv = (tp - pos) * 2
vel = tv:Lerp(vel, math.exp(-2 * dt))
if math.random() < 0.01 then
vel += Vector2.new(math.random(-64, 64), math.random(-64, 64))
end
if spike > 64 then
vel += out * 64 * math.random()
end
pos += vel * dt
else
pos += Vector2.new(0, 10)
end
v[2], v[3] = pos, vel
return Vector3.new(zind * pos.Magnitude / 6, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local a = i / ps
local s = (a * 6) % 1
local r = (a + s / 8) * 2 * math.pi + os.clock() * 2 + zind * math.pi * 0.125 * (pbl / 200) * (1 - s)
pos = Vector2.new(math.sin(r), math.cos(r)) * s * (100 + pbl / 15)
v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
function(i, v, dt, pbl, spike)
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local a = i / ps
local b = 1 / 3
local c = math.sqrt(3) / 2
local d = {
{Vector2.new(0, b + c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(-1, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(-1, b - c), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(1, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(1, b - c), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b - c)},
{Vector2.new(0, b - c), Vector2.new(-0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(-0.5, b), Vector2.new(0.5, b)},
{Vector2.new(0.5, b), Vector2.new(0, b + c)},
}
local t = a * #d
local i = math.floor(t) + 1
local u = t % 1
if i > #d then
i = #d
u = 1
end
pos = d[i][1]:Lerp(d[i][2], u) * 150
local r = os.clock() * 2
pos = Vector2.new(
pos.X * math.cos(r) - pos.Y * math.sin(r),
pos.X * math.sin(r) + pos.Y * math.cos(r)
)
v[2], v[3] = pos, Vector2.zero
return Vector3.new(0, pos.Y, pos.X)
end,
}
local currentprocessor = 1
local lastLowScene = false
local NOPARTICLES = {}
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t, dt)
if Util.IsGuiVisible(CracktroFrame) then
local pp = PositionProcessor[currentprocessor]
local CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize = CracktroFrame.AbsoluteSize
Glowy.ImageColor3 = UITextColor.Value
Glowy.ImageTransparency = 0.75 + math.sin(((os.clock() / 10) % 2) * math.pi) * 0.05
local pbl = UISound.Music.PlaybackLoudness
local spike = math.max(0, (pbl - oldpbl) - 16)
oldpbl = pbl
local trivelt = pbl * 2 * dt
trivel = trivelt + (trivel - trivelt) * math.exp(-8 * dt)
Triforce.Rotation = (Triforce.Rotation + trivel) % 360
local ring = CFrame.Angles(
0,
math.cos(((t / 5) % 2) * math.pi) * math.pi * 0.5,
(1 - math.cos(((t / 7) % 2) * math.pi)) * math.pi * 0.5
)
local fov = 220
local lowScene = Util.FX.IsLowEnd()
if lowScene ~= lastLowScene then
lastLowScene = lowScene
if lowScene then
for _, pv in particles do
pv[1].Visible = false
pv[5] = false
end
end
end
for i,v in (lowScene and NOPARTICLES or particles) do
local inst, pos, vel, zind, lvis, lzind = unpack(v)
local sp = ring:VectorToWorldSpace(pp(i, v, dt, pbl, spike))
local z = sp.Z
local sc = fov / (z + fov)
sp = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) * sc
local nvis, nzind = lvis, lzind
if z > 1 - fov then
inst.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset(sp + CracktroFrameAbsoluteSize / 2)
inst.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sc * 2.5, sc * 2.5)
nvis = true
if z > 0 then
nzind = -1
else
nzind = 1
end
else
nvis = false
end
if lvis ~= nvis then
inst.Visible = nvis
v[5] = nvis
end
if lzind ~= nzind then
inst.ZIndex = nzind
v[6] = nzind
end
end
local textsel = t % 9
if IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded then
textsel = t % 12
end
textsel //= 3
if text3mustchange ~= (textsel == 3) then
text3mustchange = (textsel == 3)
if text3mustchange then changequote() end
end
if textsel == 0 then
text0.Visible = true
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = false
elseif textsel == 1 then
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = true
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = false
elseif textsel == 2 then
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = false
text3.Visible = true
else
text0.Visible = false
text1.Visible = false
text2.Visible = true
text3.Visible = false
end
else
currentprocessor = math.random(1, #PositionProcessor)
end
end, CracktroFrame)
end
task.wait()

function UI.CreateText(parent, text, size, alignment)
local margin = 5
local Container = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
Container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65536)
Container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Container.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
local Text = Util.Instance("TextLabel", Container)
Text.Position = UDim2.new(0, margin, 0, 0)
Text.Size = UDim2.new(1, margin * -2, 1, -margin + 1)
Text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Text.RichText = true
Text.Font = Enum.Font.Code
Text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Text.TextTransparency = 0
Text.TextXAlignment = alignment
Text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
Text.TextWrapped = true
Text.TextSize = size
RegisterTextLabel(Text)
local lastCT, lastTS, lastFont, lastX
local function update()
local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
local ct, ts, fnt = Text.ContentText, Text.TextSize, Text.Font
if ct == lastCT and ts == lastTS and fnt == lastFont and x == lastX then return end
lastCT, lastTS, lastFont, lastX = ct, ts, fnt, x
local size = TextService:GetTextSize(ct, ts, fnt, Vector2.new(x - margin * 2, math.huge))
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size.Y + margin)
end
Text.Text = text
update()
Text.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
if prop == "TextColor3" or prop == "TextTransparency" or prop == "TextBounds" or prop == "TextFits" or prop == "AbsolutePosition" or prop == "AbsoluteRotation" then return end
update()
end)
return Text
end

local SliderC = Util.Instance("TextButton", Container)

local SliderR = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderC)

local range = max - min
if step > 0 then
if range / step < 20 then
local i = min + step
while i < max do
local snaps = Util.Instance("Frame", SliderR)
snaps.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
snaps.Position = UDim2.new((i - min) / range, 0, 0, 1)

snaps.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
snaps.BorderSizePixel = 0
i += step
end
end
end
local Select = Util.Instance("NumberValue")
local function update()
local str = string.format("%.3f", Select.Value)
if str:find("%.") then
while str:sub(-1) == "0" do
str = str:sub(1, -2)
if str:sub(-1) == "." then
str = str:sub(1, -2)
break
end
end
end
BoxText.Text = str
SliderB.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp((Select.Value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
if math.random(4) == 1 then
if str:find("67") or str:find("6.7") then
Util.UINotify("SIX SEVENNNN 67 67 67 67 OMG")
end
end
end
Select.Value = value
Select.Changed:Connect(update)
update()
BoxText.FocusLost:Connect(function()
Select.Value = tonumber(BoxText.Text) or Select.Value
update()
end)
local function ondrag(x)
local val = range * math.clamp((x - SliderR.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderR.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
if step > 0 then
val = math.round(val / step) * step
end
val += min
Select.Value = val
end
local dragref = nil
local start = nil
SliderC.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragref = input
start = input.Position
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragref then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and dragref == input) then
if start then
local delta = input.Position - start
if delta.Magnitude > 10 then
start = nil
if math.abs(delta.X) < math.abs(delta.Y) then
dragref = nil
end
end
else
ondrag(input.Position.X)
end
end
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if dragref and dragref == input then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
ondrag(input.Position.X)
dragref = nil
end
end
end)
return Select
end

local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X

local size2 = TextService:GetTextSize(DropdownText.ContentText, DropdownText.TextSize, DropdownText.Font, Vector2.new(x * 0.8 - margin * 2, math.huge))
Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, size1.Y, size2.Y + margin * 2))

DropdownText.Changed:Connect(update)

end)
local Droplist = Util.Instance("ScrollingFrame", UIMainFrame)
Droplist.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
Droplist.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Droplist.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

Droplist.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Droplist.BorderSizePixel = 0

UIList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical

UIList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
Stylize(Droplist, {
Glow = true
})
local items = {}
local sizex = 60
local interact = false
local opened = false
local dropStroke = Droplist:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
Util.LinkDestroyI2I(Dropdown, Droplist)
for i,itemname in array do
local Item = Util.Instance("TextButton", Droplist)
Item.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
Item.BackgroundTransparency = 0
Item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

Item.TextSize = 15
Item.Font = Enum.Font.Code
Item.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Item.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Item.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
Item.TextWrapped = false
RegisterTextLabel(Item)
table.insert(items, Item)
pcall(Util.FX.EnhanceItem, Item)
local size = TextService:GetTextSize(itemname, Item.TextSize, Item.Font, Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge))
sizex = math.max(sizex, size.X + 12)
Item.Activated:Connect(function()
Select.Value = i
opened = false
interact = true
end)
Item.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
interact = true
UISound.Click:Play()
end
end)
end
Dropdown.Activated:Connect(function()
opened = not opened
interact = true
end)
local conn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
task.wait()
if not interact then
opened = false
end
interact = false
end
end)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Dropdown, conn)
local scrollframe = Container:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
if scrollframe then
local conn = scrollframe:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()
opened = false
end)
end
local opentween, lastOpen = 0, false
AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
if opened ~= lastOpen then lastOpen = opened pcall(Util.FX.MotionBlur, 1.5, 0.5) end
if not opened and opentween < 0.002 then
if opentween ~= 0 or Droplist.Visible then
opentween = 0
Droplist.Visible = false
Droplist.ZIndex = 3
Droplist.Interactable = false
end
return
end
if opened then
opentween = 1 + (opentween - 1) * math.exp(-11 * dt)
Droplist.ZIndex = 4
Droplist.Interactable = true
else
opentween *= math.exp(-14 * dt)
Droplist.ZIndex = 3
Droplist.Interactable = false
end
local ysize = math.round(math.min(90, #items * 20) * opentween)
if ysize >= 1 then
Droplist.Position = Util.Vector2ToUDim2Offset((Dropdown.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(0, Dropdown.AbsoluteSize.Y - (1 - opentween) * 8)) - UIMainFrame.AbsolutePosition)
Droplist.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(Dropdown.Size.X.Offset, sizex), 0, ysize)
Droplist.Visible = true
local fade = 1 - math.clamp(opentween, 0, 1)
Droplist.BackgroundTransparency = fade
if dropStroke then dropStroke.Transparency = fade end
local n = 0
for _, v in items do
n = n + 1
local f = math.max(fade, math.clamp(1 - (opentween * 1.35 - (n - 1) * 0.07), 0, 1))
v.BackgroundTransparency = f
v.TextTransparency = f
end
else
Droplist.Visible = false
end
local i1 = GetUIBGColor(t)
local i2 = i1:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.1)
for i,v in items do
if i == Select.Value then
v.BackgroundColor3 = i2
else
v.BackgroundColor3 = i1
end
end
end, Droplist)
Util.LinkDestroyI2I(Dropdown, Select)
return Select, Text
end

local built, buildErr = pcall(function()
local S = {
Entries = {},
Items = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
Headers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
Titles = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
LastText = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
Pools = {switch = {}, action = {}, input = {}},
PageSize = 8,
Limit = 8,
MaxShown = 56,
HistoryMax = 15,
HistoryShow = 7,
Risky = {"clear all", "delete", "reset", "kill all", "server hop", "rejoin", "run all", "respawn", "buy module", "redownload", "reload"},
}
Util.Search = S
S.Titles[MainPage] = "Main"
local function plain(t)
t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
t = t:gsub("<[^>]*>", "")
t = t:gsub("&lt;", "<")
t = t:gsub("&gt;", ">")
t = t:gsub("&amp;", "&")
t = t:gsub("%s+", " ")
t = t:gsub("^ ", "")
t = t:gsub(" $", "")
return t
end
local function esc(t)
t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
t = t:gsub("&", "&amp;")
t = t:gsub("<", "&lt;")
t = t:gsub(">", "&gt;")
return t
end
local function trim(t)
t = tostring(t == nil and "" or t)
t = t:gsub("^%s+", "")
t = t:gsub("%s+$", "")
return t
end
local function fmt(n)
if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
local s = string.format("%.3f", n)
s = s:gsub("0+$", "")
s = s:gsub("%.$", "")
return s
end
local function safe(fn, ...)
local ok, v = pcall(fn, ...)
if ok then return v end
return nil
end
local function H()
local h = SaveData.SearchHistory
if type(h) ~= "table" then
h = {}
SaveData.SearchHistory = h
end
return h
end
do
local raw = H()
local clean, seen = {}, {}
for _, v in ipairs(raw) do
if type(v) == "string" then
local s = trim(v)
local key = s:lower()
if s ~= "" and not seen[key] and #clean < S.HistoryMax then
seen[key] = true
clean[#clean + 1] = s
end
end
end
SaveData.SearchHistory = clean
end
S.Remember = function(q)
q = trim(q)
if #q < 2 or #q > 60 then return end
local h = H()
local key = q:lower()
for i = #h, 1, -1 do
if type(h[i]) ~= "string" or h[i]:lower() == key then
table.remove(h, i)
end
end
table.insert(h, 1, q)
while #h > S.HistoryMax do
table.remove(h)
end
end
S.Forget = function(q)
local h = H()
for i = #h, 1, -1 do
if h[i] == q then
table.remove(h, i)
end
end
end
S.ClearHistory = function()
table.clear(H())
end
S.Section = function(parent, name)
S.Headers[parent] = name
end
S.Hook = function(item, data)
pcall(function()
local e = S.Items[item]
if e then
for k, v in pairs(data) do
e[k] = v
end
end
end)
end
local origText, origSwitch, origButton = UI.CreateText, UI.CreateSwitch, UI.CreateButton
local origDropdown, origSlider, origTextbox = UI.CreateDropdown, UI.CreateSlider, UI.CreateTextbox
local origItem = UI.CreateItemListItem
local function reg(e)
pcall(function()
S.Entries[#S.Entries + 1] = e
end)
end
local function skipLabel(l)
if l == "" then return true end
if l:sub(1, 1) == "<" then return true end
local ll = l:lower()
if ll:find("hurry back", 1, true) or ll:find("back to cool scene", 1, true) then return true end
return false
end
local function itemTexts(item)
local list = {}
for _, c in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("Frame") then
local tl = c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
if tl then
list[#list + 1] = {o = c.LayoutOrder, t = plain(tl.Text)}
end
end
end
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
return a.o < b.o
end)
return list
end
UI.CreateText = function(parent, text, size, alignment)
local label = origText(parent, text, size, alignment)
pcall(function()
local raw = tostring(text)
local head = raw:match("^%s*<b>(.-)</b>%s*$")
if head then
head = plain(head)
if head ~= "" then
S.Headers[parent] = head
if S.Titles[parent] == nil then
S.Titles[parent] = head
end
end
end
S.LastText[parent] = {Label = label, Text = plain(raw)}
end)
return label
end
UI.CreateSwitch = function(parent, text, value)
local lever, label = origSwitch(parent, text, value)
reg({Kind = "switch", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Lever = lever,
GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
return lever, label
end
UI.CreateButton = function(parent, text, size)
local button, label = origButton(parent, text, size)
pcall(function()
if not skipLabel(plain(text)) then
reg({Kind = "button", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Button = button,
GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
end
end)
return button, label
end
UI.CreateDropdown = function(parent, text, array, value)
local sel, label = origDropdown(parent, text, array, value)
reg({Kind = "dropdown", Obj = label, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Select = sel, Options = array,
GetName = function() return plain(label.Text) end})
return sel, label
end
UI.CreateSlider = function(parent, text, value, min, max, step)
local sel = origSlider(parent, text, value, min, max, step)
pcall(function()
local kids = parent:GetChildren()
local obj
for i = #kids, 1, -1 do
local k = kids[i]
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.LayoutOrder == #kids then
obj = k
break
end
end
obj = obj or kids[#kids]
reg({Kind = "input", Sub = "slider", Obj = obj, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Select = sel,
Min = min or 1, Max = max or 10, Step = math.abs(step or 0),
GetName = function() return plain(text) end})
end)
return sel
end
UI.CreateTextbox = function(parent, text, placeholder, size)
local box = origTextbox(parent, text, placeholder, size)
pcall(function()
local related
local prev = S.LastText[parent]
if prev and prev.Label and prev.Label.Parent then
local cont = box.Parent and box.Parent.Parent
if cont and cont.LayoutOrder == prev.Label.Parent.LayoutOrder + 1 then
if prev.Text ~= "" and #prev.Text <= 45 then
related = prev.Text
end
end
end
reg({Kind = "input", Sub = "textbox", Obj = box, Parent = parent, Section = S.Headers[parent], Box = box,
GetName = function()
if related then return related end
local ph = plain(box.PlaceholderText)
if ph ~= "" then return ph end
return "Text box"
end,
GetExtra = function() return plain(box.PlaceholderText) end})
end)
return box
end
UI.CreateItemListItem = function(parent)
local item = origItem(parent)
pcall(function()
local cache
local e = {Kind = "item", Obj = item, Parent = parent, Button = item,
GetName = function()
if cache then return cache end
local list = itemTexts(item)
local n = list[1] and list[1].t or ""
n = n:gsub("%s*>%s*$", "")
if n ~= "" then cache = n end
return n
end,
GetDesc = function()
local list = itemTexts(item)
return list[2] and list[2].t or ""
end,
GetExtra = function()
local n = item.Parent and item.Parent.Name or ""
local own = cache or ""
if own ~= "" and #n < 1500 and n:lower():find(own:lower(), 1, true) then
return n
end
local list = itemTexts(item)
return list[2] and list[2].t or ""
end}
S.Items[item] = e
reg(e)
end)
return item
end
local function alive(e)
local ok, res = pcall(function()
return e.Obj:IsDescendantOf(UIMainFrame)
end)
return ok and res == true
end
local function whereOf(e)
local page
local p = e.Parent
local guard = 0
while p ~= nil and p ~= UIMainFrame and guard < 40 do
local t = S.Titles[p]
if t then
page = t
end
p = p.Parent
guard += 1
end
local sec = e.Section
if page and sec and sec ~= page then
return page .. " > " .. sec
end
return sec or page or "Settings"
end
local function kindWord(e)
if e.Kind == "switch" then return "switch toggle" end
if e.Kind == "button" then return "button" end
if e.Kind == "dropdown" then return "dropdown option" end
if e.Kind == "input" then
return e.Sub == "slider" and "slider" or "textbox input"
end
if e.Group == "moveset" then return "moveset" end
if e.Group == "dance" then return "dance" end
return "item"
end
local function isRisky(e)
if e.Kind ~= "button" then return false end
local l = (safe(e.GetName) or ""):lower()
for _, w in ipairs(S.Risky) do
if l:find(w, 1, true) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function find(query)
local q = query:lower()
local words = {}
for w in q:gmatch("%S+") do
words[#words + 1] = w
end
local live, out = {}, {}
for idx, e in ipairs(S.Entries) do
if alive(e) then
live[#live + 1] = e
local okN, label = pcall(e.GetName)
if okN and type(label) == "string" and label ~= "" then
local where = whereOf(e)
local extra = ""
if e.GetExtra then
local ex = safe(e.GetExtra)
if type(ex) == "string" then
extra = ex:sub(1, 600)
end
end
local hay = (label .. " " .. where .. " " .. kindWord(e) .. " " .. extra):lower()
local hit = true
for _, w in ipairs(words) do
if not hay:find(w, 1, true) then
hit = false
break
end
end
if hit then
local ll = label:lower()
local score = 3
if ll:sub(1, #q) == q then
score = 1
elseif ll:find(q, 1, true) then
score = 2
end
out[#out + 1] = {Entry = e, Label = label, Score = score, Idx = idx}
end
end
end
end
if #S.Entries - #live > 40 then
S.Entries = live
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b)
if a.Score ~= b.Score then
return a.Score < b.Score
end
local la, lb = a.Label:lower(), b.Label:lower()
if la ~= lb then
return la < lb
end
return a.Idx < b.Idx
end)
return out
end
local function trigger(signal, ...)
local args = table.pack(...)
task.spawn(function()
local fired = false
if type(firesignal) == "function" then
fired = pcall(firesignal, signal, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
end
if not fired and type(getconnections) == "function" then
local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, signal)
if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
local okc = pcall(function()
c:Fire(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
end)
if okc then fired = true end
end
end
end
if not fired then
Util.Notify("Your executor can't press buttons from the search (needs firesignal or getconnections).")
end
end)
end
local function applyInput(e, txt)
if e.Sub == "slider" then
local n = tonumber(txt)
if not n then
Util.Notify("That is not a number.")
return
end
if e.Step and e.Step > 0 then
n = e.Min + math.round((n - e.Min) / e.Step) * e.Step
end
e.Select.Value = math.clamp(n, e.Min, e.Max)
else
e.Box.Text = txt
trigger(e.Box.FocusLost, true)
end
end
local SearchBox = origTextbox(MainPage, "", "Search everything... (fly, dance, hub)", 15)
local Results = Util.Instance("Frame", MainPage)
Results.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
Results.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
Results.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
Results.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Results.LayoutOrder = #MainPage:GetChildren()
Results.Visible = false

ResultsList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
ResultsList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
ResultsList.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
ResultsList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
ResultsList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
local Status = origText(Results, "", 11, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local StatusBox = Status.Parent
StatusBox.Visible = false
local before = {}
for _, c in ipairs(Results:GetChildren()) do
before[c] = true
end
UI.CreateSeparator(Results)
for _, c in ipairs(Results:GetChildren()) do
if not before[c] and c:IsA("Frame") then
c.LayoutOrder = 100000
end
end
local refresh, render, runEntry
local historyOpen = false
local function newSwitchRow()
local lever, label = origSwitch(Results, "", false)
local button = label.Parent
local row = {Type = "switch", Lever = lever, Label = label, Container = button.Parent, Conns = {}}
row.Container.Visible = false
button.Activated:Connect(function()
local e = row.Target
if e and e.Lever then
S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
e.Lever.Value = not e.Lever.Value
end
end)
return row
end
local function newActionRow()
local button, label = origButton(Results, "", 15)
label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
local pad = Util.Instance("UIPadding", label)
pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
local row = {Type = "action", Button = button, Label = label, Container = button.Parent, Conns = {}}
row.Container.Visible = false
button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
local t = input.UserInputType
if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
row.PressAt = os.clock()
end
end)
button.Activated:Connect(function()
local held = row.PressAt ~= nil and (os.clock() - row.PressAt) >= 0.5
row.PressAt = nil
local e = row.Target
if e then
local ok, err = pcall(runEntry, e, held, row)
if not ok then
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search action failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
end)
return row
end
local function newInputRow()
local box = origTextbox(Results, "", "", 14)
local row = {Type = "input", Box = box, Container = box.Parent.Parent, Conns = {}}
row.Container.Visible = false
box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
local txt = trim(box.Text)
box.Text = ""
local e = row.Target
if e and txt ~= "" then
local ok, err = pcall(applyInput, e, txt)
if not ok then
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search input failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
pcall(render, row, e)
end
end)
return row
end
local used = {}
local function acquire(kind)
local pool = S.Pools[kind]
local n = (used[kind] or 0) + 1
local row = pool[n]
if not row then
if kind == "switch" then
row = newSwitchRow()
elseif kind == "action" then
row = newActionRow()
else
row = newInputRow()
end
pool[n] = row
end
used[kind] = n
return row
end
local function fit(row)
pcall(function()
if row.Type == "input" then return end
local x = Results.AbsoluteSize.X
if x < 120 then
x = MainPage.AbsoluteSize.X
end
if row.Type == "switch" then
local sz = TextService:GetTextSize(row.Label.ContentText, row.Label.TextSize, row.Label.Font, Vector2.new(math.max(60, x - 65), math.huge))
row.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, sz.Y))
else
local sz = TextService:GetTextSize(row.Label.ContentText, row.Label.TextSize, row.Label.Font, Vector2.new(math.max(60, x - 24), math.huge))
row.Container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(35, sz.Y + 14))
end
end)
end
local function sub(t, warnColor)
if warnColor then
return "\n<font size=\"11\" color=\"" .. warnColor .. "\">" .. esc(t) .. "</font>"
end
return "\n<font size=\"11\" transparency=\"0.5\">" .. esc(t) .. "</font>"
end
local function armed(e)
return e.ArmedUntil ~= nil and os.clock() <= e.ArmedUntil
end
local function actionText(e)
local k = e.Kind
if k == "history" then
return esc(e.Query) .. sub("recent search  -  tap = search again, hold = remove")
elseif k == "clear" then
return "Clear search history" .. sub("removes every saved search")
elseif k == "more" then
return "Show more results" .. sub(e.Count .. " more match")
end
local label = safe(e.GetName) or ""
local where = whereOf(e)
if armed(e) then
return esc(label) .. sub("TAP AGAIN TO CONFIRM", "#FF5555")
end
if k == "dropdown" then
local cur = e.Options[e.Select.Value]
return esc(label) .. ": <b>" .. esc(tostring(cur)) .. "</b>" .. sub(where .. "  -  tap = next, hold = previous")
end
local state = e.State and safe(e.State)
local head = esc(label)
if state then
head = head .. "  <b>[" .. esc(state) .. "]</b>"
end
local hint
if k == "button" then
hint = "tap to run"
elseif e.Use then
hint = e.Hint or "tap = use, hold = open"
else
hint = "tap to open"
end
return head .. sub(where .. "  -  " .. hint)
end
local function inputPlaceholder(e)
local label = safe(e.GetName) or ""
local where = whereOf(e)
if e.Sub == "slider" then
return "Set " .. label .. " = " .. fmt(e.Select.Value) .. "  (" .. fmt(e.Min) .. " to " .. fmt(e.Max) .. ")  -  " .. where
end
local cur = e.Box.Text or ""
if #cur > 24 then
cur = cur:sub(1, 24) .. "..."
end
return "Set " .. label .. (cur ~= "" and (" = " .. cur) or "") .. "  -  " .. where
end
render = function(row, e)
if row.Type == "switch" then
row.Lever.Value = e.Lever.Value
row.Label.Text = esc(safe(e.GetName) or "") .. sub(whereOf(e))
elseif row.Type == "action" then
row.Label.Text = actionText(e)
else
row.Box.PlaceholderText = inputPlaceholder(e)
end
fit(row)
end
runEntry = function(e, alt, row)
local k = e.Kind
if k == "history" then
if alt then
S.Forget(e.Query)
refresh()
else
SearchBox.Text = e.Query
end
return
elseif k == "clear" then
S.ClearHistory()
refresh()
return
elseif k == "more" then
S.Limit = math.min(S.Limit + S.PageSize, S.MaxShown)
refresh()
return
end
if isRisky(e) and not armed(e) then
e.ArmedUntil = os.clock() + 3
render(row, e)
task.delay(3.1, function()
if row.Target == e then
pcall(render, row, e)
end
end)
return
end
e.ArmedUntil = nil
S.Remember(SearchBox.Text)
if k == "dropdown" then
local n = #e.Options
if n > 0 then
local dir = alt and -1 or 1
e.Select.Value = ((e.Select.Value - 1 + dir) % n) + 1
end
elseif k == "button" then
trigger(e.Button.Activated)
elseif k == "item" then
if e.Use and not alt then
e.Use()
else
trigger(e.Button.Activated)
end
end
render(row, e)
end
local function resetRows()
for _, pool in pairs(S.Pools) do
for _, r in ipairs(pool) do
for _, c in ipairs(r.Conns) do
c:Disconnect()
end
table.clear(r.Conns)
r.Target = nil
r.Container.Visible = false
end
end
table.clear(used)
StatusBox.Visible = false
end
local function place(entry, order)
local kind = "action"
if entry.Kind == "switch" then
kind = "switch"
elseif entry.Kind == "input" then
kind = "input"
end
local okR, row = pcall(acquire, kind)
if not okR or not row then
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search row failed: " .. tostring(row))
return nil
end
row.Target = entry
row.Container.LayoutOrder = order
row.Container.Visible = true
if kind == "switch" then
table.insert(row.Conns, entry.Lever.Changed:Connect(function(v)
row.Lever.Value = v
end))
end
local okD, err = pcall(render, row, entry)
if not okD then
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Search render failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
return row
end
refresh = function()
resetRows()
local query = trim(SearchBox.Text)
local placed = {}
if query == "" then
local h = H()
if #h == 0 or not (historyOpen or SearchBox:IsFocused()) then
Results.Visible = false
return
end
Results.Visible = true
Status.Text = "Recent searches"
StatusBox.LayoutOrder = 0
StatusBox.Visible = true
for i = 1, math.min(#h, S.HistoryShow) do
local r = place({Kind = "history", Query = h[i]}, i)
if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
end
local r = place({Kind = "clear"}, S.HistoryShow + 1)
if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
else
Results.Visible = true
local found = find(query)
local shown = math.min(#found, S.Limit)
for i = 1, shown do
local r = place(found[i].Entry, i)
if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
end
if shown == 0 then
Status.Text = "No matching options. Try another word."
StatusBox.LayoutOrder = 90000
StatusBox.Visible = true
elseif #found > shown then
local r = place({Kind = "more", Count = #found - shown}, shown + 1)
if r then placed[#placed + 1] = r end
end
end

for _, r in ipairs(placed) do
fit(r)
end
end)
end

local function switchart()
if AsciiTextartsw then return end
AsciiTextartsw = true
local function animation(art, inv)
local transmap = AsciiTextarttr[math.random(1, #AsciiTextarttr)]
local rot = math.random(0, 3)
local st = os.clock()
repeat
local t = os.clock() - st
local i = math.clamp(math.floor(t * 60) + 1, 1, 60)
local render = {}
for iy=1, #art do
local y = (iy - 1) / #art
local conc = ""
local txt = art[iy]
for ix=1, #txt do
local x = (ix - 1) / #txt
local ch = string.sub(txt, ix, ix)
local b = 0
if rot == 0 then
b = transmap[i][math.floor(y * 64) + 1][math.floor(x * 64) + 1]
elseif rot == 1 then
b = transmap[i][math.floor(x * 64) + 1][64 - math.floor(y * 64)]
elseif rot == 2 then
b = transmap[i][64 - math.floor(y * 64)][64 - math.floor(x * 64)]
elseif rot == 3 then
b = transmap[i][64 - math.floor(x * 64)][math.floor(y * 64) + 1]
end
if inv then b = 3 - b end
if b == 1 then
if (ch == ch:upper() and ch ~= ch:lower()) or ch == "8" or ch == "0" then
ch = "?"
elseif ch == ":" or ch == ";" or ch == "_" then
ch = "."
elseif ch == "." or ch == "," or ch == " " then
ch = " "
else
ch = ":"
end
elseif b == 2 then
if (ch == ch:upper() and ch ~= ch:lower()) or ch == "8" or ch == "0" then
ch = ":"
elseif ch == ":" or ch == ";" or ch == "_" or ch == "." or ch == "," or ch == " " then
ch = " "
else
ch = "."
end
elseif b == 3 then
ch = " "
end
conc ..= ch
end
table.insert(render, conc)
end
AsciiText.Text = table.concat(render, "\n")
task.wait()
until os.clock() > st + 1
end
local source = string.split(AsciiText.Text, "\n")
local target = source
while table.concat(source, "\n") == table.concat(target, "\n") do
task.wait()
target = AsciiTextarts[math.random(1, #AsciiTextarts)]
end
animation(source, false)
animation(target, true)
AsciiText.Text = table.concat(target, "\n")
AsciiTextartsw = false
end
local AsciiTextartin = nil
AsciiText.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
AsciiTextartin = input
end
end)
AsciiText.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if AsciiTextartin == input then
AsciiTextartin = nil
switchart()
end
end)
switchart()
end)

local function norm(t)
t = tostring(t or ""):gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("&gt;", ""):gsub("&lt;", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
t = t:gsub("^[%s%*%-=+<>]+", ""):gsub("[%s%*%-=+<>:]+$", "")
return t:lower()
end
local function lastRow(parent)
local best
for _, k in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and (not best or k.LayoutOrder >= best.LayoutOrder) then best = k end
end
return best
end
local function hintRow(parent, cont, text, center)
local w = math.max(parent.AbsoluteSize.X, 240) - 22
local dh = TextService:GetTextSize(text, 11, Enum.Font.Code, Vector2.new(w, math.huge)).Y
local row = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, dh + 5)
row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
row.LayoutOrder = #parent:GetChildren()
row.Interactable = false
row.Visible = cont.Visible
local lbl = Util.Instance("TextLabel", row)
lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, -2)
lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
lbl.TextSize = 11
lbl.TextWrapped = true
lbl.TextXAlignment = center and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
lbl.Text = text
RegisterTextLabel(lbl)
lbl.TextTransparency = 0.45
cont:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
row.Visible = cont.Visible
end)
cont.Destroying:Once(function()
row:Destroy()
end)
end
local function addPill(cont, lever)
if typeof(lever) ~= "Instance" or not lever:IsA("BoolValue") then return end
local p = Util.Instance("TextLabel", cont)
p.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
p.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, 0)
p.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 14)
p.BackgroundTransparency = 1
p.Font = Enum.Font.Code
p.TextSize = 11
p.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
p.Interactable = false
RegisterTextLabel(p)
local sc
local function paint(anim)
local on = lever.Value
p.Text = on and "ON" or "OFF"
local tr = on and 0 or 0.6
if anim and Util.FX.Settings.Transitions and not Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then
sc = sc or Util.Instance("UIScale", p)
sc.Scale = 0.55
p.TextTransparency = 1
TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = tr}):Play()
else
p.TextTransparency = tr
end
end
paint(false)
lever.Changed:Connect(function()
paint(true)
end)
end
local function contOf(kind, r, parent)
local c
if kind == "switch" then
c = r[2] and r[2].Parent and r[2].Parent.Parent
elseif kind == "button" then
c = r[1] and r[1].Parent
elseif kind == "dropdown" then
c = r[2] and r[2].Parent
end
if c and c.Parent == parent then return c end
return lastRow(parent)
end
local function wrap(name, kind)
local orig = UI[name]
UI[name] = function(parent, text, ...)
local r = table.pack(orig(parent, text, ...))
pcall(function()
local hint = H[norm(text)]
if not hint and kind ~= "switch" then return end
local cont = contOf(kind, r, parent)
if not cont then return end
if kind == "switch" then addPill(cont, r[1]) end
if hint then hintRow(parent, cont, hint, kind == "button") end
end)
return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
end
end
wrap("CreateSwitch", "switch")
wrap("CreateSlider", "slider")
wrap("CreateDropdown", "dropdown")
wrap("CreateButton", "button")
end

local SERVER_JS = [==[
// node broadcast_server.js   (env: OWNER_KEY_SHA256 = sha256 hex of the owner key, OWNER_NAME = the owner's username as listed in roles.json, PORT optional)
const http = require("http"), crypto = require("crypto");
const OWNER = process.env.OWNER_NAME || "", KEYHASH = String(process.env.OWNER_KEY_SHA256 || "").toLowerCase();
const sha = s => crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(s)).digest("hex");
const seen = new Map();
const proofOk = (req, path, bind) => {
  const hd = n => String(req.headers[n] || ""), ts = hd("x-uh-ts"), nonce = hd("x-uh-nonce"), proof = hd("x-uh-proof"), uid = hd("x-uh-user");
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(KEYHASH) || !/^\d{9,12}$/.test(ts) || !/^\d{1,16}$/.test(uid) || !/^[0-9a-f]{16,96}$/.test(nonce) || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(proof)) return false;
  if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - Number(ts)) > 120 || seen.has(nonce)) return false;
  if (!crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sha([KEYHASH, uid, "", path, ts, nonce, bind].join("|"))), Buffer.from(proof))) return false;
  seen.set(nonce, Date.now());
  for (const [k, t] of seen) if (Date.now() - t > 300000) seen.delete(k);
  return true;
};
let msgs = [], lastId = 0, lastSend = 0;
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const u = new URL(req.url, "http://x");
  const out = (c, o) => { res.writeHead(c, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }); res.end(JSON.stringify(o)); };
  if (req.method === "GET" && u.pathname === "/poll") {
    const a = u.searchParams.get("after");
    return out(200, { id: lastId, msgs: a === null ? [] : msgs.filter(m => m.id > Number(a)) });
  }
  if (req.method === "POST" && u.pathname === "/send") {
    let b = "";
    req.on("data", d => { b += d; if (b.length > 4096) req.destroy(); });
    req.on("end", () => {
      let j; try { j = JSON.parse(b); } catch { return out(400, {}); }
      if (!proofOk(req, "/send", String(j.text || "")) || !OWNER || j.user !== OWNER) return out(403, {});
      const text = String(j.text || "").replace(/[\u0000-\u001f<>]/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 200);
      if (!text || Date.now() - lastSend < 2000) return out(400, {});
      lastSend = Date.now();
      lastId = Math.max(Date.now(), lastId + 1);
      msgs.push({ id: lastId, text });
      msgs = msgs.slice(-50);
      out(200, { id: lastId });
    });
    return;
  }
  out(404, {});
}).listen(process.env.PORT || 3000);
]==]

local drag, dragInput = nil, nil
local function scrollParent()
local p = Container.Parent
while p do
if p:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return p end
p = p.Parent
end
return nil
end
local function setScroll(on)
local sf = scrollParent()
if sf then sf.ScrollingEnabled = on end
end
local function applyPos(x, y)
if drag == "sv" then
s = math.clamp((x - SV.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, SV.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
v = 1 - math.clamp((y - SV.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, SV.AbsoluteSize.Y), 0, 1)
elseif drag == "hue" then
h = math.clamp((y - Hue.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, Hue.AbsoluteSize.Y), 0, 0.9999)
end
commit()
end
local function begin(kind)
return function(input)
if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
drag, dragInput = kind, input
setScroll(false)
applyPos(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
end
end
end
SV.InputBegan:Connect(begin("sv"))
Hue.InputBegan:Connect(begin("hue"))
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Container, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if drag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == dragInput)) then
applyPos(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
end
end))
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(Container, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if drag and (input == dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
drag, dragInput = nil, nil
setScroll(true)
end
end))
return Value
end
Util.UIPlus = (function()
local P = {}
local FONTS = {Enum.Font.Code, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Enum.Font.SciFi, Enum.Font.Arcade, Enum.Font.Ubuntu, Enum.Font.RobotoMono, Enum.Font.Fantasy}
P.FontNames = {"Code (default)", "Gotham", "Sci-Fi", "Arcade", "Ubuntu", "Roboto Mono", "Fantasy"}
local function cfg() return Util.FX.Cfg end
local function fontFor(o)
if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") then
local f = FONTS[cfg().UIFont or 1] or FONTS[1]
if o.Font ~= f then o.Font = f end
end
end
function P.ApplyFont()
for _, d in ipairs(UIMainWindow:GetDescendants()) do pcall(fontFor, d) end
if not P.fontConn then
P.fontConn = UIMainWindow.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
if (cfg().UIFont or 1) ~= 1 then task.defer(function() pcall(fontFor, d) end) end
end)
end
end
function P.ApplyScale()
local s = (cfg().UIScale or 1) * (Util.GlassFit and Util.GlassFit() or 1)
if not P.scaleObj then
if s == 1 then return end
UIMainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
UIMainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
P.scaleObj = Util.Instance("UIScale", UIMainFrame)
end
P.scaleObj.Scale = s
end
function P.ApplyParticles()
local on = cfg().UIParticles
if on and not P.motes then
local box = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainWindow)
box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
box.ClipsDescendants = true
box.ZIndex = 40
box.Interactable = false
local list = {}
for i = 1, 18 do
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", box)
local sz = 2 + (i % 3)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 40
f.Interactable = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
list[i] = {f = f, x = math.random(), y = math.random(), s = 0.02 + math.random() * 0.05, p = math.random() * 6}
end
P.motes = box
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t, dt)
if not box.Visible then return end
local pal = Util.Color.Palette(t)
for i, m in ipairs(list) do
m.y = m.y - m.s * dt
if m.y < -0.05 then m.y = 1.05 m.x = math.random() end
m.f.Position = UDim2.new(m.x + math.sin(t * 0.7 + m.p) * 0.02, 0, m.y, 0)
m.f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and pal.Accent or pal.Secondary
m.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 2 + m.p)
end
end, box)
end
if P.motes then P.motes.Visible = on and true or false end
end
function P.ApplySheen()
local on = cfg().UIGradient
if on and not P.sheen then
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainWindow)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.ZIndex = 39
f.Interactable = false
local corner = Util.Instance("UICorner", f)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.86, 0.96)
P.sheen = f
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t)
if not f.Visible then return end
local pal = Util.Color.Palette(t)
g.Color = ColorSequence.new(pal.Accent, pal.Secondary)
g.Rotation = (t * 18) % 360
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, cfg().UIRound)
end, f)
end
if P.sheen then P.sheen.Visible = on and true or false end
end
function P.ApplyTrail()
if P.trailOn then return end
P.trailOn = true
local last = Vector2.new(-100, -100)
local acc = 0
Util.AddDecoStep(function(t, dt)
if not cfg().UITrail or not UIMainFrame.Visible then return end
local ok, m = pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() end)
if not ok or not UserInputService.MouseEnabled then return end
acc = acc + dt
if (m - last).Magnitude > 8 and acc > 0.02 then
acc = 0
last = m
local d = Util.Instance("Frame", UIMainFrame)
d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

Util.Mini = (function()
local MG = {Games = {}, ByID = {}, Plugins = {}, Errors = {}, Active = nil, Version = "25.0"}
local HUDFONT = Enum.Font.Code
local RS = RunService
local UIS = UserInputService
local function rname() return Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(10) or "mg" end
local function new(class, parent, props)
local o = Instance.new(class)
o.Name = rname()
if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end end
if parent then o.Parent = parent end
return o
end
MG.new = new
local V3, V2, C3 = Vector3.new, Vector2.new, Color3.new
local U2 = UDim2.new
local pi = math.pi
local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
local function approach(v, target, step) if v < target then return math.min(v + step, target) end return math.max(v - step, target) end
local function wrapang(a)
if a ~= a or a == math.huge or a == -math.huge then return 0 end
if a > pi or a < -pi then a = (a + pi) % (2 * pi) - pi end
return a
end
MG.clamp, MG.lerp, MG.approach, MG.wrapang = clamp, lerp, approach, wrapang
local function fwd(yaw) return V3(-math.sin(yaw), 0, -math.cos(yaw)) end
local function rgt(yaw) return V3(math.cos(yaw), 0, -math.sin(yaw)) end
MG.fwd, MG.rgt = fwd, rgt
local function safe(fn, ...)
local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
if not ok then
if #MG.Errors < 40 then MG.Errors[#MG.Errors + 1] = tostring(err) end
warn("[Minigames] " .. tostring(err))
end
return ok, err
end
MG.safe = safe
function MG.Data(id)
local store = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
if not store then MG._fallback = MG._fallback or {} store = MG._fallback end
if type(store.MiniData) ~= "table" then store.MiniData = {} end
if type(store.MiniData[id]) ~= "table" then store.MiniData[id] = {} end
return store.MiniData[id]
end

pcall(function() last = UIS:GetLastInputType() end)
if UIS.TouchEnabled and (not UIS.KeyboardEnabled or last == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return "Mobile" end
return "PC"
end

UI.ghosts = {}
function UI.Bar(parent, pos, size, o)
o = o or {}
local z = o.z or 5
local back = UI.Frame(parent, pos, size, {tr = 0.45, round = 3, stroke = 1, anchor = o.anchor, z = o.z})
local ghost = new("Frame", back, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C3(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.6, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z})
new("UICorner", ghost, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)})
local fill = new("Frame", back, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = o.color or C3(1, 0.2, 0.2), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 1})
new("UICorner", fill, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)})
if o.theme then UI.Theme(fill, "BackgroundColor3", o.theme) end
local bar = {back = back, fill = fill, ghost = ghost, v = 1, g = 1, hold = 0}
function bar:Set(frac)
if frac ~= frac then frac = 0 end
frac = clamp(frac, 0, 1)
if frac == self.v then return end
if frac < self.v then
local drop = self.v - frac
if drop >= 0.04 then
if self.g < self.v then self.g = self.v end
self.hold = 0.35
UI.ghosts[self] = true
elseif self.g > self.v then
UI.ghosts[self] = true
else
self.g = frac
self.ghost.Size = U2(frac, 0, 1, 0)
end
elseif frac >= self.g then
self.g = frac
self.ghost.Size = U2(frac, 0, 1, 0)
end
self.v = frac
self.fill.Size = U2(frac, 0, 1, 0)
end
return bar
end
function UI.Tick(dt)
for bar in pairs(UI.ghosts) do
if not bar.back.Parent then UI.ghosts[bar] = nil
elseif bar.hold > 0 then bar.hold = bar.hold - dt
else
bar.g = math.max(bar.v, bar.g - dt * 0.7)
bar.ghost.Size = U2(bar.g, 0, 1, 0)
if bar.g <= bar.v then UI.ghosts[bar] = nil end
end
end
end

BackgroundTransparency = o.tr or 0.25, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = o.anchor or V2(0, 0), ZIndex = o.z or 8})

end)
if cb then b.Activated:Connect(function() safe(cb) end) end

end
local toastSeq = 0
function UI.Toast(root, text, secs)
local holder = root:FindFirstChild("MGToasts")
if not holder then
holder = new("Frame", root, {Name = "MGToasts", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = U2(0.5, 0, 0.3, 0), Position = U2(0.25, 0, 0.08, 0), ZIndex = 40})
new("UIListLayout", holder, {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4), HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center})

while #live >= 4 do table.remove(live, 1):Destroy() end
toastSeq = toastSeq + 1
local l = UI.Label(holder, text, U2(1, 0, 0, 26), U2(1, 0, 0, 26), {size = 20, xa = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, z = 41, theme = "Accent"})

l.TextTransparency = 1
TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
task.delay(secs or 2.2, function()
if not l.Parent then return end
TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play()
task.delay(0.32, function() if l.Parent then l:Destroy() end end)
end)
return l
end
local function rayBoxS(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, maxd)
local tmin, tmax = 0, maxd
local hitAxis, hitSign = 0, 0
if dx > -1e-9 and dx < 1e-9 then
if ox < x0 or ox > x1 then return nil end
else
local t1, t2 = (x0 - ox) / dx, (x1 - ox) / dx
local sg = -1
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 sg = 1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin = t1 hitAxis = 1 hitSign = sg end
if t2 < tmax then tmax = t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return nil end
end
if dy > -1e-9 and dy < 1e-9 then
if oy < y0 or oy > y1 then return nil end
else
local t1, t2 = (y0 - oy) / dy, (y1 - oy) / dy
local sg = -1
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 sg = 1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin = t1 hitAxis = 2 hitSign = sg end
if t2 < tmax then tmax = t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return nil end
end
if dz > -1e-9 and dz < 1e-9 then
if oz < z0 or oz > z1 then return nil end
else
local t1, t2 = (z0 - oz) / dz, (z1 - oz) / dz
local sg = -1
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 sg = 1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin = t1 hitAxis = 3 hitSign = sg end
if t2 < tmax then tmax = t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return nil end
end
return tmin, hitAxis, hitSign
end
local function rayBox(o, d, mn, mx, maxd)
local t, ax, sg = rayBoxS(o.X, o.Y, o.Z, d.X, d.Y, d.Z, mn.X, mn.Y, mn.Z, mx.X, mx.Y, mx.Z, maxd)
if not t then return nil end
return t, V3(ax == 1 and sg or 0, ax == 2 and sg or 0, ax == 3 and sg or 0)
end
MG.rayBox = rayBox
local Boxes = {}
Boxes.__index = Boxes
function MG.NewBoxes() return setmetatable({list = {}}, Boxes) end
function Boxes:Add(center, size, tag, data)
local h = size * 0.5
local mn, mx = center - h, center + h
local b = {min = mn, max = mx, x0 = mn.X, y0 = mn.Y, z0 = mn.Z, x1 = mx.X, y1 = mx.Y, z1 = mx.Z, tag = tag, data = data}
self.list[#self.list + 1] = b
return b
end
function Boxes:Sync(b)
local mn, mx = b.min, b.max
b.x0, b.y0, b.z0, b.x1, b.y1, b.z1 = mn.X, mn.Y, mn.Z, mx.X, mx.Y, mx.Z
end
function Boxes:Remove(b)
local i = table.find(self.list, b)
if i then table.remove(self.list, i) end
end
function Boxes:Overlaps(mn, mx, ignoreTag)
local ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz = mn.X, mn.Y, mn.Z, mx.X, mx.Y, mx.Z
local list = self.list
for i = 1, #list do
local b = list[i]
if b.solid ~= false and ax < b.x1 and bx > b.x0 and ay < b.y1 and by > b.y0 and az < b.z1 and bz > b.z0 and (ignoreTag == nil or b.tag ~= ignoreTag) then return b end
end
return nil
end
function Boxes:OverlapsExcept(mn, mx, skip)
local ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz = mn.X, mn.Y, mn.Z, mx.X, mx.Y, mx.Z
local list = self.list
for i = 1, #list do
local b = list[i]
if b ~= skip and b.solid ~= false and ax < b.x1 and bx > b.x0 and ay < b.y1 and by > b.y0 and az < b.z1 and bz > b.z0 then return b end
end
return nil
end
function Boxes:Ray(o, d, maxd)
local best, bb, bax, bsg = maxd, nil, 0, 0
local ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz = o.X, o.Y, o.Z, d.X, d.Y, d.Z
local list = self.list
for i = 1, #list do
local b = list[i]
if b.solid ~= false and b.noRay ~= true then
local t, ax, sg = rayBoxS(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, b.x0, b.y0, b.z0, b.x1, b.y1, b.z1, best)
if t and t < best then best, bb, bax, bsg = t, b, ax, sg end
end
end
if bb then return best, V3(bax == 1 and bsg or 0, bax == 2 and bsg or 0, bax == 3 and bsg or 0), bb end
return nil
end
function Boxes:Solid(mn, mx) return self:Overlaps(mn, mx) ~= nil end
function MG.Move(world, pos, vel, half, dt, stepUp)
local grounded = false
local function box(p) return V3(p.X - half.X, p.Y, p.Z - half.Z), V3(p.X + half.X, p.Y + half.Y * 2, p.Z + half.Z) end
local function axis(p, d, ax)
if d == 0 then return p, false end
local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(math.abs(d) / 0.4))
local sd = d / steps
local hit = false
for _ = 1, steps do
local np = V3(p.X + (ax == 1 and sd or 0), p.Y + (ax == 2 and sd or 0), p.Z + (ax == 3 and sd or 0))
local mn, mx = box(np)
if world:Solid(mn, mx) then
hit = true
if ax ~= 2 and stepUp then
local up = V3(np.X, np.Y + stepUp, np.Z)
local m2, x2 = box(up)
if not world:Solid(m2, x2) then p = up hit = false else break end
else
break
end
else
p = np
end
end
return p, hit
end
local hitx, hity, hitz
pos, hitx = axis(pos, vel.X * dt, 1)
pos, hitz = axis(pos, vel.Z * dt, 3)
pos, hity = axis(pos, vel.Y * dt, 2)
local nv = V3(hitx and 0 or vel.X, hity and 0 or vel.Y, hitz and 0 or vel.Z)
if hity and vel.Y <= 0 then grounded = true end
if not grounded and vel.Y <= 0 then
local mn, mx = box(V3(pos.X, pos.Y - 0.06, pos.Z))
if world:Solid(mn, mx) then grounded = true end
end
return pos, nv, grounded, (hitx or hitz)
end
local Vox = {}
Vox.__index = Vox
function MG.NewVoxels(sx, sy, sz)
return setmetatable({sx = sx, sy = sy, sz = sz, cells = {}, ox = 0, oy = 0, oz = 0}, Vox)
end
function Vox:Key(x, y, z) return (x * 4099 + y) * 4111 + z end
function Vox:Get(x, y, z)
if x < 0 or y < 0 or z < 0 or x >= self.sx or y >= self.sy or z >= self.sz then return nil end
return self.cells[self:Key(x, y, z)]
end
function Vox:Set(x, y, z, v)
if x < 0 or y < 0 or z < 0 or x >= self.sx or y >= self.sy or z >= self.sz then return false end
self.cells[self:Key(x, y, z)] = v
return true
end
function Vox:Solid(mn, mx)
local x0, x1 = math.floor(mn.X), math.floor(mx.X - 1e-4)
local y0, y1 = math.floor(mn.Y), math.floor(mx.Y - 1e-4)
local z0, z1 = math.floor(mn.Z), math.floor(mx.Z - 1e-4)
for x = x0, x1 do for y = y0, y1 do for z = z0, z1 do
local c = self:Get(x, y, z)
if c ~= nil and c ~= 0 then return true end
if x < 0 or x >= self.sx or z < 0 or z >= self.sz then return true end
end end end
return false
end
function Vox:Ray(o, d, maxd)
local ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz = o.X, o.Y, o.Z, d.X, d.Y, d.Z
local x, y, z = math.floor(ox), math.floor(oy), math.floor(oz)
local sx, sy, sz = dx > 0 and 1 or -1, dy > 0 and 1 or -1, dz > 0 and 1 or -1
local tdx = dx == 0 and 1e9 or math.abs(1 / dx)
local tdy = dy == 0 and 1e9 or math.abs(1 / dy)
local tdz = dz == 0 and 1e9 or math.abs(1 / dz)
local tmx = dx == 0 and 1e9 or ((sx > 0 and (x + 1) or x) - ox) / dx
local tmy = dy == 0 and 1e9 or ((sy > 0 and (y + 1) or y) - oy) / dy
local tmz = dz == 0 and 1e9 or ((sz > 0 and (z + 1) or z) - oz) / dz
local t, nx, ny, nz = 0, 0, 0, 0
local cells, SX, SY, SZ = self.cells, self.sx, self.sy, self.sz
for _ = 1, 400 do
if x >= 0 and y >= 0 and z >= 0 and x < SX and y < SY and z < SZ then
local c = cells[(x * 4099 + y) * 4111 + z]
if c ~= nil and c ~= 0 then return t, V3(nx, ny, nz), x, y, z end
end
if tmx < tmy and tmx < tmz then t = tmx x = x + sx tmx = tmx + tdx nx, ny, nz = -sx, 0, 0
elseif tmy < tmz then t = tmy y = y + sy tmy = tmy + tdy nx, ny, nz = 0, -sy, 0
else t = tmz z = z + sz tmz = tmz + tdz nx, ny, nz = 0, 0, -sz end
if t > maxd then return nil end
end
return nil
end

pcall(function() sg.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)

local Scene = {}
Scene.__index = Scene
function MG.NewScene(root, o)
o = o or {}
local vp = new("ViewportFrame", root, {Size = U2(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = o.sky or C3(0.5, 0.7, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1,
Ambient = o.ambient or C3(0.55, 0.55, 0.6), LightColor = o.lightColor or C3(1, 0.97, 0.9), LightDirection = o.lightDir or V3(-0.5, -1, -0.3)})
local cam = new("Camera", nil, {FieldOfView = o.fov or 75, CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 8, 0)})
pcall(function() cam.NearPlaneZ = -0.1 end)
cam.Parent = vp
vp.CurrentCamera = cam
pcall(function() vp.Visible = true vp.ImageTransparency = 0 vp.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end)
local s = setmetatable({vp = vp, cam = cam, count = 0, shake = 0, fov = o.fov or 75}, Scene)
return s
end
function Scene:Part(pos, size, color, o)
o = o or {}
local p = new("Part", self.vp, {Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false, CanQuery = false, CastShadow = o.shadow == true, Size = size, Color = color or C3(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
Material = o.mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Transparency = o.tr or 0, TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth})
if o.shape then p.Shape = o.shape end
p.CFrame = o.cframe or CFrame.new(pos)
self.count = self.count + 1
return p
end
function Scene:SetCam(pos, yaw, pitch, roll)
local sh = self.shake
local off = V3(0, 0, 0)
local now = os.clock()
local sdt = self._st and clamp(now - self._st, 0, 0.1) or 1 / 60
self._st = now
if sh > 0.001 then off = V3((math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (math.random() - 0.5) * sh) self.shake = sh * (0.88 ^ (sdt * 60)) end
self.cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + off) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, roll or 0)
self.cam.FieldOfView = self.fov
end
function Scene:LookAt(pos, target) self.cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, target) self.cam.FieldOfView = self.fov end
function Scene:Destroy() self.vp:Destroy() end
local FX_CAP = 220
function MG.NewFX(scene)
local fx = {list = {}, scene = scene, pool = {}}
local function grab(pos, size, color, mat, shape)
local p = table.remove(fx.pool)
if p and p.Parent then
p.Size, p.Color, p.Material, p.Transparency = size, color, mat, 0
p.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
return p
end
return scene:Part(pos, size, color, {mat = mat, shape = shape})
end
local function push(e)
local l = fx.list
if #l >= FX_CAP then
local old = table.remove(l, 1)
if old.p.Parent then old.p.Transparency = 1 fx.pool[#fx.pool + 1] = old.p end
end
l[#l + 1] = e
end
local NEON = Enum.Material.Neon
function fx:Tracer(a, b, color, life, width)
local d = b - a
local len = d.Magnitude
if len < 0.1 then return end
local mid = (a + b) * 0.5
local p = grab(mid, V3(width or 0.08, width or 0.08, len), color or C3(1, 0.9, 0.5), NEON)
p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b)
push({p = p, t = life or 0.07, life = life or 0.07, kind = "fade"})
end
function fx:Spark(pos, color, n, speed, life)
for _ = 1, n or 5 do
local p = grab(pos, V3(0.18, 0.18, 0.18), color or C3(1, 0.8, 0.3), NEON)
local v = V3(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.8 + 0.1, math.random() - 0.5).Unit * ((speed or 6) * (0.4 + math.random()))
push({p = p, t = life or 0.45, life = life or 0.45, kind = "spark", v = v, pos = pos})
end
end
function fx:Flash(pos, color, size, life)
local p = grab(pos, V3(size or 1, size or 1, size or 1), color or C3(1, 0.8, 0.4), NEON, Enum.PartType.Ball)
push({p = p, t = life or 0.12, life = life or 0.12, kind = "grow", size = size or 1})
end
function fx:Ring(pos, color, size, life)
local p = grab(pos, V3(0.2, 1, 1), color or C3(1, 0.7, 0.3), NEON, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, pi / 2)
push({p = p, t = life or 0.35, life = life or 0.35, kind = "ring", size = size or 6, pos = pos})
end
function fx:Smoke(pos, size, life)
local p = grab(pos, V3(size or 1, size or 1, size or 1), C3(0.35, 0.35, 0.37), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
push({p = p, t = life or 0.9, life = life or 0.9, kind = "smoke", size = size or 1, pos = pos, v = V3((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, 2 + math.random() * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5)})
end
function fx:Update(dt)
local l = self.list
local n = 0
for i = 1, #l do
local e = l[i]
local p = e.p
e.t = e.t - dt
if e.t <= 0 or not p.Parent then
if p.Parent then p.Transparency = 1 self.pool[#self.pool + 1] = p end
else
local k = e.t / e.life
local kind = e.kind
if kind == "fade" then p.Transparency = 1 - k
elseif kind == "spark" then
e.v = e.v - V3(0, 22 * dt, 0)
e.pos = e.pos + e.v * dt
p.CFrame = CFrame.new(e.pos)
p.Transparency = 1 - k
elseif kind == "grow" then
local sz = e.size * (1.6 - k * 0.8)
p.Size = V3(sz, sz, sz)
p.Transparency = 1 - k
elseif kind == "ring" then
local sz = e.size * (1 - k) + 0.5
p.Size = V3(0.2, sz, sz)
p.Transparency = 1 - k
elseif kind == "smoke" then
e.pos = e.pos + e.v * dt
local sz = e.size * (1 + (1 - k) * 1.8)
p.Size = V3(sz, sz, sz)
p.CFrame = CFrame.new(e.pos)
p.Transparency = 0.45 + 0.55 * (1 - k)
end
n = n + 1
l[n] = e
end
end
for i = #l, n + 1, -1 do l[i] = nil end
local pool = self.pool
while #pool > 120 do local p = table.remove(pool) if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end
end
return fx
end
local Rig = {}
Rig.__index = Rig
local PT, MAT = Enum.PartType, Enum.Material
function Rig:Add(host, pos, size, color, o)
o = o or {}
local s = self.s
local p = self.scene:Part(V3(0, 0, 0), size * s, color, {mat = o.mat, shape = o.shape, tr = o.tr})
self.parts[#self.parts + 1] = p
self.acc[#self.acc + 1] = {p = p, host = host, off = CFrame.new(pos * s) * (o.rot or CFrame.new())}
return p
end
