local function AddModule(func)
GiveFunctionsToFunction(func)
local m = func()
if m and type(m) == "table" then
if m.ModuleType == "MOVESET" then
return AddMoveset(m)
elseif m.ModuleType == "DANCE" then
return AddDance(m)
else
return nil, "Unknown ModuleType for Module!"
end
else
return nil, "Module return value is not a table. Got " .. typeof(m) .. " instead."
end
end
do
local lastT = os.clock()
Util.ModuleYield = function(reset)
if reset then lastT = os.clock() return end
local prof = type(_G) == "table" and _G.UHDevProfile
local tier = type(prof) == "table" and tonumber(prof.Tier) or 3
if os.clock() - lastT >= (tier <= 1 and 0.003 or (tier == 2 and 0.0045 or 0.006)) then
task.wait()
lastT = os.clock()
end
end
end
local function AddModules(list)
local names = {}
local logging = ""
Util.ModuleYield(true)
if type(list) == "table" then
for i=1, #list do
local okM, name, logging2 = pcall(AddModule, list[i])
if not okM then
logging ..= "\n[ERROR] M" .. i .. ": " .. tostring(name)
else
if name then table.insert(names, name) end
if logging2 then
logging ..= "\n[ERROR] M" .. i .. ": " .. logging2
end
end
Util.ModuleYield()
end
else
logging ..= "\n[LOG] Module return value is not a table array of module functions. Skipping."
end
logging ..= "\n[LOG] Loaded " .. #names .. " modules."
return names, logging
end

local Kinds = {

local function search(kind, q)
q = string.lower(tostring(q or "")):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
local out = {}
if q == "" then return out end
for _, m in Kinds[kind].List() do
local n = string.lower(tostring(m.Name))
local sc = nil
if n == q then sc = 0
elseif n:sub(1, #q) == q then sc = 1
elseif n:find(q, 1, true) then sc = 2
elseif string.lower(tostring(m.Description or "")):find(q, 1, true) then sc = 3 end
if sc then out[#out + 1] = {m = m, s = sc} end
end
table.sort(out, function(a, b)
if a.s ~= b.s then return a.s < b.s end
return tostring(a.m.Name) < tostring(b.m.Name)
end)
return out
end
local function favItems(kind)
local out = {}
for _, name in WF[kind] do
for _, m in Kinds[kind].List() do
if tostring(m.Name) == name then
out[#out + 1] = m
break
end
end
end
return out
end
local function toggleFav(kind, name)
local i = table.find(WF[kind], name)
if i then table.remove(WF[kind], i) else table.insert(WF[kind], name) end
return i == nil
end

local function inRect(g, p)
local ap, as = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
return p.X >= ap.X and p.X <= ap.X + as.X and p.Y >= ap.Y and p.Y <= ap.Y + as.Y
end

moved = true
local vs = SCREENGUI.AbsoluteSize

end)

function refresh()
if not cur then return end
local K = Kinds[cur]
local favs = favItems(cur)
nFav, nPages = #favs, math.max(1, math.ceil(#favs / SLOTS))
page = math.clamp(page, 1, nPages)
for i = 1, SLOTS do
local m = favs[(page - 1) * SLOTS + i]
slotMod[i] = m
set(tiles[i].nm, m and tostring(m.Name) or "-")
tiles[i].b.Interactable = m ~= nil
end
set(pageLbl, nPages > 1 and (page .. " / " .. nPages) or "")
prevB.Visible, nextB.Visible = nPages > 1, nPages > 1
local res = search(cur, box.Text)
for i, r in rows do
local x = res[i]
r.m = x and x.m or nil
r.b.Visible = x ~= nil
if x then r.b.Text = (table.find(WF[cur], tostring(x.m.Name)) and "★  " or "+  ") .. tostring(x.m.Name) end
end
end
function pick(i)
local m, k = slotMod[i], cur
if not m or not k then return end
pcall(Kinds[k].Use, m)
close()
end
function open(k)
if cur == k then return end
cur, lastK, page = k, k, 1
box.Text = ""
refresh()
end
function close()
if not cur then return end
cur = nil
pcall(box.ReleaseFocus, box)
end
local function flip(d)
if cur then
page = (page - 1 + d) % nPages + 1
refresh()
end
end
dim.Activated:Connect(function()
if hoverSel and not lastTouch then pick(hoverSel) else close() end
end)
closeB.Activated:Connect(close)
prevB.Activated:Connect(function() flip(-1) end)
nextB.Activated:Connect(function() flip(1) end)
box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refresh)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
if not enter or not cur then return end
local res = search(cur, box.Text)
if res[1] then
local added = toggleFav(cur, tostring(res[1].m.Name))
say((added and "Favorite added: " or "Favorite removed: ") .. tostring(res[1].m.Name))
elseif box.Text ~= "" then
say("No match for '" .. box.Text .. "' in " .. Kinds[cur].Title:lower())
end
box.Text = ""
refresh()
end)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
local ut, kc = input.UserInputType, input.KeyCode
if ut == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then lastTouch = true
elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then lastTouch = false end
if gp then return end
if ut == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
if not held then
for k, K in Kinds do
if kc == K.Key then held, heldAt, fired = k, os.clock(), false end
end
end
if cur then
if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
close()
else
local n = table.find(NUM, kc)
if n then pick(n) end
end
end
elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 and cur then
if kc == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
if hoverSel then pick(hoverSel) end
elseif kc == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
close()
end
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gp)
local ut = input.UserInputType
if ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
lastTouch = false
elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
stick = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
elseif ut == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and cur then
flip(input.Position.Z > 0 and -1 or 1)
end
end)
AddToRenderStep(function(t, dt)
dt = dt or 0.016

if held then
local K = Kinds[held]
if not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(K.Key) then
held = nil
elseif not fired then
local p = (os.clock() - heldAt) / HOLD_TIME
hold.Visible = p > 0.1
hfill.Size, hfill.BackgroundColor3, holdStroke.Color = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(p, 0, 1), 1), acc, acc
set(htxt, "HOLD " .. K.Key.Name .. "  -  " .. K.Title)
if p >= 1 then
fired = true
hold.Visible = false
if held == "dance" then CurrentDance = stable end
if cur == held then close() else open(held) end
end
end
end
if not held then
hold.Visible = false
stable = CurrentDance
end
local touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
for _, mb in mob do
mb.b.Visible = touch and not cur
mb.st.Color = acc
end
anim = anim + ((cur and 1 or 0) - anim) * (1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
if anim < 0.01 and not cur then
if root.Visible then root.Visible = false end
return
end
root.Visible = true
local K = Kinds[cur or lastK]
local sel, vec = nil, nil
local ctr = cont.AbsolutePosition + cont.AbsoluteSize / 2
if stick.Magnitude > 0.5 then
vec = Vector2.new(stick.X, -stick.Y)
elseif not lastTouch then
local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
if not (inRect(panel, mp) or inRect(sugg, mp) or inRect(closeB, mp)) then vec = mp - ctr end
end
if vec and vec.Magnitude > cont.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.11 then
local ang = math.atan2(vec.X, -vec.Y) % (math.pi * 2)
local i = math.floor((ang + math.pi / SLOTS) / (math.pi * 2 / SLOTS)) % SLOTS + 1
if slotMod[i] then sel = i end
end
hoverSel = sel
local a = anim
dim.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.58 * a
contScale.Scale = 0.86 + 0.14 * a
ringStroke.Color, ringStroke.Transparency = acc, 1 - 0.6 * a
discStroke.Color, discStroke.Transparency = acc, 1 - 0.8 * a
panelStroke.Color, panelStroke.Transparency = acc, 1 - 0.7 * a
closeStroke.Color, closeStroke.Transparency = acc, 1 - 0.7 * a

tl.b.BackgroundColor3 = INK:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245), h)
tl.b.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - pop * (m and (0.82 + 0.15 * h) or 0.4)
tl.st.Color = acc:Lerp(WHITE, h)
tl.st.Thickness = live and 3 or 2

tl.num.TextColor3, tl.num.TextTransparency = ink, 1 - pop * (m and 0.55 or 0.2)

end

local _oldcharacterreference = nil
local errorsandwarnings = {}
local currenterrorid = 1
local function _animStep(dt)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
SaveData.MovesetIndex = MovementStyleIndex
do
local curStyle = MovementStyles[MovementStyleIndex]
if curStyle and curStyle.Hash then SaveData.MovesetHash = curStyle.Hash end
end
if ReanimCharacter then
if _oldcharacterreference ~= ReanimCharacter then
SetOverrideMovesetMusic(nil)
SetOverrideDanceMusic(nil)
if CurrentMovementStyle then
pcall(CurrentMovementStyle.Destroy, nil)
CurrentMovementStyle = nil
end
if _CurrentDance then
pcall(_CurrentDance.Destroy, nil)
_CurrentDance = nil
end
_MovementStyleIndex = nil
end
if MovementStyleIndex ~= _MovementStyleIndex then
if CurrentMovementStyle then
CurrentMovementStyle.Destroy(ReanimCharacter)
CurrentMovementStyle = nil
end
_MovementStyleIndex = MovementStyleIndex
CurrentMovementStyle = MovementStyles[MovementStyleIndex]
SetOverrideMovesetMusic(nil)
if ReanimCharacter:GetAttribute("MovementInit") then
Reanimate.CreateCharacter()
ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
end
end
if CurrentMovementStyle then
if ReanimCharacter:GetAttribute("MovementInit") then
CurrentMovementStyle.Update(dt, ReanimCharacter)
if CurrentDance ~= _CurrentDance then
if _CurrentDance then
pcall(_CurrentDance.Destroy, ReanimCharacter)
end
_CurrentDance = CurrentDance
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("IsDancing", nil)
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("DanceInternalName", nil)
SetOverrideDanceMusic(nil)
end
if _CurrentDance then
if ReanimCharacter:GetAttribute("IsDancing") then
_CurrentDance.Update(dt, ReanimCharacter)
else
if AssetEnsure(_CurrentDance.Assets) then
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("IsDancing", true)
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("DanceInternalName", _CurrentDance.InternalName)
_CurrentDance.Init(ReanimCharacter)
else
SetOverrideDanceMusic(nil)
end
end
end
else
HatReanimator.HatWeldOverride = {}
if AssetEnsure(CurrentMovementStyle.Assets) then
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("MovementInit", true)
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("MovesetInternalName", CurrentMovementStyle.InternalName)
table.clear(HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride)
CurrentMovementStyle.Init(ReanimCharacter)
else
SetOverrideMovesetMusic(nil)
end
end
else
ReanimCharacter:SetAttribute("MovementInit", nil)
_MovementStyleIndex = nil
end
else
CurrentDance = nil
_MovementStyleIndex = nil
SetOverrideMovesetMusic(nil)
SetOverrideDanceMusic(nil)
if CurrentMovementStyle then
CurrentMovementStyle.Destroy(nil)
CurrentMovementStyle = nil
end
if _CurrentDance then
_CurrentDance.Destroy(nil)
_CurrentDance = nil
end
end
_oldcharacterreference = ReanimCharacter
end
local function _animErr(m)
m = debug.traceback("ANIMLOOP :: " .. m)
local id = errorsandwarnings[m]
if not id then
errorsandwarnings[m] = {currenterrorid, 0}
currenterrorid += 1
warn("ERROR #" .. errorsandwarnings[m][1] .. ": " .. m)
else
id[2] += 1
if id[2] <= 8192 and math.sqrt(id[2]) % 1 == 0 then
warn("ERROR #" .. id[1] .. " repeated " .. id[2] .. " times")
end
end
end
local _hb = RunService.Heartbeat
while true do xpcall(_animStep, _animErr, _hb:Wait()) end
end)

local function hubNotify(text)

local function runHubScript(name, url)
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local src = game:HttpGet(url)
if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
error("empty response", 0)
end
local fn, cerr = loadstring(src)
if not fn then
error(tostring(cerr or "loadstring failed"), 0)
end
fn()
end)
if ok then
hubNotify("Nooby's script hub: ran " .. name)
else
warn("[nooby's script hub] Failed to execute " .. name .. " (" .. url .. "): " .. tostring(err))
hubNotify("Nooby's script hub: " .. name .. " failed (see console)")
end
return ok
end
local function runHubGuarded(fn)
if hubBusy then
hubNotify("Nooby's script hub: still running a script, wait a moment")
return
end
hubBusy = true
task.spawn(function()
pcall(fn)
hubBusy = false
end)
end

if Util.IsGuiVisible(UhhhhhhFire) then

end

local a = ""

local b = UhhhhhhFirea[y]:sub(x, x)
if b == " " and tr < 0.1 then
a ..= " "
else

local x1, y1 = x / UhhhhhhFirex, y / UhhhhhhFirey
for _,v in pp do

bright += (1.0 - bright) * math.pow(a, 1.5);
end
if b == " " then bright *= tr end
if bright > 0.9 then
a ..= "Q";
elseif bright > 0.8 then
a ..= "W";
elseif bright > 0.7 then
a ..= "#";
elseif bright > 0.6 then
a ..= "S";
elseif bright > 0.5 then
a ..= "l";
elseif bright > 0.4 then
a ..= "v";
elseif bright > 0.3 then
a ..= "|";
elseif bright > 0.2 then
a ..= ";";
elseif bright > 0.1 then
a ..= ".";
else
a ..= " ";
end
end
end
table.insert(aa, a)
end
UhhhhhhFire.Text = table.concat(aa, "\n")
pp = nil
end

local InitLogsText = (function()
local label = UI.CreateText(InitLogsPage, "Loading...", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local MAXLEN = 24000
local parts, n = {"Loading..."}, 1
local dirty, queued, hasErr = false, false, false
local function join()
if n > 1 then
local str = table.concat(parts, "", 1, n)
if #str > MAXLEN then
str = str:sub(-MAXLEN)
local nl = str:find("\n", 1, true)
if nl then str = str:sub(nl) end
end
table.clear(parts)
parts[1], n = str, 1
end
return parts[1]
end
local flush
local function mark()
dirty = true
if not queued then
queued = true
task.delay(0.35, flush)
end
end
function flush()
queued = false
if not dirty then return end
if label.Parent == nil then return end
if Util.IsGuiVisible(label) then
dirty = false
label.Text = join()
else
queued = true
task.delay(0.75, flush)
end
end
local function add(str)
n += 1
parts[n] = tostring(str)
if not hasErr and parts[n]:find("ERROR", 1, true) then hasErr = true end
if n >= 256 then join() end
mark()
end
pcall(function() InitLogsPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() if dirty then flush() end end) end)
return setmetatable({}, {
__index = function(_, k)
if k == "Text" then return join() end
if k == "Add" then return add end
if k == "HasError" then return hasErr end
return label[k]
end,
__newindex = function(_, k, v)
if k == "Text" then
table.clear(parts)
parts[1], n = tostring(v), 1
hasErr = parts[1]:find("ERROR", 1, true) ~= nil
mark()
else
label[k] = v
end
end,
})
end)()
local function _contentgetgithubraw(path)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path)
local s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/content/" .. path,
Headers = {
Accept = "application/vnd.github.VERSION.raw"
}
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
return resp.Body
end
if s and resp then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " " .. resp.StatusCode)
elseif s then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " NIL")
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET api./" .. path .. " ERR " .. resp)
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path)
s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/main/content/" .. path,
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
return resp.Body
end
if s and resp then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " " .. resp.StatusCode)
elseif s then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " NIL")
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] [GitGET] GET raw./" .. path .. " ERR " .. resp)
end
return nil
end

local function normalize(p) return (tostring(p):gsub("\\", "/")) end
local function shortName(p) return normalize(p):match("([^/]+)$") or tostring(p) end
local function under(path, list)
local p = normalize(path):lower() .. "/"
for _, dir in ipairs(list) do
if p:find(dir .. "/", 1, true) then return true end
end
return false
end
local function shouldScan(path)
local ext = shortName(path):match("%.([%w_]+)$")
return ext ~= nil and cfg.Extensions[ext:lower()] == true
end
local function lineOf(content, abs)
if not abs then return nil end
return select(2, content:sub(1, abs):gsub("\n", "")) + 1
end
local function addHit(state, content, id, weight, desc, abs)
if state.hits[id] then return end
state.hits[id] = {id = id, weight = weight, desc = desc, line = lineOf(content, abs)}
state.score += weight
end
local function reasonText(report, n)
local out = {}
for i = 1, math.min(n or 3, #report.reasons) do
local r = report.reasons[i]
out[i] = r.desc .. (r.line and (" (line " .. r.line .. ")") or "")
end
return table.concat(out, "; ")
end
local function log(text)
pcall(function() InitLogsText.Add("\n[SECURITY] " .. text) end)
end
local function notify(text)
pcall(Util.UINotify, text)
end
local function status(prefix)
local text = string.format("%s | scanned this pass: %d | flagged: %d | deleted: %d", prefix, Stats.PassScanned, Stats.Flagged, Stats.Deleted)
Security.StatusText = text
if Security.OnStatus then pcall(Security.OnStatus, text) end
end
local function scanChunk(content, pos, state)
local low = content:sub(pos, pos + cfg.ChunkSize + cfg.ChunkOverlap - 1):lower()
local hits, flags = state.hits, state.flags
for i = 1, #SIGS do
local sig = SIGS[i]
if not hits[sig.id] then
local at
if sig.any then
for j = 1, #sig.any do
at = low:find(sig.any[j], 1, true)
if at then break end
end
else
at = low:find(sig.f, 1, not sig.p)
end
if at then addHit(state, content, sig.id, sig.w, sig.desc, pos + at - 1) end
end
end
for i = 1, #SPAWNERS do
local needle, weight = SPAWNERS[i][1], SPAWNERS[i][2]
local id = "spawn_payload_" .. i
if not hits[id] then
local init = 1
while true do
local s, e = low:find(needle, init, true)
if not s then break end
local win = low:sub(e + 1, e + cfg.LineWindow)
local nl = win:find("\n", 1, true)
if nl then win = win:sub(1, nl - 1) end
if win:find("%[=*%[") then
addHit(state, content, id, weight, "hides a long-string payload right after " .. needle, pos + s - 1)
break
end
init = e + 1
end
end
end
if not hits.raw_ip then
for ip in low:gmatch("https?://(%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+)") do
if not (ip:find("^127%.") or ip:find("^10%.") or ip:find("^192%.168%.") or ip:find("^0%.")) then
addHit(state, content, "raw_ip", 25, "talks to a bare IP address", nil)
break
end
end
end
if not flags.ls and low:find("loadstring", 1, true) then flags.ls = true end
if not flags.http and (low:find("httpget", 1, true) or low:find("httppost", 1, true) or low:find("getasync", 1, true) or low:find("postasync", 1, true)) then
flags.http = true
end
if not flags.spawn and (low:find(SPAWNERS[1][1], 1, true) or low:find(SPAWNERS[4][1], 1, true)) then
flags.spawn = true
end
state.esc += select(2, low:gsub("\\x%x%x", "")) + select(2, low:gsub("\\%d%d%d", ""))
end
function Security.Analyze(content, gen)
local state = {score = 0, hits = {}, flags = {}, esc = 0}
local n, pos = #content, 1
while pos <= n do
scanChunk(content, pos, state)
pos += cfg.ChunkSize
if gen and pos <= n then
task.wait()
if Security._gen ~= gen then return nil end
end
end
local f = state.flags
if f.ls and f.http and f.spawn then
addHit(state, content, "spawn_loader", 25, "spawns a remote loadstring loader", nil)
end
if state.esc >= cfg.EscapeLimit then
addHit(state, content, "escapes", 25, "is packed with escape-sequence obfuscation", nil)
end
local reasons = {}
for _, h in pairs(state.hits) do table.insert(reasons, h) end
table.sort(reasons, function(a, b) return a.weight > b.weight end)
local verdict = "CLEAN"
if state.score >= cfg.MaliciousScore then
verdict = "MALICIOUS"
elseif state.score >= cfg.SuspiciousScore then
verdict = "SUSPICIOUS"
end
return {verdict = verdict, score = state.score, reasons = reasons}
end
function Security.Enabled() return SaveData.SecurityScan ~= false end
function Security.AutoDelete() return SaveData.SecurityAutoDelete == true end
local function deleteFile(path, content)
pcall(makefolder, cfg.QuarantineDir)
local safe = (normalize(path):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"))
local copied = pcall(writefile, cfg.QuarantineDir .. "/" .. safe .. "." .. os.time() .. ".quarantined", content)
pcall(delfile, path)
local gone = false
pcall(function() gone = not isfile(path) end)
return gone, copied
end
local reported, byKey = {}, {}
local function respond(path, report, content, blocked)
local key = normalize(path) .. "|" .. report.score .. "|" .. #content
local first = not reported[key]
reported[key] = true
local why = reasonText(report)
local name = shortName(path)
local malicious = report.verdict == "MALICIOUS"
local deleted, copied = false, false
if malicious and Security.AutoDelete() and not under(path, cfg.ReportOnlyDirs) then
deleted, copied = deleteFile(path, content)
end
if first then
Stats.Flagged += 1
local finding = {path = path, verdict = report.verdict, score = report.score, why = why, deleted = deleted, time = os.time()}
byKey[key] = finding
table.insert(Security.Findings, finding)
elseif deleted and byKey[key] then
byKey[key].deleted = true
end
if deleted then
Stats.Deleted += 1
log("DELETED " .. path .. " [score " .. report.score .. "]: " .. why .. (copied and (" (copy kept in " .. cfg.QuarantineDir .. ")") or ""))
notify("Auto-deleted " .. name .. ": " .. why)
elseif first then
log(report.verdict .. " " .. path .. " [score " .. report.score .. "]: " .. why)
if malicious then
notify((blocked and "Blocked malicious module " or "Malicious file found: ") .. name .. ": " .. why)
else
notify("Suspicious file: " .. name .. " (details in Init Logs)")
end
end
if first and malicious and Security.OnMalicious then
pcall(Security.OnMalicious, path, report)
end
return deleted
end
function Security.GateModule(path, content)
if not Security.Enabled() or type(content) ~= "string" then return nil end
local ok, report = pcall(Security.Analyze, content)
if not ok or not report or report.verdict == "CLEAN" then return nil end
respond(path, report, content, true)
if report.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then return reasonText(report) end
return nil
end
local function waitFrameHealthy(gen)
local waited = 0
while Security._frame > cfg.MaxFrameTime and waited < 5 and Security._gen == gen do
task.wait(0.25)
waited += 0.25
end
end
local function scanFile(path, gen)
local ok, content = pcall(readfile, path)
if not ok or type(content) ~= "string" or #content == 0 then return end
if #content > cfg.MaxFileBytes then
Stats.Skipped += 1
return
end
local report = Security.Analyze(content, gen)
if not report then return end
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
if report.verdict ~= "CLEAN" then respond(path, report, content, false) end
end
local function runPass(gen)
local queue, head, seen = {}, 1, {}
for _, root in ipairs(cfg.Roots) do
seen[normalize(root):lower()] = true
table.insert(queue, {dir = true, path = root})
end
while head <= #queue do
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
local item = queue[head]
head += 1
if item.dir then
local ok, list = pcall(listfiles, item.path)
if ok and type(list) == "table" then
for i, p in ipairs(list) do
local key = normalize(p):lower()
if not seen[key] then
seen[key] = true
if not under(p, cfg.SkipDirs) then
local okf, isdir = pcall(isfolder, p)
if okf and isdir then
table.insert(queue, {dir = true, path = p})
elseif shouldScan(p) then
table.insert(queue, {path = p})
end
end
end
if i % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
end
end
task.wait(cfg.ListDelay)
else
waitFrameHealthy(gen)
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
status("Security: scanning " .. shortName(item.path))
pcall(scanFile, item.path, gen)
task.wait(cfg.FileDelay)
end
end
return true
end
local function loop(gen)
while Security._gen == gen do
Stats.PassScanned = 0
if not runPass(gen) then return end
Stats.Passes += 1
if Stats.Passes == 1 then
log("First full scan finished: " .. Stats.PassScanned .. " files checked, " .. Stats.Flagged .. " flagged.")
end
status("Security: idle (pass " .. Stats.Passes .. " done)")
Security._scanNow = false
Security._idle = true
local waited = 0
while Security._gen == gen and not Security._scanNow and waited < cfg.PassDelay do
task.wait(1)
waited += 1
end
if Security._gen == gen then Security._idle = false end
end
end
function Security.Start()
if not Security.Enabled() or Security._running then return end
Security._running = true
Security._gen += 1
local gen = Security._gen
Security._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
Security._frame = Security._frame * 0.9 + dt * 0.1
end)
status("Security: starting")
task.spawn(function()
pcall(loop, gen)
end)
end
function Security.Stop()
Security._gen += 1
Security._running = false
Security._idle = false
if Security._conn then
Security._conn:Disconnect()
Security._conn = nil
end
status("Security: background scan is OFF")
end
function Security.ScanNow()
if not Security._running then
notify("Turn on Background Malware Scan first")
elseif Security._idle then
Security._scanNow = true
notify("Starting a new security scan")
else
notify("A security scan is already running")
end
end
return Security
end)

Util.Security = sec
else
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Security module failed to load: " .. tostring(sec))
end
end

local loadMode = tonumber(SaveData.ModuleLoadMode)
if loadMode ~= 2 and loadMode ~= 3 and loadMode ~= 4 then loadMode = 1 end
local SLOW_STEP_DELAY = 0.35
local function SlowPause()
if loadMode == 4 then
task.wait(SLOW_STEP_DELAY)
end
end
local lowTier = ((type(_G) == "table" and type(_G.UHDevProfile) == "table" and tonumber(_G.UHDevProfile.Tier)) or 3) <= 2
local FRAME_BUDGET, sliceT = lowTier and 0.003 or 0.006, os.clock()
local function FetchContent(x, tries)
for a = 1, tries do
local content = _contentgetgithubraw(x)
if type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then return content end
if a < tries then task.wait(0.6 * a) end
end
return nil
end
local function Breathe()
if os.clock() - sliceT >= FRAME_BUDGET then
task.wait()
sliceT = os.clock()
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Module load mode: " .. ({"Default", "Splitted (2 at a time)", "Instant", "Slow (1 at a time, paced)"})[loadMode])
if loadMode == 4 then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Slow mode: one module at a time with a short pause between each, this takes longer.")
end
local function RunPhase(items, work, apply)
local rawApply = apply
local function bump()
local P = Util.ModuleProgress
if P then P.Done = P.Done + 1 end
end
apply = function(i, x, data)
if rawApply then
local okA, errA = pcall(rawApply, i, x, data)
if not okA then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed: " .. tostring(errA)) end
end
bump()
end
if loadMode == 4 then
for i, x in items do
local ok, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not ok then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: reading step failed: " .. tostring(data))
data = nil
bump()
else
SlowPause()
end
if ok and apply then
local okA, errA = pcall(apply, i, x, data)
if not okA then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: load step failed: " .. tostring(errA))
end
SlowPause()
end
end
return
end
if loadMode == 1 then
for i, x in items do
local okW, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not okW then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed, skipping this file: " .. tostring(data))
bump()
elseif apply then
task.wait()
apply(i, x, data)
end
end
return
end
local size = (loadMode == 2 or lowTier) and 2 or math.max(1, #items)
local i = 1
while i <= #items do
local last = math.min(i + size - 1, #items)
local results, pending = {}, last - i + 1
for k = i, last do
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(work, k, items[k])
results[k] = (ok and res) or ""
pending -= 1
end)
end
while pending > 0 do
task.wait()
end
if apply then
sliceT = os.clock()
for k = i, last do
if k > i then Breathe() end
apply(k, items[k], results[k])
results[k] = nil
end
end
if loadMode == 2 then
task.wait()
end
i = last + 1
end
end

end, function(msg)

end

st = okb and r or nil
end
if def.Tick then conn = CRM.Tick(def.TickRate or 1, function(dt) def.Tick(R, S, st, dt) end) end
end
local ok, err = pcall(origStart, ...)
if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
if on and def.End then pcall(def.End, R, S, st, CRM) end
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end

end)
end

LimbReanimator.RegisterMode((function()
local STREAM_DEPTH = 16
local DEEP_DEPTH = 64
local FLOOR_MARGIN = 32
local DEFAULT_FPDH = -500
local SMOOTH_TIME_XZ = 0.20
local SMOOTH_TIME_Y = 0.40
local STREAM_LEASH = 8
local DEEP_LEASH = 48
local TELEPORT_DIST = 200
local MAX_DT = 0.1
local DEFAULT_DT = 1 / 60
local MAX_COORD = 1e8
local MAX_VEL = 1e5
local MAX_FAILS = 30
local OMEGA_XZ = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_XZ
local OMEGA_Y = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_Y
local sqrt, min, max = math.sqrt, math.min, math.max
local ready = false
local sx, sy, sz = 0, 0, 0
local vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
local lastT = nil
local fails = 0
local function finite(n)
return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n > -MAX_COORD and n < MAX_COORD
end
local function readPosition(part)
return part.Position
end
local function samplePart(part)
if typeof(part) ~= "Instance" or part.Parent == nil then return nil end
local ok, pos = pcall(readPosition, part)
if not ok or typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
local x, y, z = pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z
if finite(x) and finite(y) and finite(z) then return x, y, z end
return nil
end
local function damp(cur, target, vel, omega, dt)
local x = omega * dt
local e = 1 / (1 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
local change = cur - target
local temp = (vel + omega * change) * dt
return target + (change + temp) * e, (vel - omega * temp) * e
end
local function step(ctx)
local fpdh = ctx.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
if not finite(fpdh) then fpdh = DEFAULT_FPDH end
local floorY = fpdh + FLOOR_MARGIN
local px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.RootPart)
if px == nil then px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.Torso) end
local t = ctx.Time
local dt = DEFAULT_DT
if finite(t) and lastT ~= nil and t >= lastT then
dt = min(t - lastT, MAX_DT)
end
if finite(t) then lastT = t end
if px ~= nil then
local streaming = ctx.Streaming == true
local tx, tz = px, pz
local ty = max(py - (streaming and STREAM_DEPTH or DEEP_DEPTH), floorY)
local dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
local stateOk = finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz)
and finite(vx) and finite(vy) and finite(vz)
if not ready or dist > TELEPORT_DIST or not stateOk then
sx, sy, sz = tx, ty, tz
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
sx, vx = damp(sx, tx, vx, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sz, vz = damp(sz, tz, vz, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sy, vy = damp(sy, ty, vy, OMEGA_Y, dt)
local leash = streaming and STREAM_LEASH or DEEP_LEASH
dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local rem = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
if rem > leash then
local k = (rem - leash) / rem
sx, sy, sz = sx + dx * k, sy + dy * k, sz + dz * k
end
if vx > MAX_VEL or vx < -MAX_VEL or vy > MAX_VEL or vy < -MAX_VEL or vz > MAX_VEL or vz < -MAX_VEL then
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
end
if sy < floorY then
sy = floorY
if vy < 0 then vy = 0 end
end
elseif not ready then
sx, sy, sz = 0, floorY, 0
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return {
Name = "Nooby's style",
GetRootCFrame = function(ctx)
local ok, cf = pcall(step, ctx)
if ok and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
fails = 0
return cf
end
fails = fails + 1
if fails > MAX_FAILS then
error("Nooby's style failed repeatedly: " .. tostring(cf), 0)
end
if ready and finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz) then
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return CFrame.new(0, DEFAULT_FPDH + FLOOR_MARGIN, 0)
end,
}
end)(), "built-in")
end)
if not okn then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to register built-in Nooby's style: " .. tostring(errn)) end
end
end

local function post(path, body)
if type(req) ~= "function" then return nil, 0 end
local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = BASE .. path, Method = "POST", Headers = {["Content-Type"] = "application/json"}, Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)})
if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return nil, 0 end
local ok2, d = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body or "{}")
return ok2 and d or nil, res.StatusCode
end
local function resolve(q)
q = trim(q):lower()
if q == "" then return nil end
for _, e in ipairs(cache) do
if tostring(e[1]) == q or e[2]:lower() == q or e[3]:lower() == q then return e end
end
for _, e in ipairs(cache) do
if e[2]:lower():find(q, 1, true) == 1 or e[3]:lower():find(q, 1, true) == 1 then return e end
end
end

end
notify(moved and ("Teleported to " .. tostring(e[2])) or "Your character isn't loaded")
return
end

notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - join link copied, paste it in your browser")

notify(tostring(e[2]) .. " is in " .. gname .. " - opened in your browser")

end

local function handle(ev)
acks[#acks + 1] = ev.id
local key = tostring(ev.id) .. ":" .. tostring(ev.t)
if seen[key] then return end
seen[key] = true
local who = tostring(ev.f)
notify(who .. " used " .. tostring(ev.k) .. " on you")
if ev.k == "kill" then killSelf()
elseif ev.k == "deanimate" then pcall(Util.ModDeanimate)

end
local function presence(tag, label, m)
local s = 0
if m then s = (tostring(m[1]) == game.JobId) and 2 or 1 end
if m and tostring(m[2]):lower() == LP.Name:lower() then s = 0 end
local prev = mstate[tag]
mstate[tag] = s
if s > 0 and s ~= prev and not (prev == 2 and s == 1) then
local nm = tostring(m[2])
if s == 2 then
alert(label .. " " .. nm .. (prev == nil and " is in YOUR server" or " joined YOUR server"))
else
alert(label .. " " .. nm .. " is online (different server)")
end
end
end
local lastGood = 0
local function dedupe(l)
local out, idx = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(l) do
local k = tostring(e[1])
if idx[k] then
out[idx[k]] = e
else
out[#out + 1] = e
idx[k] = #out
end
end
return out
end

busy = false

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local L, R = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local N = 40
local function themeCol() return (UITextColor and UITextColor.Value) or WHITE end
local function fmtMB(v) if v >= 1024 then return string.format("%.2f GB", v / 1024) end return string.format("%.0f MB", v) end
local function readMem()
local ok, v = pcall(Stats.GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats)
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v end
end
local function readLua()
local ok, v = pcall(collectgarbage, "count")
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v / 1024 end
end
local cpuItem
local function readCpuMs()
if not cpuItem or not cpuItem.Parent then
local ps = Stats:FindFirstChild("PerformanceStats")
cpuItem = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("CPU")
if not cpuItem then return nil end
end
local ok, s = pcall(cpuItem.GetValueString, cpuItem)
if not ok or type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
local num, unit = s:match("([%d%.]+)%s*(%a+)")
num = tonumber(num)
if num and unit == "ms" then return num end
end
local hw
local function safe(f, ...) local ok, v = pcall(f, ...) if ok then return v end end
local function clean(s) if type(s) == "string" then return (s:gsub("[<>&]", ""):sub(1, 48)) end end
local function readHW()
if hw then return hw end
hw = {}
hw.platform = safe(function() return (tostring(game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetPlatform()):gsub("^Enum%.Platform%.", "")) end)
hw.exec = clean(safe(function() return (identifyexecutor()) end))
local ts = safe(function() return settings():GetService("TaskScheduler") end)
if ts then
hw.pool = safe(function() local v = ts.ThreadPoolSize return type(v) == "number" and v > 0 and v or nil end)
hw.poolCfg = safe(function() return (tostring(ts.ThreadPoolConfig):gsub("^Enum%.ThreadPoolConfig%.", "")) end)
end
local dev = (FX and FX.Device) or _G.UHDevProfile
if type(dev) == "table" and type(dev.RAM) == "number" then hw.ram, hw.ramConf = dev.RAM, dev.Confidence end
local env = type(genv) == "table" and genv or _G
local function scan(t, d)
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
if type(v) == "table" then
if d < 2 then scan(v, d + 1) end
elseif type(v) == "string" and #v > 2 and (ks:find("cpu", 1, true) or ks:find("processor", 1, true)) and (ks:find("name", 1, true) or ks:find("model", 1, true) or ks:find("brand", 1, true) or ks == "cpu" or ks == "processor") then
hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(v)
elseif type(v) == "number" and v >= 1 and v <= 256 and v % 1 == 0 then
if ks:find("thread", 1, true) or ks:find("logical", 1, true) then hw.threads = hw.threads or v
elseif ks:find("core", 1, true) and not ks:find("score", 1, true) then hw.cores = hw.cores or v end
end
end
end
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo", "getcpuinfo", "getprocessorinfo"}) do
local fn = env[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = safe(fn)
if type(r) == "table" then scan(r, 0)
elseif type(r) == "string" and #r > 2 and n:find("cpu", 1, true) then hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(r) end
end
end
return hw
end
local function hwText()
local h = readHW()
local thr = {}
if h.threads then thr[#thr + 1] = h.threads .. " logical threads (executor)" end
if h.cores then thr[#thr + 1] = h.cores .. " cores (executor)" end
if h.pool then thr[#thr + 1] = "Roblox scheduler pool " .. h.pool .. (h.poolCfg and (" [" .. h.poolCfg .. "]") or "") end
return "<b>Hardware</b> (read locally)\n"
.. "CPU: " .. (h.cpuName or "name not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Threads: " .. (#thr > 0 and table.concat(thr, ", ") or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "RAM: " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB (%s confidence)", h.ram, tostring(h.ramConf or "?")) or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Platform: " .. (h.platform or "?") .. "  |  Executor: " .. (h.exec or "?")
end

local ftH, memH = table.create(N, 0), table.create(N, 0)
local w, pkAvg, pkWorst, pkMem, pkLua = 1, 0, 0, 0, 0
local cpuMode, lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct, pkCpu, hwDone = false, 0, 0, 0, false
local function draw(bars, hist, top)
for i = 1, N do
bars[i].Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -1, math.clamp(hist[(w + i - 2) % N + 1] / top, 0, 1), 0)
end
end
local function sample(avgMs, fps, worst)
if avgMs > pkAvg then pkAvg = avgMs end
if worst > pkWorst then pkWorst = worst end
local cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuMode then
cpuMs = readCpuMs()
if cpuMs then
cpuPct = math.clamp(cpuMs / avgMs * 100, 0, 100)
lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct = cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuPct > pkCpu then pkCpu = cpuPct end
else
cpuMs, cpuPct = lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct
end
end
local m, l = readMem(), readLua()
ftH[w], memH[w] = cpuMode and cpuPct or avgMs, m or 0
if m and m > pkMem then pkMem = m end
if l and l > pkLua then pkLua = l end
w = w % N + 1
if not MainPage.Visible then return end
local topF, topM = cpuMode and 100 or 33.4, 1
for i = 1, N do
if not cpuMode and ftH[i] > topF then topF = ftH[i] end
if memH[i] > topM then topM = memH[i] end
end
topM = topM * 1.15
draw(barsA, ftH, topF)
draw(barsB, memH, topM)
local h = readHW()
local pct = m and h.ram and (h.ramConf == "exact" or h.ramConf == "high") and m / (h.ram * 1024) * 100
mScale.Text = "max " .. fmtMB(topM)
if cpuMode then
fScale.Text = "max 100%"
fVal.Text = string.format("%d%%  %.1f ms", math.floor(cpuPct + 0.5), cpuMs)
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak %d%%  |  Frame %.1f ms  %d FPS\nSystem-wide CPU %%: not exposed", math.floor(pkCpu + 0.5), avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
else
fScale.Text = string.format("max %d ms", math.ceil(topF))
fVal.Text = string.format("%.1f ms  %d FPS", avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak avg %.1f ms  |  Worst %.1f ms\nCPU %%: not exposed by Roblox", pkAvg, pkWorst)
end
mVal.Text = m and (fmtMB(m) .. (pct and string.format("  (%d%%)", math.floor(pct + 0.5)) or "")) or "unavailable"
mDet.Text = (m and ("Peak " .. fmtMB(pkMem)) or "Peak n/a") .. "  |  Device RAM " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB", h.ram) or "n/a") .. "\n"
.. (l and string.format("Lua heap %.1f MB  |  Peak %.1f MB", l, pkLua) or "Lua heap: unavailable")
end
local opened, paused, conn, interval = false, false, nil, 1
local t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
local function setStatus() status.Text = paused and "PAUSED" or string.format("LIVE  %ds", interval) end
local function stop() if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end end
local function start()
if conn or not opened or paused then return end
interval = 1
pcall(function() if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then interval = 2 end end)
local c = readCpuMs()
if (c ~= nil) ~= cpuMode then
cpuMode = c ~= nil
for i = 1, N do ftH[i] = 0 end
end
if c then lastCpuMs = c end
fTitle.Text = cpuMode and "<b>CPU</b> frame load" or "<b>Frame time</b> (CPU n/a)"
t, fsum, n, mx = math.max(0, interval - 0.2), 0, 0, 0
conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
t += dt; fsum += dt; n += 1
if dt > mx then mx = dt end
if t >= interval then
local a, c, m = fsum / n * 1000, n / fsum, mx * 1000
t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
sample(a, c, m)
end
end)
end
setStatus()
btn.Activated:Connect(function()
opened = not opened
if opened and not hwDone then hwDone = true hwLabel.Text = hwText() end
boxCont.Visible = opened
btnText.Text = opened and "Hide Performance Monitor" or "Performance Monitor &gt;"
if opened then start() else stop() end
setStatus()
end)
pbtn.Activated:Connect(function()
paused = not paused
ptext.Text = paused and "Resume" or "Pause"
if paused then stop() else start() end
setStatus()
end)
local btnCont = btn.Parent
local function findRow(needle)
for _, k in ipairs(MainPage:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k ~= btnCont and k ~= boxCont then
for _, d in ipairs(k:GetDescendants()) do
if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d.Text:find(needle, 1, true) then return k end
end
end
end
end
local anchor = findRow("Feature Center &gt;") or findRow("Back to cool scene")
if anchor then
local base = anchor.LayoutOrder
for _, k in ipairs(MainPage:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k ~= btnCont and k ~= boxCont and k.LayoutOrder > base then
k.LayoutOrder = k.LayoutOrder + 2
end
end
btnCont.LayoutOrder, boxCont.LayoutOrder = base + 1, base + 2
end
end)
if not okPM then warn("[perf-monitor] failed to build: " .. tostring(errPM)) end
end

blue = Color3.fromRGB(56, 140, 255), cyan = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 200), purple = Color3.fromRGB(128, 84, 235),
pink = Color3.fromRGB(240, 80, 150), green = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 120), amber = Color3.fromRGB(250, 170, 60),
}
local BOLD, MED = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.Font.GothamMedium
local LEFT, RIGHT, CENTER = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local function new(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end
local function calm()
return (FX.Settings and FX.Settings.Transitions == false) or (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) or false
end
local function tw(o, t, props, style, dir)
if calm() then
for k, v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
return
end
t = t / math.max(0.2, (FX.Cfg and FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed) or 1)
local ok, tn = pcall(function()
return TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
end)
if ok and tn then
tn:Play()
return tn
end
end
local function corner(o, r)
return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 14)}, o)
end
local function stroke(o, tr, col)
return new("UIStroke", {Color = col or W, Transparency = tr or 0.84, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function rim(st)
if not (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) then
new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 38, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.32, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08)})}, st)
end
return st
end

TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
}, parent)

for k, v in pairs(extra) do l[k] = v end
end
return l
end

local function feel(b, base, hover, lift)
lift = lift or 1.025
local rest = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and 1 or lift
local sc = new("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.2, {BackgroundTransparency = hover})
tw(sc, 0.35, {Scale = lift}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = base})
tw(sc, 0.3, {Scale = 1})
end)
b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.08, {Scale = 0.94}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad) end)
b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.5, {Scale = rest}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end

end

local rowReg = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rowOf(page, h)
local r = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = #page:GetChildren()}, page)
local holder = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -6)}, r)
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then reg = {} rowReg[page] = reg end
reg[#reg + 1] = holder
return holder, r
end
local Nav = {Closers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
Util.Nav = Nav
local function press(btn)
if not btn then return false end
if type(firesignal) == "function" and pcall(firesignal, btn.Activated) then return true end
if type(getconnections) == "function" then
local ok = pcall(function()
for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(btn.Activated)) do
if c.Fire then c:Fire() elseif c.Function then c.Function() end
end
end)
if ok then return true end
end
return false
end
function Nav.TopPage()
local best
for _, p in ipairs(Util.AllPages or {}) do
if p ~= MainPage and p.Parent and p.Visible and math.abs(p.Position.X.Offset) < 2 and p.Position.X.Scale == 0.5 then
if not best or p.ZIndex >= best.ZIndex then best = p end
end
end
return best
end
function Nav.Open(p)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = true
MainPage.Interactable = false
local goal = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
if calm() then
p.Position = goal
p.Interactable = true
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = goal})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(function() p.Interactable = true end)
pcall(Nav.Stagger, p)
end
function Nav.Close(p)
p.Interactable = false
MainPage.Interactable = false
local away = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
local function done()
MainPage.Interactable = true
p.Visible = false
end
if calm() then
p.Position = away
done()
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = away})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(done)
end
function Nav.Stagger(page)
if calm() then return end
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then return end
for i, h in ipairs(reg) do
if i > 12 then break end
if h.Parent then
local sc = h:FindFirstChild("PopScale") or new("UIScale", {Name = "PopScale"}, h)
sc.Scale = 0.92
h.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
task.delay(0.045 * (i - 1), function()
if not h.Parent then return end
tw(sc, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
tw(h, 0.5, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)})
end)
end
end
end
function Nav.CloseTop()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return false end
local c = Nav.Closers[p]
if c then
c()
return true
end
local back = Util.BackBtns and Util.BackBtns[p]
if back then return press(back) end
return false
end
local function newPage()
local p = UI.CreatePage()
p.ZIndex = 1
p.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = false
UI.CreateButton(p, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(function() Nav.Close(p) end)
Nav.Closers[p] = function() Nav.Close(p) end
return p
end
local function toggleMusic()
local snd = UISound.Music
if snd.IsPlaying then
pcall(function() snd:Pause() end)
elseif snd.IsPaused then
pcall(function() snd:Resume() end)
else
pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
end
end
local fpsVal = 60
do
local acc, n = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc += dt
n += 1
if acc >= 0.5 then
fpsVal = math.floor(n / acc + 0.5)
acc, n = 0, 0
end
end)
end
local friends, friendBusy = {}, {}
local function queueFriend(plr, after)
if plr == Player or friends[plr.UserId] ~= nil or friendBusy[plr.UserId] then return end
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = true
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(function() return Player:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) end)
friends[plr.UserId] = ok and res == true
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = nil
if after then after() end
end)
end
local function friendsHere(after)
local out = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= Player then
queueFriend(plr, after)
if friends[plr.UserId] then out[#out + 1] = plr end
end
end
return out
end
local function fmtTime(s)
s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
if s >= 3600 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", s // 3600, (s % 3600) // 60) end
return string.format("%dm %02ds", s // 60, s % 60)
end

local function setSpectate(plr)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local hum
if plr then
hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
else
local ok, rc = pcall(function() return Reanimate and Reanimate.Character end)
hum = (ok and rc and rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or (Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
end
if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
end

local function rebuild()
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do r:Destroy() end
rows = {}
local q = string.lower(search.Text or "")
local list = Players:GetPlayers()
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
if a == Player then return true end
if b == Player then return false end
return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
end)
local shown = 0
local myRoot = rootOf(Player)
for _, plr in ipairs(list) do
queueFriend(plr, function() refresh() end)
local okQ = q == "" or plr.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil or plr.DisplayName:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
local okF = true
if filter == "Friends" then
okF = friends[plr.UserId] == true
elseif filter == "Nearby" then
local r = rootOf(plr)
okF = plr ~= Player and r ~= nil and myRoot ~= nil and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 150
end
if okQ and okF then
shown += 1
local sel = selected == plr
local b = new("TextButton", {AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = C.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = shown}, listFrame)
corner(b, UDim.new(0, 14))
stroke(b, sel and 0.5 or 0.88)
local av = new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundColor3 = W, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), Image = ""}, b)
corner(av, UDim.new(1, 0))
loadAvatar(av, plr.UserId)
label(b, plr.DisplayName .. (plr == Player and "  (you)" or ""), 13, C.text, BOLD, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 16)})
label(b, "@" .. plr.Name, 10, C.mute, MED, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 13)})
if friends[plr.UserId] then
label(b, "Friend", 10, C.green, BOLD, RIGHT, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, 0)})
end
feel(b, sel and 0.2 or 0.45, 0.3)
b.Activated:Connect(function()
selected = plr
specSpec = false
specT1.Text = "Spectate"
updateDetail()
refresh()
end)
rows[#rows + 1] = b
end
end
countL.Text = shown .. " of " .. #list
end

local function syncShadow()
local ap, as, base = UIMainWindow.AbsolutePosition, UIMainWindow.AbsoluteSize, UIMainFrame.AbsolutePosition
local sc = (Util.UIPlus and Util.UIPlus.scaleObj and Util.UIPlus.scaleObj.Scale) or 1
shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ap.X - base.X + as.X / 2) / sc, (ap.Y - base.Y + as.Y / 2) / sc + 10)
shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(as.X / sc + 56, as.Y / sc + 56)
shadow.Visible = UIMainWindow.Visible
end
for _, prop in ipairs({"AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize", "Visible"}) do
UIMainWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(syncShadow)
end

local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return 1 end
local vp = cam.ViewportSize
return math.clamp(math.min(vp.X / 392, vp.Y / 320), 0.6, 1)
end

end)
end

end)

d.isc.Scale = 1.4

end
end
end

local function popDock()
if calm() then return end
pillF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 24)
tw(pillF, 0.55, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
for i, key in ipairs(KEYS) do
local d = parts[key]
d.sc.Scale = 0.2
task.delay(0.04 * i, function() tw(d.sc, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
end

local v = WindowContent.Visible

dock.Visible = v
end

function Nav.CurrentKey()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return "Menu" end
if p == cards then return "Home" end
if p == pp then return "Players" end
if Util.NavLast == "Music &gt;" then return "Music" end
if Util.NavLast == "Customization &gt;" then return "Settings" end
return "Menu"
end
function Nav.Go(key)
if Nav.Busy then return end
Nav.Busy = true
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()
local same = Nav.CurrentKey() == key and key ~= "Cmds"
local closed = Nav.CloseTop()
if closed then task.wait(0.65) end
if not same then
local fn = Nav.Targets[key]
if fn then fn() end
end
end)
task.wait(0.25)
Nav.Busy = false
end)
end

setActive(Nav.CurrentKey())

dockStroke.Color = tint
local d = parts[activeKey]
if d then d.st.Color = tint end
end
end)
task.wait(0.2)
end
end)
end, function(e)
warn("[GlassUI] " .. tostring(e))
end)

local GetMarketList_cache = {}
local function GetMarketList()
local aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu = GetMarketList_cache.aitemus, GetMarketList_cache.file2name, GetMarketList_cache.file2aitemu
if not aitemus or not file2name or not file2aitemu then
local marketteresult = game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh-Store/main/list.txt")
marketteresult = string.split(marketteresult, "\n")
aitemus = {}
local aitemu = {}
for _,a in marketteresult do
if #a > 3 then
local k, v = string.split(a, " = ")
k, v = table.remove(k, 1), table.concat(string.split(table.concat(k, " = "), "\\n"), "\n")
if k == "name" then
aitemu.Name = v
continue
end
if k == "user" then
aitemu.User = v
continue
end
if k == "desc" then
aitemu.Description = v
continue
end
if k == "cost" then
aitemu.Cost = v
continue
end
if k == "file" then
aitemu.Source = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh-Store/main/" .. v
aitemu.File = string.gsub(v, "/", ".")
continue
end
end
if next(aitemu) == nil then
continue
end
table.insert(aitemus, aitemu)
aitemu = {}
end
if next(aitemu) ~= nil then
table.insert(aitemus, aitemu)
end
file2name, file2aitemu = {}, {}
for _,aitemu in aitemus do
if aitemu.Name and aitemu.File then
file2name[aitemu.File] = aitemu.Name
file2aitemu[aitemu.File] = aitemu
end
end
end
GetMarketList_cache.aitemus, GetMarketList_cache.file2name, GetMarketList_cache.file2aitemu = aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu
return aitemus, file2name, file2aitemu
end

page.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)

Util.NoobyStore = (function()
local REPO, ROOT, NAME = "Elliot12-wq/nooby-s-unoffical-store-", "UhhhhhhReanim/NoobyStore/", "Nooby's unofficial store"
local NS, lastList = {Busy = false}, nil
local INFO = {}
local function esc(t) return (tostring(t):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;")) end
local function applyInfo(a)
local info = INFO[a.File]
if not info and type(SaveData.NoobyInfo) == "table" then info = SaveData.NoobyInfo[a.File] end
if type(info) ~= "table" or #info == 0 then return end
INFO[a.File] = info
a.Base = a.Base or a.Description
local parts, kinds, seen = {}, {}, {}
for _, m in info do
local ty = tostring(m.Type or "Module")
parts[#parts + 1] = ty .. ": " .. esc(m.Name or "Unnamed") .. ((m.Description or "") ~= "" and ("\n" .. esc(m.Description)) or "")
if not seen[ty] then seen[ty] = true kinds[#kinds + 1] = ty end
end
a.Name = esc(info[1].Name or "Unnamed") .. (#info > 1 and (" +" .. (#info - 1) .. " more") or "")
a.User = ((info[1].Author or "") ~= "" and esc(info[1].Author) or NAME) .. " - " .. table.concat(kinds, " + ")
a.Description = table.concat(parts, "\n\n") .. (a.Needs and ("\n\n" .. a.Needs) or "") .. "\n\n" .. a.Base
end
local function field(w, key)
local _, v = w:match("%f[%w_]" .. key .. "%s*=%s*([\"'])(.-)%1")
if not v then _, v = w:match("%f[%w_]" .. key .. "%s*=%s*%[(=*)%[(.-)%]%1%]") end
if v then v = v:gsub("\\n", "\n"):gsub("\\([\"'])", "%1") end
return v
end
local function scanModules(src)
local found = {}
for pos, kind in src:gmatch("()ModuleType%s*=%s*[\"'](%u+)[\"']") do
if kind == "MOVESET" or kind == "DANCE" then
local w = src:sub(pos, pos + 4000)
found[#found + 1] = {Type = kind == "DANCE" and "Dance" or "Moveset", Name = field(w, "Name") or "Unnamed", Description = field(w, "Description") or "", Author = field(w, "Author") or field(w, "Creator") or field(w, "User") or ""}
end
end
return found
end
local ASSET = {anim = true, anims = true, mp3 = true, png = true, rbxm = true, rbxms = true, jpg = true, jpeg = true}
local function assetNames(src)
local names, seen = {}, {}
for n in src:gmatch("[\"']([^\"'\r\n\\/@:]+%.%w+)[\"']") do
local ext = n:match("%.(%w+)$"):lower()
if ASSET[ext] and #n < 120 and not seen[n:lower()] then
seen[n:lower()] = true
names[#names + 1] = n
end
end
return names
end
local function findAsset(name, from)
local c = NS.Index and NS.Index[name:lower()]
if not c then return nil end
local dir = (from or ""):match("^(.*)/[^/]*$") or ""
for _, x in c do
if (x.Path:match("^(.*)/[^/]*$") or "") == dir then return x end
end
return c[1]
end
function NS.List()
local HS, list = game:GetService("HttpService"), nil
for _, ref in {"main", "HEAD"} do
local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. REPO .. "/git/trees/" .. ref .. "?recursive=1")
local okJ, data = false, nil
if ok then okJ, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, body) end
if okJ and type(data) == "table" and type(data.tree) == "table" then
list = {}
local index = {}
for _, node in data.tree do
local low = type(node.path) == "string" and node.path:lower() or ""
local ext = low:match("%.(%w+)$")
if node.type == "blob" and ext then
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. REPO .. "/" .. ref .. "/" .. EnsureUrlEncode(node.path)
if ASSET[ext] then
local leaf = low:match("([^/]+)$")
index[leaf] = index[leaf] or {}
table.insert(index[leaf], {Path = node.path, Url = url})
elseif ext == "lua" or ext == "txt" then
local entry = {
Path = node.path,
Size = node.size or 0,
Name = (node.path:match("([^/]+)$"):gsub("%.%w+$", "")),
User = NAME,
Description = node.path .. "\nSize: " .. math.max(1, math.floor((node.size or 0) / 1024)) .. " KB\nFrom " .. NAME,
Cost = (node.size or 0) >= 1048576 and string.format("%.1f MB", node.size / 1048576) or (node.size or 0) >= 1024 and string.format("%d KB", math.floor(node.size / 1024)) or math.max(1, node.size or 0) .. " B",
Source = url,
File = (node.path:gsub("/", ".")),
}
applyInfo(entry)
table.insert(list, entry)
end
end
end
NS.Index = index
break
end
end
if not list then
pcall(Util.UINotify, NAME .. ": could not load the list" .. (lastList and ", showing the last one" or ""))
return lastList or {}
end
table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.File:lower() < b.File:lower() end)
lastList = list
return list
end
function NS.Details(a, done, status)
status = status or function() end
local finished = false
task.delay(30, function() if not finished then done("timed out, you can still download it") end end)
task.spawn(function()
local ok, err = pcall(function()
status("Reading details...")
local src = (tostring(game:HttpGet(a.Source)):gsub("^\239\187\191", ""))
local info = scanModules(src)
if #info == 0 then error("no moveset or dance data in this file", 0) end
local have, miss = {}, {}
for _, n in assetNames(src) do
if findAsset(n, a.Path) then have[#have + 1] = esc(n) else miss[#miss + 1] = esc(n) end
end
a.Needs = (#have > 0 and ("Files it needs (from this store): " .. table.concat(have, ", ")) or "") .. (#miss > 0 and ((#have > 0 and "\n" or "") .. "Not in this store: " .. table.concat(miss, ", ")) or "")
if a.Needs == "" then a.Needs = nil end
INFO[a.File] = info
SaveData.NoobyInfo = type(SaveData.NoobyInfo) == "table" and SaveData.NoobyInfo or {}
SaveData.NoobyInfo[a.File] = info
applyInfo(a)
end)
finished = true
done(not ok and (tostring(err):gsub("^[^\n]-:%d+: ", "")) or nil)
end)
end
local function keep(name, data)
if type(data) ~= "string" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false end
name = (tostring(name):match("([^/]+)$") or "file"):gsub('[<>:"|?*]', "_")
pcall(makefolder, ROOT:sub(1, -2))
local base, ext = name:match("^(.+)(%.[^%.]+)$")
if not base then base, ext = name, "" end
local p, n = ROOT .. name, 1
while isfile(p) do
local okR, old = pcall(readfile, p)
if okR and old == data then return true end
n += 1
p = ROOT .. base .. " (" .. n .. ")" .. ext
end
return (pcall(writefile, p, data))
end
function NS.Has(a)
return isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Modules/" .. a.File)
end
function NS.Install(a, path, label)
if NS.Busy then
label.Text = "Download agent is busy"
return
end
NS.Busy = true
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local prev = type(SaveData.NoobyStore) == "table" and SaveData.NoobyStore[a.File]
if type(prev) == "table" then
for _, m in type(prev.Modules) == "table" and prev.Modules or {} do
if m ~= a.File then pcall(delfile, "UhhhhhhReanim/Modules/" .. m) end
end
SaveData.NoobyStore[a.File] = nil
end
label.Text = "Download agent summoned"
local fail0, t0 = _Assetdownloadingfail, os.clock()
AssetDownloadAgent(a.Source, a.File, path)
while not isfile(path) do
if _Assetdownloadingfail > fail0 or os.clock() - t0 > 90 then error("download failed", 0) end
task.wait(0.2)
end
local src = readfile(path)
if src:sub(1, 3) == "\239\187\191" then
src = src:sub(4)
writefile(path, src)
end
if #scanModules(src) == 0 then
pcall(delfile, path)
error("no moveset or dance data in this file", 0)
end
local saved = keep(a.Path:match("([^/]+)$") or a.File, src) and 1 or 0
local wanted = {}
for _, n in assetNames(src) do
local x, target = findAsset(n, a.Path), AssetGetPathFromFilename(n)
if x and not isfile(target) then wanted[#wanted + 1] = {name = n, target = target, url = x.Url} end
end
for i, w in wanted do
label.Text = "Downloading files " .. i .. "/" .. #wanted .. "..."
local fail1, t1 = _Assetdownloadingfail, os.clock()
AssetDownloadAgent(w.url, w.name .. os.clock(), w.target)
while not isfile(w.target) do
if _Assetdownloadingfail > fail1 or os.clock() - t1 > 90 then error("could not download " .. w.name, 0) end
task.wait(0.2)
end
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, w.target)
if okR and keep(w.name, data) then saved += 1 end
end
label.Text = "Loading modules..."
local okL = pcall(ForceModuleReload, false)
local picked, pickedDance
for _, nm in UserModulesListor[a.File] or {} do
for _, m in MovementStyles do
if not picked and m.Name == nm then picked = m end
end
for _, d in DanceableDances do
if not pickedDance and d.Name == nm then pickedDance = d end
end
end
if picked then
if picked.Hash then SaveData.MovesetHash = picked.Hash end
Util.MovesetPickedByUser = true
MovementStyleIndex = table.find(MovementStyles, picked)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Moveset: " .. picked.Name)
elseif pickedDance then
pcall(Util.Notify, "Dance: " .. pickedDance.Name)
end
pcall(Util.Notify, "Saved " .. saved .. " file(s) to NoobyStore. " .. (okL and "Modules reloaded - reload again later if you add or change files by hand." or "Reload modules now to apply them, or later from the Modules page."))
label.Text = "You already have this"
end)
if not ok then
local msg = (tostring(err):gsub("^[^\n]-:%d+: ", ""))
label.Text = "Install failed: " .. msg:sub(1, 60)
pcall(Util.UINotify, NAME .. ": install failed (" .. msg:sub(1, 80) .. ")")
end
NS.Busy = false
end

RefreshOnlineUserModules(NS)
MarkettePage.Interactable = false
MarkettePage.Visible = true
MarketPage.Interactable = false
local tween = TweenService:Create(MarkettePage, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {

})
tween:Play()
tween.Completed:Connect(function()
MarkettePage.Interactable = true
end)
end)
return NS
end)()
task.spawn(function()
local okM, errM = pcall(ForceModuleReload, false)
if not okM then warn("[Uh] module reload failed: " .. tostring(errM)) end
end)
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()
local LOW_FPS, LOW_SECS = 25, 3
local HIGH_FPS, HIGH_SECS = 40, 8
local WINDOW, WARMUP, COOLDOWN, TICK = 1, 6, 15, 0.25
local flagtable = {
{ name = "DFIntDebugFRMQualityLevelOverride", value = "1" },
{ name = "DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled", value = "True" },
{ name = "DFIntTextureQualityOverride", value = "0" },
{ name = "FIntRenderGrassDetailStrands", value = "0" },
}
local function same(a, b) return tostring(a):lower() == tostring(b):lower() end
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
local state = genv.UhAutoFPSState
if type(state) ~= "table" then
state = { changed = {}, noticedUnsupported = false }
genv.UhAutoFPSState = state
end
if state.conn then pcall(function() state.conn:Disconnect() end) state.conn = nil end
if genv.UhAutoFPS == false then return end
local function ShowNotification(msg)
pcall(Util.UINotify, msg)
end
local function readRender()
local ok, v = pcall(function() return settings().Rendering.QualityLevel end)
if ok then return v end
return nil
end
local N = 256
local ring, head, count, sum = table.create(N, 0), 1, 0, 0
local function push(dt)
if count == N then sum = sum - ring[head] head = head % N + 1 count = count - 1 end
ring[(head + count - 1) % N + 1] = dt
count = count + 1
sum = sum + dt
while count > 1 and sum > WINDOW do sum = sum - ring[head] head = head % N + 1 count = count - 1 end
end
local function apply(fps)
local changed, readable = state.changed, false
if type(getfflag) == "function" and type(setfflag) == "function" then
for _, f in ipairs(flagtable) do
local ok, orig = pcall(getfflag, f.name)
if ok and orig ~= nil and tostring(orig) ~= "" then
readable = true
if not same(orig, f.value) and pcall(setfflag, f.name, f.value) then
local ok2, cur = pcall(getfflag, f.name)
if ok2 and same(cur, f.value) then
changed[#changed + 1] = { kind = "flag", name = f.name, orig = tostring(orig), set = f.value }
else
pcall(setfflag, f.name, tostring(orig))
end
end
end
end
end
if #changed == 0 then
local cur = readRender()
if cur ~= nil then
readable = true
if cur ~= Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 then
pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
if readRender() == Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 then
changed[#changed + 1] = { kind = "render", orig = cur, set = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 }
end
end
end
end
if #changed > 0 then
ShowNotification(("Low FPS (%d): graphics quality level 1 enabled (%s)"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5), changed[1].kind == "flag" and "FFlag" or "graphics setting"))
elseif not readable and not state.noticedUnsupported then
state.noticedUnsupported = true
ShowNotification(("Low FPS (%d): no supported quality control available, nothing changed"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5)))
end
end
local function restore(fps)
local changed, reverted = state.changed, 0
for i = #changed, 1, -1 do
local c, done = changed[i], false
if c.kind == "flag" then
local ok, cur = pcall(getfflag, c.name)
if ok and not same(cur, c.set) then
done = true
elseif ok and pcall(setfflag, c.name, c.orig) then
local ok2, now = pcall(getfflag, c.name)
if ok2 and same(now, c.orig) then done = true reverted = reverted + 1 end
end
else
local cur = readRender()
if cur ~= nil and cur ~= c.set then
done = true
elseif cur ~= nil then
pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = c.orig end)
if readRender() == c.orig then done = true reverted = reverted + 1 end
end
end
if done then table.remove(changed, i) end
end
if #changed == 0 and reverted > 0 then
ShowNotification(("FPS recovered (%d): original graphics settings restored"):format(math.floor(fps + 0.5)))
end
end
local acc, started, lowSince, highSince, lastSwitch = 0, os.clock(), nil, nil, -math.huge
state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if genv.UhAutoFPS == false then return end
if dt > 1 then dt = 1 end
if dt > 0 then push(dt) end
acc = acc + dt
if acc < TICK then return end
acc = 0
local now = os.clock()
if now - started < WARMUP or sum < WINDOW * 0.5 then return end
local fps = count / sum
if #state.changed == 0 then
highSince = nil
if fps < LOW_FPS then
lowSince = lowSince or now
if now - lowSince >= LOW_SECS and now - lastSwitch >= COOLDOWN then
lowSince, lastSwitch = nil, now
apply(fps)
count, sum = 0, 0
end
else
lowSince = nil
end
else
lowSince = nil
if fps > HIGH_FPS then
highSince = highSince or now
if now - highSince >= HIGH_SECS and now - lastSwitch >= COOLDOWN then
highSince, lastSwitch = nil, now
restore(fps)
count, sum = 0, 0
end
else
highSince = nil
end
end
end)
end)
end)

local function safeGet(url)
local ok, res = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)
return ok and res or nil
end

["Dances/myuu.mp3"] = safeGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nitro-GT/music/refs/heads/main/myuu.mp3"),
["Dances/emoboy.mp3"] = safeGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nitro-GT/music/refs/heads/main/emoboy.mp3"),
["KDV3/Sphere.mp3"] = safeGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Solary-3/Scripts/refs/heads/Audios-1/Sphere.mp3"),
}
local function checkfile(id)
if isfile(id) then
local content = checkfiles[id]
if not content then return true end
if content == readfile(id) then
return true
end
end
return false
end
